workflows.body:
name: Announcements Content

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  content-check:
    name: announcements-content-check
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install announcement parser dependencies
        run: pnpm install --filter agent-teams-ai --prod --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Validate exact source against available Git base
        env:
          PR_BASE: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          PUSH_BASE: ${{ github.event.before }}
        run: |
          base="${PR_BASE:-$PUSH_BASE}"
          if [ -z "$base" ] || [ "$base" = "0000000000000000000000000000000000000000" ]; then
            echo "An explicit available Git base is required for content-check."
            exit 1
          fi
          node scripts/announcements/generate.mjs --check --base "$base"
      - name: Test publishing invariants
        run: node --test test/features/announcements/publishing/*.test.mjs
      - name: Generate static announcement artifacts
        run: node scripts/announcements/generate.mjs

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  packaged-windows:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - name: Enable long paths
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Assert pinned Windows runtime archive SHA-256
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $lock = Get-Content runtime.lock.json | ConvertFrom-Json
          $asset = $lock.assets.'win32-x64'
          if ($asset.sha256 -notmatch '^[a-f0-9]{64}$') { throw 'Invalid win32-x64 runtime lock hash' }
          if ($lock.releaseRepository -notmatch '^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$') { throw 'Invalid runtime release repository' }
          $archiveDir = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'issue684-runtime-archive'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $archiveDir | Out-Null
          $releaseUrl = "https://github.com/$($lock.releaseRepository)/releases/download/$([Uri]::EscapeDataString($lock.releaseTag))/$([Uri]::EscapeDataString($asset.file))"
          Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $releaseUrl -OutFile (Join-Path $archiveDir $asset.file) -TimeoutSec 300
          $actual = (Get-FileHash (Join-Path $archiveDir $asset.file) -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          if ($actual -ne $asset.sha256) { throw "Pinned runtime archive SHA-256 mismatch for $($asset.file)" }
      - name: Stage pinned runtime from runtime.lock.json
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform win32-x64
      - name: Stage pinned terminal runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform win32-x64
      - name: Build application
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Stage native OpenCode wrapper
        run: node scripts/stage-opencode-console-wrapper.mjs --platform win32-x64 --require
      - name: Package unpacked Windows x64 application
        run: pnpm pack:win:x64 --dir --publish never
      - name: Validate bundle
        run: node scripts/electron-builder/verifyBundle.cjs release/win-unpacked win32 x64
      - name: Run issue 684 packaged UI E2E
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:TMPDIR = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TEMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $executable = (Resolve-Path 'release/win-unpacked/AgentTeamsAI.exe').Path
          node scripts/e2e/anthropic-compatible-status/run-packaged.mjs --packaged-executable $executable
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Typecheck packaged default-model qualification
        run: node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.desktop-e2e.json
      - name: Prove inherited default through released bundled runtime and native save
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:TMPDIR = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TEMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $lock = Get-Content runtime.lock.json | ConvertFrom-Json
          $archive = Join-Path (Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'issue684-runtime-archive') $lock.assets.'win32-x64'.file
          $executable = (Resolve-Path 'release/win-unpacked/AgentTeamsAI.exe').Path
          node scripts/e2e/anthropic-compatible-status/default-model-packaged.ts --packaged-executable $executable --runtime-archive $archive
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Archive exact qualified Windows package
        if: success()
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $sourceCommit = git rev-parse HEAD
          $archive = "AgentTeamsAI-windows-684-$sourceCommit.zip"
          Compress-Archive -Path release/win-unpacked -DestinationPath "release/$archive"
          $digest = (Get-FileHash "release/$archive" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          "$digest  $archive" | Set-Content release/anthropic-compatible-status-SHA256SUMS.txt
      - name: Preserve qualified Windows package
        if: success()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: anthropic-compatible-status-windows-package-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            release/AgentTeamsAI-windows-684-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}.zip
            release/anthropic-compatible-status-SHA256SUMS.txt
      - name: Upload sanitized evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: anthropic-compatible-status-windows-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/anthropic-compatible-status-e2e-*/evidence.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/anthropic-compatible-status-e2e-*/*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/anthropic-compatible-status-e2e-*/desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/anthropic-default-e2e-*/evidence.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/anthropic-default-e2e-*/*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/anthropic-default-e2e-*/desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/anthropic-default-e2e-*/preflight.ndjson
            ${{ runner.temp }}/anthropic-default-e2e-*/team.meta.json

name: Build Linux and Windows Draft

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: New Linux/Windows draft tag
        type: string
        required: true
        default: v2.17.6
      build_only:
        description: Preserve verified payloads and provenance as Actions artifacts without draft writes
        type: boolean
        required: true
        default: false
      application_sha:
        description: Reviewed immutable application and workflow commit (40 hex characters)
        type: string
        required: true

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ inputs.release_tag }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
  APPLICATION_SHA: ${{ inputs.application_sha }}
  BUILD_ONLY: ${{ inputs.build_only }}

jobs:
  package:
    name: ${{ matrix.job_name }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - job_name: release-linux x64
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
            platform: linux
            arch: x64
            runtime: linux-x64
            bundle: linux-unpacked
            command: pnpm pack:linux
          - job_name: release-win x64
            runner: windows-latest
            platform: win32
            arch: x64
            runtime: win32-x64
            bundle: win-unpacked
            command: pnpm pack:win:x64
          - job_name: release-win arm64
            runner: windows-11-arm
            platform: win32
            arch: arm64
            runtime: win32-arm64
            bundle: win-arm64-unpacked
            command: pnpm pack:win:arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Require immutable reviewed workflow and source
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$APPLICATION_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$APPLICATION_SHA" == "$GITHUB_SHA" ]]
          [[ "$RELEASE_TAG" == 'v2.17.6' ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.application_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify source, version and existing tag
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$APPLICATION_SHA" ]]
          [[ "$(jq -r .version package.json)" == "${RELEASE_TAG#v}" ]]
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/matching-refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/tag-refs.json"
          if jq -e --arg ref "refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG" 'any(.[]; .ref == $ref)' "$RUNNER_TEMP/tag-refs.json" >/dev/null; then
            [[ "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$RELEASE_TAG" --jq .sha)" == "$APPLICATION_SHA" ]]
          fi
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Linux packaging dependencies
        if: ${{ matrix.platform == 'linux' }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libarchive-tools rpm xvfb binutils
      - name: Restore pnpm node-gyp executable bit
        run: |
          PNPM_STORE="$(pnpm store path)"
          PNPM_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"
          for path in "$PNPM_STORE" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$PNPM_BIN_DIR"; do
            if [ -d "$path" ]; then
              find "$path" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done
      - name: Install frozen dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Stage bundled runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.runtime }}
      - name: Stage terminal-platform runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.runtime }}
      - name: Verify Sentry release env
        env:
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-sentry-release.cjs prebuild
      - name: Verify PostHog release env
        env:
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-posthog-release.cjs prebuild
      - name: Build app
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: '--max-old-space-size=8192'
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Verify Sentry source map upload
        env:
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-sentry-release.cjs postbuild
      - name: Verify PostHog renderer bundle
        env:
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-posthog-release.cjs postbuild
      - name: Stage OpenCode console wrapper
        if: ${{ matrix.platform == 'win32' }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-opencode-console-wrapper.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.runtime }} --require
      - name: Verify packaged inputs
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f dist-electron/main/index.cjs
          test -f dist-electron/preload/index.js
          test -f out/renderer/index.html
          test -f mcp-server/dist/index.js
          test -f resources/runtime/VERSION
          test -f resources/terminal-platform/VERSION
          test -f resources/terminal-platform/terminal-platform-node/index.mjs
          if [[ '${{ matrix.platform }}' == win32 ]]; then
            test -f resources/terminal-platform/terminal-daemon.exe
            test -f resources/runtime/opencode-console/opencode.exe
          else
            test -f resources/terminal-platform/terminal-daemon
          fi
      - name: Package without publication
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: ${{ matrix.command }} --publish never
      - name: Validate Linux installers
        if: ${{ matrix.platform == 'linux' }}
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/verifyLinuxInstallers.cjs release
      - name: Verify actual pacman dependencies and ELF imports
        if: ${{ matrix.platform == 'linux' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          archive="release/agent-teams-ai-${RELEASE_TAG#v}.pacman"
          bsdtar -xOf "$archive" .PKGINFO > "$RUNNER_TEMP/pacman.PKGINFO"
          grep -Fx "pkgver = ${RELEASE_TAG#v}-1" "$RUNNER_TEMP/pacman.PKGINFO"
          jq -r '.build.pacman.depends[]' package.json | sort > "$RUNNER_TEMP/expected-depends"
          sed -n 's/^depend = //p' "$RUNNER_TEMP/pacman.PKGINFO" | sort > "$RUNNER_TEMP/actual-depends"
          diff -u "$RUNNER_TEMP/expected-depends" "$RUNNER_TEMP/actual-depends"
          ! grep -Fx http-parser "$RUNNER_TEMP/actual-depends"
          count=0
          : > "$RUNNER_TEMP/elf-needed.txt"
          while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
            if readelf -h "$file" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              count=$((count + 1))
              printf '%s\n' "$file" >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/elf-needed.txt"
              readelf -d "$file" >> "$RUNNER_TEMP/elf-needed.txt"
            fi
          done < <(find release/linux-unpacked -type f -print0)
          ((count > 0))
          ! grep -E 'NEEDED.*libhttp[-_]parser' "$RUNNER_TEMP/elf-needed.txt"
      - name: Validate packaged bundle
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/verifyBundle.cjs "release/${{ matrix.bundle }}" ${{ matrix.platform }} ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Smoke packaged app in disposable profile
        timeout-minutes: 2
        run: |
          if [[ '${{ matrix.platform }}' == linux ]]; then
            xvfb-run -a node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedApp.cjs "release/${{ matrix.bundle }}" linux
          else
            node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedApp.cjs "release/${{ matrix.bundle }}" win32
          fi
      - name: Upload immutable producer payloads
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: draft-${{ matrix.runtime }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            release/*.exe
            release/*.blockmap
            release/*.AppImage
            release/*.deb
            release/*.rpm
            release/*.pacman
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30
      - name: Preserve Linux packaging evidence
        if: ${{ always() && matrix.platform == 'linux' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: packaging-linux-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/pacman.PKGINFO
            ${{ runner.temp }}/elf-needed.txt
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

  draft:
    needs: package
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          pattern: draft-*-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: payloads
          merge-multiple: true
      - name: Create or resume append-only new draft
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$APPLICATION_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$APPLICATION_SHA" == "$GITHUB_SHA" && "$RELEASE_TAG" == v2.17.6 ]]
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID" > run.json
          jq -e --arg sha "$APPLICATION_SHA" --argjson attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" '.head_sha == $sha and .run_attempt == $attempt and .event == "workflow_dispatch" and .path == ".github/workflows/build-linux-windows-draft.yml"' run.json
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/attempts/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT/jobs?per_page=100" > jobs.json
          jq -e '.jobs | [.[] | select(.name == "release-linux x64" or .name == "release-win x64" or .name == "release-win arm64")] | length == 3 and all(.[]; .conclusion == "success")' jobs.json
          mkdir -p evidence
          jq --arg sha "$APPLICATION_SHA" --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --argjson attempt "$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" --slurpfile run run.json '{schemaVersion:1, applicationSha:$sha, tag:$tag, runId:$run[0].id, attempt:$attempt, jobs:[.jobs[] | select(.name == "release-linux x64" or .name == "release-win x64" or .name == "release-win arm64") | {id,name,conclusion,run_id}], workflowPath:$run[0].path}' jobs.json > "evidence/build-provenance-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT.json"
          version=${RELEASE_TAG#v}
          for name in "Agent.Teams.AI.Setup.$version.exe" "Agent.Teams.AI.Setup.$version-arm64.exe" "Agent.Teams.AI-$version.AppImage" "agent-teams-ai_${version}_amd64.deb" "agent-teams-ai-$version.x86_64.rpm" "agent-teams-ai-$version.pacman"; do
            test -f "payloads/$name"
          done
          for file in payloads/*; do
            jq -n --arg name "$(basename "$file")" --arg sha256 "$(sha256sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)" '{name:$name,sha256:$sha256}'
          done | jq -s . > payload-digests.json
          proof="evidence/build-provenance-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT.json"
          jq --slurpfile payloads payload-digests.json '. + {payloads:$payloads[0]}' "$proof" > provenance.json
          mv provenance.json "$proof"
          for file in payloads/* evidence/*.json; do
            [[ -f "$file" ]]
            name=$(basename "$file")
            case "$name" in *.exe|*.blockmap|*.AppImage|*.deb|*.rpm|*.pacman|build-provenance-*.json) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
          done
          if [[ "$BUILD_ONLY" == true ]]; then
            cat "$proof" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 0
          fi
          discover_draft() {
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases?per_page=100" --paginate --slurp | jq --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" '[.[][] | select(.tag_name == $tag)]' > existing.json
          }
          verify_tag_ref() {
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/matching-refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG" > tag-refs.json
            if jq -e --arg ref "refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG" 'any(.[]; .ref == $ref)' tag-refs.json >/dev/null; then
              [[ "$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/commits/$RELEASE_TAG" --jq .sha)" == "$APPLICATION_SHA" ]]
            fi
          }
          verify_tag_ref
          discover_draft
          count=$(jq length existing.json)
          [[ "$count" == 0 || "$count" == 1 ]]
          if [[ "$count" == 0 ]]; then
            gh release create "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$APPLICATION_SHA" --title "$RELEASE_TAG" --notes 'Linux/Windows build only. macOS remains at signed v2.17.1; carry-forward staging is required before publication.' --draft
            discover_draft
          fi
          jq -e --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --arg sha "$APPLICATION_SHA" 'length == 1 and (.[0] | .tag_name == $tag and .draft == true and .prerelease == false and .target_commitish == $sha and (.id | type == "number" and . > 0 and floor == .))' existing.json
          release_id=$(jq -r '.[0].id' existing.json)
          verify_bound_draft() {
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id" > draft.json
            jq -e --argjson id "$release_id" --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" --arg sha "$APPLICATION_SHA" '.id == $id and .tag_name == $tag and .draft == true and .prerelease == false and .target_commitish == $sha' draft.json
            verify_tag_ref
          }
          list_bound_assets() {
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id/assets?per_page=100" --paginate --slurp | jq '[.[][]]' > fresh-assets.json
          }
          verify_asset_snapshot() {
            jq -S 'map({id,name,size,digest,state}) | sort_by(.id)' expected-assets.json > expected-snapshot.json
            jq -S 'map({id,name,size,digest,state}) | sort_by(.id)' fresh-assets.json > fresh-snapshot.json
            diff -u expected-snapshot.json fresh-snapshot.json
          }
          verify_bound_draft
          list_bound_assets
          cp fresh-assets.json expected-assets.json
          for file in payloads/* evidence/*.json; do
            [[ -f "$file" ]]
            name=$(basename "$file")
            case "$name" in *.exe|*.blockmap|*.AppImage|*.deb|*.rpm|*.pacman|build-provenance-*.json) ;; *) exit 1 ;; esac
            digest="sha256:$(sha256sum "$file" | cut -d' ' -f1)"
            verify_bound_draft
            list_bound_assets
            verify_asset_snapshot
            matches=$(jq --arg name "$name" '[.[] | select(.name == $name)] | length' fresh-assets.json)
            if [[ "$matches" != 0 ]]; then
              [[ "$matches" == 1 ]]
              jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg digest "$digest" 'any(.[]; .name == $name and .digest == $digest and .state == "uploaded")' fresh-assets.json || { echo "Asset collision: $name" >&2; exit 1; }
            else
              encoded_name=$(jq -rn --arg name "$name" '$name | @uri')
              verify_bound_draft
              # Numeric identity prevents a tag lookup from retargeting the write.
              gh api "https://uploads.github.com/repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/releases/$release_id/assets?name=$encoded_name" --method POST -H 'Content-Type: application/octet-stream' --input "$file" > uploaded.json
              jq -e --arg name "$name" --arg digest "$digest" --argjson size "$(stat -c %s "$file")" '.name == $name and .digest == $digest and .size == $size and .state == "uploaded" and (.id | type == "number" and . > 0 and floor == .)' uploaded.json
              jq --slurpfile uploaded uploaded.json '. + $uploaded' expected-assets.json > next-assets.json
              mv next-assets.json expected-assets.json
            fi
          done
          verify_bound_draft
          list_bound_assets
          verify_asset_snapshot
          verify_bound_draft
          cat "evidence/build-provenance-$GITHUB_RUN_ID-$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT.json" >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Preserve producer identity evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: build-provenance-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: evidence/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

name: CI
# Immutable event inputs are available through run.display_title before jobs start.
run-name: >-
  ${{ format('CI proof: PR={0} | head={1} | base={2} | merge={3} | action={4} | draft={5}', github.event.pull_request.number || 0, github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha, github.event.pull_request.base.sha || 'none', github.sha, github.event.action || github.event_name, github.event.pull_request.draft && 'true' || 'false') }}

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      # Long-lived integration branches: pushes here previously ran no CI at all,
      # which let multi-day test regressions land unnoticed (they only surfaced
      # through PR #252's merge CI).
      - refactor/team-provisioning-round2-reapply
      - refactor/hosted-web-feature-boundaries
  pull_request:
    types:
      [
        opened,
        synchronize,
        reopened,
        ready_for_review,
        converted_to_draft,
        edited,
        labeled,
        unlabeled,
      ]
  merge_group:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      stage1_desktop:
        description: Run existing Stage 1 source Desktop controls with isolated localhost fixtures
        type: boolean
        default: false
      stage1_process_diagnostic:
        description: Record an unqualified current macOS tuple diagnostic with one owned finite Node child
        type: boolean
        default: false
      stage1_process_qualification:
        description: Run fresh TEST kernel ancestry, normal SDK Stop and unsigned packed Launch on the exact prospective tuple
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
# Every edited event is additionally isolated before the stricter Node classifier
# runs. Even malformed edits or failed planning must not cancel current-code CI.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && format('edited-{0}', github.run_id) || 'checks' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action != 'edited' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

env:
  CI_ROOT_TEST_SHARDS: '4'

jobs:
  plan:
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'Metadata CI plan' || 'plan' }}
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    outputs:
      scope: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.scope }}
      full: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.full }}
      metadata: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.metadata }}
      reuse: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.reuse }}
      source_run: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.source_run }}
      image: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.image }}
      linux_arch: ${{ steps.plan.outputs.linux_arch }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: "CI source proof: PR=${{ github.event.pull_request.number || 0 }} | base=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || 'none' }} | head=${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}"
        run: echo 'Source event identity recorded in job metadata'
      - name: Plan feedback and verify reusable evidence
        id: plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          CI_LINUX_RUNNER: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
        run: |
          node --test test/scripts/ciOptionalWorkflows.test.mts
          node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts plan

  feedback:
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && (needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'false') && 'Metadata fast feedback' || 'Fast feedback' }}
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.full == 'false' && needs.plan.outputs.metadata == 'false'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      # Force exit: a broken gate wait loop must fail this step, not hang it.
      - name: Test feedback policy
        run: node --test --test-force-exit test/scripts/ciFeedback*.test.mts test/scripts/ciChangeScope*.test.mts test/scripts/installDependenciesWithRetry.test.mjs
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Guard runtime artifacts
        run: node ./scripts/ci/forbid-runtime-artifacts.cjs
      - name: Guard production source file size
        run: node ./scripts/ci/check-source-file-size.mjs
      - name: Guard Team Provisioning architecture
        run: node ./scripts/ci/check-team-provisioning-architecture.mjs
      - name: Typecheck workspace
        run: pnpm typecheck:workspace
      - name: Fast lint
        run: pnpm lint:fast

  validate:
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && (needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'false') && 'Metadata validate' || 'validate' }}
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.full == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.scope == 'full'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Guard runtime artifacts
        run: node ./scripts/ci/forbid-runtime-artifacts.cjs

      - name: Guard production source file size
        run: node ./scripts/ci/check-source-file-size.mjs

      - name: Guard Team Provisioning architecture
        run: node ./scripts/ci/check-team-provisioning-architecture.mjs

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm

      # Loads the TypeScript contract parser, so it needs the pinned Node.
      - name: Verify runtime lock
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-runtime-lock.mjs

      - name: Restore pnpm node-gyp executable bit
        run: |
          PNPM_STORE="$(pnpm store path)"
          PNPM_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"
          for path in "$PNPM_STORE" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$PNPM_BIN_DIR"; do
            if [ -d "$path" ]; then
              find "$path" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs

      - name: Rebuild test SQLite native module for Node
        run: node ./scripts/ci/rebuild-better-sqlite3-node.cjs

      - name: Audit dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/audit-dependencies.mjs

      - name: Verify release download transport protocol
        run: node --test scripts/e2e/release-updater/github-download.test.mts

      - name: Validate workspace truth gate
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
        run: pnpm validate:ci

  test:
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && (needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'false') && 'Metadata test' || 'test' }} (${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.full == 'true' && (needs.plan.outputs.scope == 'full' || needs.plan.outputs.scope == 'source') && needs.plan.outputs.reuse != 'true'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]

    steps:
      - name: "CI runner proof: ${{ runner.os }} | ${{ runner.arch }} | ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}"
        run: echo 'Runner identity recorded in job metadata'
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Setup captured Host Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0

      - name: Capture exact Host test runtime
        run: echo "AGENT_BACKEND_TEST_NODE=$(node -p 'process.execPath')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Read runner image identity
        id: image
        run: node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts image
      - name: 'CI image proof: ${{ steps.image.outputs.image }}'
        run: echo 'Runner image identity recorded in job metadata'

      - name: Restore pnpm node-gyp executable bit
        run: |
          PNPM_STORE="$(pnpm store path)"
          PNPM_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"
          for path in "$PNPM_STORE" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$PNPM_BIN_DIR"; do
            if [ -d "$path" ]; then
              find "$path" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done

      - name: Install lsof for diagnostics ownership checks
        run: |
          if ! command -v lsof >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            # lsof is not in the ubuntu-24.04 runner image package list, but Homebrew
            # is preinstalled there (see actions/runner-images Ubuntu2404-Readme.md)
            # and its lsof formula ships Linux bottles, so install without su/apt:
            if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1 && [ -x /home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew ]; then
              eval "$(/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/bin/brew shellenv)"
            fi
            if ! command -v brew >/dev/null 2>&1; then
              echo "lsof is required by the opencode diagnostics ownership harness"
              echo "and neither lsof nor Homebrew is available on this runner"
              exit 1
            fi
            brew install lsof
            # Each Actions step starts a fresh shell; preserve Homebrew discovery.
            echo "$(brew --prefix)/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
            echo "$(brew --prefix)/sbin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"
          fi
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs

      - name: Rebuild test SQLite native module for Node
        run: node ./scripts/ci/rebuild-better-sqlite3-node.cjs

      - name: Test workspace packages
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-controller test
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp test
          # The portable Host test script requires Node 24; reuse the runtime captured above.
          PATH="$(dirname "$AGENT_BACKEND_TEST_NODE"):$PATH" pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host test

      - name: Test CI scripts and OpenCode proof runner safety
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          node --test test/scripts/auditDependencies.test.mjs test/scripts/installDependenciesWithRetry.test.mjs test/scripts/proveOpenCode*.test.mjs test/scripts/opencodeProofVitest.integration.test.mjs 2>&1 | tail -20

      - name: Build MCP server for root integration tests
        run: pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build

      - name: Build captured Host and ledger prerequisites
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build

      - name: Test root shard
        run: pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/4

      - name: Test feedback policy
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: node --test --test-force-exit test/scripts/ciFeedback*.test.mts test/scripts/ciChangeScope*.test.mts

  lint:
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && (needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'false') && 'Metadata lint' || 'lint' }} (${{ matrix.scope }})
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.full == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.scope == 'full' && needs.plan.outputs.reuse != 'true'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - scope: main
            paths: src/main src/preload src/shared src/types
          - scope: renderer
            paths: src/renderer
          - scope: features
            paths: src/features

    steps:
      - name: "CI runner proof: ${{ runner.os }} | ${{ runner.arch }} | ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}"
        run: echo 'Runner identity recorded in job metadata'
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Read runner image identity
        id: image
        run: node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts image
      - name: 'CI image proof: ${{ steps.image.outputs.image }}'
        run: echo 'Runner image identity recorded in job metadata'

      - name: Restore pnpm node-gyp executable bit
        run: |
          PNPM_STORE="$(pnpm store path)"
          PNPM_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"
          for path in "$PNPM_STORE" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$PNPM_BIN_DIR"; do
            if [ -d "$path" ]; then
              find "$path" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs

      - name: Build captured Host and ledger prerequisites
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build

      - name: Restore ESLint cache
        uses: actions/cache@v5
        with:
          path: .eslintcache-${{ matrix.scope }}
          key: eslint-v3-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.scope }}-${{ hashFiles('.node-version', 'pnpm-lock.yaml', 'package.json', 'pnpm-workspace.yaml', 'eslint.config.*', 'tsconfig*.json', 'scripts/tsconfig/*.json', 'electron.vite.config.ts', 'src/**', 'test/**', 'packages/agent-graph/src/**', 'scripts/team-changes-real-data-smoke.ts', 'scripts/smoke/codex-runtime-install.ts', 'resources/pricing.json') }}

      - name: Lint source shard
        run: pnpm lint:ci:files ${{ matrix.paths }} --cache-location .eslintcache-${{ matrix.scope }}

      - name: Lint MCP package
        if: matrix.scope == 'main'
        run: pnpm lint:mcp

  task-change-ledger-windows:
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    name: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'edited' && (needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'false') && 'Metadata Windows smoke' || 'Task change ledger Windows smoke' }}
    needs: plan
    if: needs.plan.outputs.full == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.scope == 'full'
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
      - name: 'CI runner proof: ${{ runner.os }} | ${{ runner.arch }} | windows-latest'
        run: echo 'Runner identity recorded in job metadata'
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Enable Windows long paths
        shell: pwsh
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Read runner image identity
        id: image
        run: node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts image
      - name: 'CI image proof: ${{ steps.image.outputs.image }}'
        run: echo 'Runner image identity recorded in job metadata'

      - name: Verify reusable Windows evidence
        id: windows
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          MODE_REUSE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.reuse }}
          SOURCE_RUN: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.source_run }}
          CI_LINUX_RUNNER: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
          CI_LINUX_IMAGE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.image }}
          CI_LINUX_ARCH: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.linux_arch }}
        run: node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts windows

      # Reused evidence needs Node only. Register cache post-actions only when
      # dependencies will be installed, so an absent pnpm store cannot fail reuse.
      - name: Setup pnpm
        if: steps.windows.outputs.reuse != 'true'
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js dependency cache
        if: steps.windows.outputs.reuse != 'true'
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Install dependencies
        if: steps.windows.outputs.reuse != 'true'
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs

      - name: Build captured Host and ledger prerequisites

          import { mkdtempSync, readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { join, resolve } from 'node:path';

          assert.equal(await fileHash(claude), '86cb722ab68348877dba7971e4d0c659919e05e6228c05e006e83da320e656ef');
          const output = mkdtempSync(join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'TEST-scheduled-native-evidence-'));
          const logPath = join(output, 'native-schedules.log'), maxOutputBytes = 8 * 1024 * 1024;
          const run = spawnSync(process.execPath, ['--test', 'packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/scheduled-run-host.native.ts'], {
              cwd: repo, timeout: 650_000, maxBuffer: maxOutputBytes, stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe'], env: { ...process.env,
                LEGACY_SCHEDULE_NATIVE_GO: '1', LEGACY_SCHEDULE_SOURCE_HEAD: process.env.CODEX_LOGIN_SOURCE_HEAD,
                LEGACY_SCHEDULE_CLAUDE: claude, LEGACY_SCHEDULE_CODEX: process.env.LEGACY_DESKTOP_CODEX_PATH,

                LEGACY_SCHEDULE_NATIVE_EVIDENCE: output,
              },
          });
          const chunks = [run.stdout ?? Buffer.alloc(0), run.stderr ?? Buffer.alloc(0)];
          const capturedBytes = chunks.reduce((bytes, chunk) => bytes + chunk.length, 0);
          const log = Buffer.concat(chunks, Math.min(capturedBytes, maxOutputBytes));
          writeFileSync(logPath, log, { mode: 0o600 });
          console.log(log.toString('utf8'));
          assert.ok(capturedBytes <= maxOutputBytes, 'original native schedule output exceeded its bound');
          assert.equal(run.error, undefined); assert.equal(run.status, 0);
          for (const provider of ['claude', 'codex']) {

            assert.equal(receipt.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(receipt.provider, provider);

        if: always()

            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/*.json
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/*.log
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/process-artifact/manifest.json
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/process-artifact/registered-process-darwin.c
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/process-artifact/registered-process.node
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/candidate/electron-builder.candidate.json
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/candidate/legacy-agent-host/candidate.json
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-native-ancestry-*/proof.ndjson
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-desktop-backend-*/*.json
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-desktop-backend-*/*.ndjson
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-desktop-backend-*/*.log
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-desktop-backend-*/*.png
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-desktop-backend-*/hoststore/**
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-desktop-backend-*/workspace/**
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-desktop-backend-*/userData/agent-backend/bindings/**
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/tmp/TEST-desktop-backend-*/native-claude/config/projects/**/*.jsonl
      - name: Preserve exact TEST inputs, original receipts and incomplete custody
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=4096
        with:
          name: stage1-process-qualification-${{ github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/stage1-process-qualification*.log
            /private/tmp/TEST-stage1-p7-*/**

  # Required by branch protection. Keep the name static for every event: on
  # PR #985 an edited-event run that reported another name left the required
  # context "Expected" although earlier runs for the same head had passed.
  # A title/body edit run skips the heavy jobs and its gate waits for the
  # same-input CI run instead of repeating it; it passes only on that run's
  # authenticated complete success. See docs/ci-qualification.md.
  full-qualification:
    name: Full qualification
    needs: [plan, validate, test, lint, task-change-ledger-windows, focused, source, dmg-artwork, retained-opencode-coexistence, codex-login-desktop]
    if: always() && !cancelled()
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Require selected Codex login and native schedule qualification
        if: >-
          needs.plan.outputs.metadata == 'false' &&
          github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false &&
          github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
          (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'feat/provider-host-frontend-parity-20261112' ||
           github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'feat/provider-host-frontend-parity-20261112')
        env:
          CODEX_LOGIN_RESULT: ${{ needs.codex-login-desktop.result }}
        run: test "$CODEX_LOGIN_RESULT" = success
      - name: Require selected retained V1 and Host V2 native Desktop qualification
        if: >-
          needs.plan.outputs.full == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.reuse == 'false' &&
          ((github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.stage1_desktop) ||
          (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.draft == false && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
          (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'feat/provider-migration-stage-1' || (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && github.event.pull_request.head.ref == 'feat/provider-migration-stage-1'))))
        env:
          RETAINED_COEXISTENCE_RESULT: ${{ needs.retained-opencode-coexistence.result }}
        run: test "$RETAINED_COEXISTENCE_RESULT" = success
      # The script deadline (METADATA_GATE.waitMs, 90 min) fails the gate first;
      # this timeout bounds the last proof after it. Either outcome is a failure.
      - name: Verify completed current-code qualification after metadata edits
        if: needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.metadata == 'true' && needs.plan.outputs.full == 'false' && needs.plan.outputs.reuse == 'false'
        timeout-minutes: 100
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts metadata-gate
      - name: Require complete current-code qualification
        if: needs.plan.result != 'success' || needs.plan.outputs.metadata != 'true' || needs.plan.outputs.full != 'false' || needs.plan.outputs.reuse != 'false'
        env:
          JOB_RESULTS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
          MODE_FULL: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.full }}
          MODE_REUSE: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.reuse }}
          SOURCE_RUN: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.source_run }}
        run: node scripts/ci/ci-feedback.mts gate

    # No GitHub paths filter: its 3,000-file cap can silently skip Host/provider changes.
    # The checked-out exact local git diff is classified by packaged-ci-cli.mts.

permissions:
  contents: read

# Metadata edits use unique groups and noncanonical check names, even if setup fails.
# A title/body edit must never cancel or replace checks for the same code.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}-${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && format('metadata-{0}', github.run_id) || 'checks' }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && !(github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body)) }}

jobs:
  packaged-scope:
    name: classify packaged smoke
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    outputs:
      scope: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.scope }}
      run: ${{ steps.scope.outputs.run }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Verify packaged CI policy contracts
        run: node --test scripts/ci/packaged-ci-policy.test.mts
      - name: Test provider archive integrity gate
        run: node --test scripts/ci/packaged-ci-provider-integrity.test.ts
      - name: Classify exact local PR diff
        id: scope
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-cli.mts classify

  packaged-smoke:
    needs: packaged-scope
    if: needs.packaged-scope.outputs.run == 'true' && github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    name: ${{ github.event.action == 'edited' && !github.event.changes.base && (github.event.changes.title || github.event.changes.body) && 'metadata packaged smoke' || 'packaged smoke' }} (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: darwin-arm64
            arch: arm64
            os: darwin
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15' }}
            pack: pack:mac:arm64
            bundle: release/mac-arm64/Agent Teams AI.app
          - platform: darwin-x64
            arch: x64
            os: darwin
            runner: macos-15-intel
            pack: pack:mac:x64
            bundle: release/mac/Agent Teams AI.app
          - platform: win32-x64
            arch: x64
            os: win32
            runner: windows-2022
            pack: pack:win:x64
            bundle: release/win-unpacked
          - platform: win32-arm64
            arch: arm64
            os: win32
            runner: windows-11-arm
            pack: pack:win:arm64
            bundle: release/win-arm64-unpacked
          - platform: linux-x64
            arch: x64
            os: linux
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
            pack: pack:linux
            bundle: release/linux-unpacked

    env:
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        if: matrix.os != 'darwin'
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Install Linux packaging tools
        if: matrix.os == 'linux'
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y libarchive-tools rpm xvfb
      - name: Restore node-gyp executable bit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          for root in "$(pnpm store path)" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"; do
            if [ -d "$root" ]; then
              find "$root" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done
      - name: Verify selected provider archives against frozen lock before install
        run: node scripts/ci/packaged-ci-provider-integrity.ts
      - name: Install frozen dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Verify managed Git pins and archive path safety
        run: node --test scripts/stage-managed-git.test.mjs
      - name: Validate packaged OpenCode project-path smoke syntax early
        if: matrix.os == 'darwin'
        run: node --check scripts/e2e/opencode-project-path-packaged.mjs
      - name: Typecheck packaged CI policy with pinned compiler
        run: node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.packaged-ci.json
      - name: Assert Electron binary was provisioned during install
        run: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const path=require('node:path'); const root=path.dirname(require.resolve('electron/package.json')); const marker=path.join(root,'path.txt'); if(!fs.existsSync(marker) || !fs.existsSync(path.join(root,'dist',fs.readFileSync(marker,'utf8')))) process.exit(1)"
      - name: Test bundled undici security version policy
        run: node --test test/scripts/verify-bundled-undici.test.cjs
      - name: Verify CI Node and Electron built-in undici versions
        run: node scripts/ci/verify-bundled-undici.cjs
      - name: Verify native rebuild
        run: pnpm exec electron-rebuild -f -o node-pty,ssh2,cpu-features,better-sqlite3
      - name: Stage bundled runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
      - name: Stage terminal platform runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
      - name: Stage Windows console wrapper
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        run: node ./scripts/stage-opencode-console-wrapper.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }} --require
      - name: Build app
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Select exact Host Node for candidate staging
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Prepare actual pinned V2 Bun, engine and admitted process custody
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_INPUTS_RECEIPT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-packaged-inputs.json
        run: node --import tsx scripts/legacy-agent-host/prepare-opencode-v2-native.ts
      - name: Prefill pinned macOS arm64 Host Node archive
        if: matrix.platform == 'darwin-arm64'
        run: node scripts/ci/prefill-legacy-host-macos-node.mts
      - name: Stage V2 Host closure in existing candidate extraResources
        run: node scripts/legacy-agent-host/stage-opencode-v2-packaged.ts
      - name: Typecheck and test packaged Host capture boundaries
        shell: bash
        run: |
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.legacy-agent-host-scripts.json
          node --test scripts/legacy-agent-host/candidate-closure.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/packaged-opencode-v2-inputs.test.ts scripts/legacy-agent-host/stage-node.test.ts
      - name: Verify and stage original Windows scoped broker for packaged Retry
        if: matrix.os == 'win32'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original broker compiler failed' }
          node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p tools/owned-process-broker/tsconfig.retained-host.json
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original retained Host compiler failed' }
          node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=1 --config tools/owned-process-broker/vitest.config.ts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original broker protocol cases failed' }
          node --check tools/owned-process-broker/nativeWindowsAppGate.mjs
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Packaged Windows driver syntax failed' }
          $build = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("TEST-Windows-UI-build-" + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + "-" + $env:RUNNER_ARCH)
          $stage = Join-Path $PWD 'resources\legacy-agent-host\windows-retry-custody'
          if (Test-Path $stage) { throw 'Windows Retry broker destination must be absent' }
          $cmake = (Get-Command cmake.exe -ErrorAction Stop).Source
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/build/buildOwnedProcessBroker.ts ${{ matrix.arch }} $build $stage $cmake service-scopes-v1
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Original scoped broker stage failed' }
          "WINDOWS_RETRY_BUILD=$build" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV

name: Host Emulated Acceptance

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/host-emulated-acceptance.yml'
      - 'packages/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'packages/task-change-ledger/**'
      - 'scripts/legacy-agent-host/**'
      - 'tools/owned-process-broker/fixtures/**'
      - 'tools/linux-node-exec/**'
      - 'scripts/build/buildLinuxNodeExec.mjs'
      - 'scripts/dev-with-runtime.mjs'
      - 'scripts/build/linuxNodeExec.native.test.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/afterPack.cjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/dist.mjs'
      - 'scripts/electron-builder/verifyLinuxNodeExec.cjs'
      - 'src/features/agent-backend/**'
      - 'src/features/runtime-provider-management/**'
      - 'src/features/codex-runtime-installer/**'
      - 'src/features/opencode-runtime-installer/**'
      - 'src/main/**'
      - 'src/preload/**'
      - 'src/renderer/**'
      - 'src/shared/**'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'

permissions:
  contents: read

# Draft PRs run finite peers and the separately declared OpenCode-only local-model lane.
# Existing native Claude/Codex gates keep their scope.
concurrency:
  # Leave the obsolete always-aggregate group after all of its matrix jobs were cancelled.
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-v2-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  offline-desktop-scenario:
    name: Offline Host Desktop (${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}, ${{ matrix.lane }})
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        lane: [team, taskboard, skills, cross-team, collaboration, extensions, import, management, codex-login, codex, claude, claude-lifecycle, opencode, review, selection, processes]
        include:
          - lane: installer
            runner: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
          - lane: opencode-v2-management
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            platform: linux-x64
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_EMULATED_LANE: ${{ matrix.lane }}
      HOST_EMULATED_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform || 'linux-x64' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Verify original checkout and runner tuple
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"

  offline-frontend-tests:
    name: Offline frontend tests (${{ matrix.shard }}/4)
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2, 3, 4]
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      HOST_TEST_SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Verify source and capture the original Host test runtime
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$HOST_EMULATED_SOURCE_HEAD"
          echo "AGENT_BACKEND_TEST_NODE=$(node -p 'process.execPath')" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Setup the original workspace test runtime
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prepare original test prerequisites
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y lsof
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs --child-concurrency=1
          node scripts/ci/rebuild-better-sqlite3-node.cjs
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Run the complete safe frontend shard
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Live subscriptions and real vendor executables are outside this finite lane.
          # Excluded files remain unqualified; the existing native gates are unchanged.
          pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 --shard="$HOST_TEST_SHARD/4" \
            --exclude '**/*.live.test.*' --exclude '**/*.live-e2e.test.*' --exclude '**/*.native.test.*' \
            --reporter=default --reporter=json --outputFile "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.json" \
            2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/host-offline-tests-$HOST_TEST_SHARD.log"
      - name: Preserve original test results, including failures
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: host-offline-tests-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}-${{ matrix.shard }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/host-offline-tests-*.log

  offline-desktop:
    name: Offline Host Desktop
    if: ${{ always() && !cancelled() && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) }}
    needs: [offline-desktop-scenario, offline-frontend-tests]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Require every original UI lane and safe frontend shard to pass
        env:
          HOST_EMULATED_MATRIX_RESULT: ${{ needs['offline-desktop-scenario'].result }}
          HOST_FRONTEND_TEST_RESULT: ${{ needs['offline-frontend-tests'].result }}
        run: |
          test "$HOST_EMULATED_MATRIX_RESULT" = success
          test "$HOST_FRONTEND_TEST_RESULT" = success
