name: macOS Signing Qualification

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      use_github_runner:
        description: Use GitHub hosted macOS when the configured runner is unavailable
        type: boolean
        default: false

concurrency:
  group: macos-signing-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

defaults:
  run:
    shell: bash

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  IS_RELEASE_BUILD: 'false'
  CI_TIMEOUT_BUFFER_MINUTES: 15

jobs:
  signing-custody:
    name: Require owner dispatch from the trusted signing branch
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Reject untrusted signing dispatch
        env:
          REPOSITORY_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          TRIGGERING_ACTOR: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = workflow_dispatch
          test "$GITHUB_ACTOR" = "$REPOSITORY_OWNER"
          test "$TRIGGERING_ACTOR" = "$REPOSITORY_OWNER"
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = refs/heads/release/macos-signing

  release-mac:
    needs: signing-custody
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner && github.ref == 'refs/heads/release/macos-signing' }}
    environment: macos-signing
    timeout-minutes: 90
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: arm64
            runner: ${{ inputs.use_github_runner && 'macos-15' || vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15' }}
            dist_command: pnpm pack:mac:arm64
            bundle: release/mac-arm64/Agent Teams AI.app
          - arch: x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
            dist_command: pnpm pack:mac:x64
            bundle: release/mac/Agent Teams AI.app
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Setup Python for node-gyp
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Restore pnpm node-gyp executable bit
        run: |
          PNPM_STORE="$(pnpm store path)"
          PNPM_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"
          for path in "$PNPM_STORE" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$PNPM_BIN_DIR"; do
            if [ -d "$path" ]; then
              find "$path" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        timeout-minutes: 15
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs

      - name: Verify active signing preflight
        run: node --test scripts/electron-builder/mac-signing-preflight.test.mts

      - name: Set version from release tag
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
          pnpm pkg set version="$VERSION"

      - name: Stage bundled runtime (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: node ./scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform "darwin-${{ matrix.arch }}"

      - name: Stage terminal-platform runtime (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: node ./scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform "darwin-${{ matrix.arch }}"

      - name: Verify Sentry release env (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-sentry-release.cjs prebuild

      - name: Verify PostHog release env (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-posthog-release.cjs prebuild

      - name: Build app (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        timeout-minutes: 30
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: '--max-old-space-size=8192'
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && secrets.SENTRY_DSN || '' }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ''
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && secrets.POSTHOG_KEY || '' }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Verify Sentry source map upload (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-sentry-release.cjs postbuild

      - name: Verify PostHog renderer bundle (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-posthog-release.cjs postbuild

      - name: Verify packaged inputs (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        run: |
          test -f dist-electron/main/index.cjs
          test -f dist-electron/preload/index.js
          test -f out/renderer/index.html
          test -f mcp-server/dist/index.js
          test -f resources/runtime/VERSION
          test -f resources/terminal-platform/VERSION
          test -f resources/terminal-platform/terminal-daemon
          test -f resources/terminal-platform/terminal-platform-node/index.mjs

      - name: Verify Apple signing credentials (macOS)
        env:
          APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64 }}
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.CSC_LINK }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_ISSUER }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${APPLE_TEAM_ID:-}" = "86399583GS" || { echo "Unexpected APPLE_TEAM_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
          for name in CSC_LINK CSC_KEY_PASSWORD APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64 APPLE_API_KEY_ID APPLE_API_ISSUER; do
            test -n "${!name:-}" || { echo "Missing $name" >&2; exit 1; }
          done

      - name: Prepare Apple notarization API key
        env:
          APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYTHON'
          import base64, os, pathlib
          key = base64.b64decode(os.environ['APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64'], validate=True)
          if not key:
              raise SystemExit('Apple notarization API key is empty')
          path = pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'apple-notary-key.p8'
          with path.open('wb') as stream:
              os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), 0o600)
              stream.write(key)
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as stream:
              stream.write(f'APPLE_API_KEY={path}\n')
          PYTHON

      - name: Package (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        timeout-minutes: 45
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.CSC_LINK }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: ${{ matrix.dist_command }} --publish never

      - name: Verify signed and notarized bundle (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: bash scripts/ci/verify-macos-signing.sh "${{ matrix.bundle }}" --notarized

      - name: Validate packaged bundle (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/verifyBundle.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" darwin ${{ matrix.arch }}

      - name: Smoke signed macOS bundled Git (${{ matrix.arch }})
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokeManagedGit.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" darwin ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - name: Smoke packaged app (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: node ./scripts/electron-builder/smokePackagedApp.cjs "${{ matrix.bundle }}" darwin

      - name: Verify transported macOS apps
        run: bash scripts/ci/verify-macos-archives.sh release

      - name: Record exact packaged source
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$GITHUB_SHA"
          git rev-parse HEAD > release/source-sha.txt
          (cd release && shasum -a 256 *.dmg *.zip > SHA256SUMS)

      - name: Upload qualified macOS installers
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: signed-macos-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: |
            release/*.dmg
            release/*.zip
            release/*.blockmap
            release/source-sha.txt
            release/SHA256SUMS
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

name: OpenCode diagnostics desktop E2E

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics-desktop.mjs
      - src/renderer/store/index.ts
      # The #1153 catalog recovery and snapshot-freshness boundaries also affect
      # native Desktop provider UX, even when the E2E harness itself is unchanged.
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/main/infrastructure/AgentTeamsRuntimeProviderManagementCliClient.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/core/application/loadOpenCodeScopedCatalog.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/hooks/useOpenCodeConnectedModelCatalog.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/hooks/useOpenCodeProviderModelCatalog.ts
      - src/renderer/components/dashboard/useOpenCodeDashboardStatus.ts
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/**
      - test/scripts/opencodeStartupCleanupFixture.test.mjs
      - .github/workflows/opencode-desktop-e2e.yml
      # Compatibility states change the native runtime user-facing E2E.
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/core/domain/openCodeProviderCompatibility.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/ui/OpenCodeProviderCompatibilityStatus.tsx
      # Provider settings first-paint and status changes require isolated Electron
      # proof on Windows and Linux, not only a renderer unit test.
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/RuntimeProviderManagementPanel.tsx
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/hooks/useRuntimeProviderManagement.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/hooks/maskRuntimeProviderStateForScope.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/hooks/runtimeProviderDirectoryCatalogPolicy.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/hooks/useRuntimeProviderQuickConnect.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/runtimeProviderDirectoryCache.ts
      - src/renderer/components/runtime/ProviderRuntimeSettingsDialog.tsx
      - src/renderer/components/runtime/openCodeStatusPresentation.ts

permissions:
  contents: read

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  desktop:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      # Keep the long catalog and Windows startup-cleanup qualification on
      # independent disposable runners. Each retains its original full checks.
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-latest
            scenario: catalog
          - os: windows-latest
            scenario: catalog
          - os: windows-latest
            scenario: startup-cleanup
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os == 'ubuntu-latest' && (vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest') || matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Enable Windows long paths
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Verify harness safety
        run: node --test scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/platform.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/catalog.test.mjs test/scripts/opencodeStartupCleanupFixture.test.mjs
      # Stage1 extracts Host imports consumed by the Electron main bundle.
      # pnpm install alone does not materialize the workspace dist exports.
      - name: Build isolated Host before Electron startup
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Configure disposable artifact directory
        shell: bash
        run: |
          echo "TMPDIR=$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "TEMP=$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          echo "TMP=$RUNNER_TEMP" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Verify Linux desktop
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && matrix.scenario == 'catalog'
        run: xvfb-run -a node scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/run.mjs
      - name: Verify Windows desktop
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && matrix.scenario == 'catalog'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          node scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/run.mjs
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Diagnose isolated Windows enumeration
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && matrix.scenario == 'catalog'
        run: node scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/windows-enumeration-probe.mjs
      - name: Verify Windows startup cleanup recovery
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && matrix.scenario == 'startup-cleanup'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          node scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/run.mjs --startup-cleanup
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Preserve diagnostic evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: opencode-desktop-${{ runner.os }}-${{ matrix.scenario }}-${{ github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/*.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/*.ndjson
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/manifest.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/**/app-errors.ndjson
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/**/opencode-bridge/diagnostics/latest.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/**/opencode-bridge/diagnostics/events.ndjson

# Plain-spawn TEST qualification port from #1004, f3cd8cf8616fea199a1f565ffa561b618ec2e1db.
name: OpenCode native Windows real tasks

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      arch:
        description: Native Windows architecture; ARM64 qualifies V2 only
        type: string
        default: x64
      sdk_ref:
        required: true
        type: string
      model:
        description: Explicit selected model required for native and source-only startup; it must be in the newest V2 catalog; unused for provider-only
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      versions:
        type: string
        default: current
      provider_only:
        type: boolean
        default: false
      short_tasks:
        description: Run only the first real task and physical stop; not full-team qualification
        type: boolean
        default: false
      source_only:
        type: boolean
        default: false
      runtime_candidate_run:
        type: string
        default: ''
      runtime_candidate_sha:
        type: string
        default: ''
    secrets:
      RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN:
        required: false
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY:
        required: true
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      arch:
        description: Native Windows architecture; ARM64 qualifies V2 only
        type: choice
        options: [x64, arm64]
        default: x64
      sdk_ref:
        description: Independently reviewed exact SDK commit with qualified Windows native gate
        required: true
        type: string
      model:
        description: Explicit openrouter/ model required for native and source-only startup; it must be in the newest V2 catalog; unused for provider-only
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      versions:
        description: 'Newest V2 only by default; all adds V1'
        type: choice
        options: [current, all, v1]
        default: current
      provider_only:
        description: Compare verified 118 and explicit CI candidate with official npm V1 provider commands only
        type: boolean
        default: false
      short_tasks:
        description: Run only the first real task and physical stop; not full-team qualification
        type: boolean
        default: false
      source_only:
        description: Requires exact sdk_ref and explicit model; real startup/stop without packaging or model prompts
        type: boolean
        default: false
      runtime_candidate_run:
        description: Exact completed Windows packaged-delivery CI producer run for provider-only verification
        type: string
        default: ''
      runtime_candidate_sha:
        description: Exact candidate source SHA matching sdk_ref for provider-only verification
        type: string
        default: ''

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  real-tasks:
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.arch == 'arm64' && 'windows-11-arm' || 'windows-2022' }}
    env:
      NATIVE_ARCH: ${{ inputs.arch || 'x64' }}
      NATIVE_PLATFORM: win32-${{ inputs.arch || 'x64' }}
      NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.arch == 'arm64' && 'release/win-arm64-unpacked' || 'release/win-unpacked' }}
    timeout-minutes: 90
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: TEST-native-source
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          path: TEST-native-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Validate exact inputs
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.versions }}
          SOURCE_ONLY: ${{ inputs.source_only }}
          SDK_REF: ${{ inputs.sdk_ref }}
          SELECTED_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
          PROVIDER_ONLY: ${{ inputs.provider_only }}
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_RUN: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_run }}
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_sha }}
        run: |
          if ($env:NATIVE_ARCH -cnotin @('x64', 'arm64')) { throw 'Unknown native Windows architecture' }
          if ($env:NATIVE_ARCH -eq 'arm64' -and ($env:VERSIONS -ne 'current' -or $env:PROVIDER_ONLY -eq 'true')) { throw 'Windows ARM64 requires the V2 current qualification scenario' }
          if ($env:VERSIONS -cnotin @('all', 'v1', 'current')) { throw 'Unknown Windows version selection' }
          if ($env:SOURCE_ONLY -eq 'true' -and $env:PROVIDER_ONLY -ne 'true' -and $env:VERSIONS -eq 'v1') { throw 'V1 has no V2 source-only scenario' }
          if ($env:SDK_REF -notmatch '^[a-f0-9]{40}$') { throw 'Exact SDK SHA required for native, source-only and provider-only runs' }
          if ($env:PROVIDER_ONLY -ne 'true' -and $env:SELECTED_MODEL -notmatch '^openrouter/[a-zA-Z0-9_./:~-]+$') { throw 'Explicit OpenRouter model required for native and source-only startup; no model prompts in source-only mode' }
          if ($env:PROVIDER_ONLY -eq 'true') {
            if ($env:RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_RUN -notmatch '^[0-9]+$' -or $env:RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_SHA -notmatch '^[a-f0-9]{40}$') { throw 'Explicit provider candidate CI run and exact source SHA required' }
            if ($env:RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_SHA -cne $env:SDK_REF) { throw 'Provider candidate must match selected SDK source' }
          }
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: 777genius/agent_teams_orchestrator
          ref: ${{ inputs.sdk_ref }}
          path: TEST-native-sdk
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          package_json_file: TEST-native-source/package.json
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: TEST-native-source/.node-version
          cache: pnpm
          cache-dependency-path: TEST-native-source/pnpm-lock.yaml
      - name: Verify the pinned Node uses the native Windows architecture
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $nativeIdentity = node -p 'process.platform + "-" + process.arch'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $nativeIdentity -cne $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM) { throw 'Pinned Node native Windows architecture mismatch' }
      - name: Stage the selected Node in a fresh private TEST directory
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $source = (Get-Command node).Source
          $expected = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash
          $directory = Join-Path (Get-Location).Path 'TEST-controller-node'
          if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $directory) { throw 'TEST controller Node already exists' }
          $null = New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $directory -ErrorAction Stop
          $target = Join-Path $directory 'node.exe'
          [IO.File]::Copy($source, $target, $false)
          if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $source -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -cne $expected -or (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $target -Algorithm SHA256).Hash -cne $expected) { throw 'TEST controller Node bytes changed' }
          "OPENCODE_NATIVE_TEST_NODE_PATH=$target" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
      - name: Verify literal TEST commands in real Windows shells before SDK installation
        if: ${{ !inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          node scripts/e2e/opencode-native-windows-command.ts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'TEST verifier command syntax failed before SDK installation; no model task submitted' }
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        with:
          bun-version: '1.4.3'
      - name: Resolve exact OpenCode CLI pins from the selected runtime registry
        id: opencode-pins
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.versions }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          # Neither tree is installed yet: a bare import must fail instead of auto-installing.
          $resolved = @(bun --no-install scripts/e2e/opencode-native-windows-pins.ts ../TEST-native-sdk $env:VERSIONS $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM)
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'OpenCode pin resolution from the selected runtime failed' }
          $resolved | Write-Output
          $resolved | Out-File $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Append -Encoding utf8
      - name: Compare verified Windows V1 provider behavior without inference
        if: ${{ inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_RUN: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_run }}
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_sha }}
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_BUN_VERSION: '1.4.3'
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $comparisonRoot = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP ("TEST-opencode-provider-" + $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID + '-' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N'))
          New-Item -ItemType Directory $comparisonRoot | Out-Null
          $originalLock = Get-Content runtime.lock.json -Raw
          try {
            $lock = $originalLock | ConvertFrom-Json
            $lock.version = '0.0.118'
            $lock.releaseTag = 'runtime-v0.0.118'
            $lock.assets.'win32-x64'.file = 'agent-teams-runtime-win32-x64-v0.0.118.zip'
            $lock.assets.'win32-x64'.sha256 = 'f664938c6194dd2b9e08c6ba850a83cfbb7361809b11f855562bb03b5bb69d2d'
            $lock | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content runtime.lock.json -Encoding utf8NoBOM
            node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform win32-x64
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Verified 118 staging failed' }
            Move-Item resources/runtime (Join-Path $comparisonRoot 'runtime118')
            New-Item -ItemType Directory resources/runtime | Out-Null
            node scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/stage-candidate.mjs
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Verified candidate staging failed' }
            $candidate = Get-Content runtime-candidate-evidence.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
            if ($candidate.runId -cne $env:RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_RUN -or $candidate.sourceSha -cne $env:RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_SHA) { throw 'Explicit candidate selection changed' }
            Move-Item resources/runtime (Join-Path $comparisonRoot 'candidate')
            $npmRoot = Join-Path $comparisonRoot 'npm'
            # The staging calls that need the dispatch token are done; third-party
            # install scripts must never run with it in their environment.
            Remove-Item Env:GH_TOKEN -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            npm install --global --prefix $npmRoot --no-audit --no-fund opencode-ai@1.18.31
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Official npm V1 install failed' }
            $npmLockPath = Join-Path $npmRoot 'node_modules/.package-lock.json'
            if (!(Test-Path $npmLockPath -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Official npm install lock missing; integrity unverifiable' }
            $npmLock = Get-Content $npmLockPath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
            $wrapper = $npmLock.packages.'node_modules/opencode-ai'
            $native = @($npmLock.packages.PSObject.Properties | Where-Object { $_.Name -cin @('node_modules/opencode-windows-x64', 'node_modules/opencode-ai/node_modules/opencode-windows-x64') })
            if ($wrapper.version -cne '1.18.31' -or $wrapper.integrity -cne 'sha512-J95feefeWwtIaw3irx76WjzWcgQXxmuHmDVphvs5ep9X30fBJ6T6bFhw50i9Kx50MG/xPn5w2pafXIfNtdry9w==') { throw 'Official npm wrapper integrity changed' }
            if ($native.Count -ne 1 -or $native[0].Value.version -cne '1.18.31' -or $native[0].Value.integrity -cne 'sha512-1Za7uKeGLonNUkUIGHD7xfV5omi7ju/7z2WYfS5YvDLTr1iU/W1PPVHzHXiwiyV4gMxsWGwHHLubWdH99D7pSA==') { throw 'Official npm native integrity changed' }
            $baseline = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $comparisonRoot 'runtime118/claude-multimodel.exe')).Path
            $candidateBinary = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $comparisonRoot 'candidate/claude-multimodel.exe')).Path
            $official = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $npmRoot 'opencode.cmd')).Path
            node ../TEST-native-sdk/scripts/opencode-v1-provider-regression.ts $comparisonRoot $official $candidateBinary $baseline
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Real V1 provider comparison failed; inspect finite receipt' }
          } finally { Set-Content runtime.lock.json $originalLock -Encoding utf8NoBOM }
      - name: Preserve finite V1 provider comparison
        if: ${{ always() && inputs.provider_only }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-v1-provider-comparison-${{ github.sha }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-opencode-provider-*/baseline-summary.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-opencode-provider-*/candidate-summary.json
            TEST-native-source/runtime-candidate-evidence.json
      - name: Seed private runner-local TEST provider auth
        if: ${{ !inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only }}
        env:
          OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
        run: node scripts/e2e/opencode-native-test-auth.ts --seed-openrouter
      - name: Restore frozen SDK package downloads
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        id: sdk-download-cache
        uses: actions/cache/restore@v5
        with:
          path: TEST-bun-download-cache
          key: opencode-sdk-downloads-v1-${{ runner.os }}-${{ runner.arch }}-bun-1.4.3-${{ hashFiles('TEST-native-sdk/bun.lock', 'TEST-native-sdk/package.json') }}
      - name: Install the selected SDK
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        working-directory: TEST-native-sdk
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SDK_REF: ${{ inputs.sdk_ref }}
          VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.versions }}
          BUN_INSTALL_CACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/TEST-bun-download-cache
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if ((git rev-parse HEAD) -ne $env:SDK_REF) { throw 'SDK checkout identity mismatch' }
          # Match portable runtime staging's private copies, including cached downloads.
          bun install --frozen-lockfile --linker hoisted --backend=copyfile
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'SDK install failed' }
          bun test src/services/opencode/execution/OpenCodeV2AdmissionService.test.ts -t 'host filesystem'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows admission journal filesystem regression failed' }
          if ($env:VERSIONS -ne 'v1') {
            bun test src/cli/runtimeTranscriptCommand.test.ts
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Real transcript CLI entry and exit contract failed' }
          }
      - name: Save frozen SDK package downloads before E2E
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only && steps.sdk-download-cache.outputs.cache-hit != 'true' }}
        uses: actions/cache/save@v5
        with:
          path: TEST-bun-download-cache
          key: ${{ steps.sdk-download-cache.outputs.cache-primary-key }}
      - name: Install exact official OpenCode CLI pins
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.versions }}
          SHORT_TASKS: ${{ inputs.short_tasks }}
          V1_PIN: ${{ steps.opencode-pins.outputs.v1 }}
          CURRENT_PIN: ${{ steps.opencode-pins.outputs.current }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          foreach ($pin in @(@('v1', 'opencode-windows-x64', $env:V1_PIN), @('current', "@opencode/cli-windows-$($env:NATIVE_ARCH)", $env:CURRENT_PIN))) {
            if ($env:VERSIONS -eq 'v1' -and $pin[0] -ne 'v1') { continue }
            if ($env:VERSIONS -eq 'current' -and $pin[0] -ne 'current') { continue }
            if (!$pin[2]) { throw "Resolved $($pin[0]) CLI pin missing" }
            npm install --prefix "TEST-pins/$($pin[0])" --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund "$($pin[1])@$($pin[2])"
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Pinned CLI install failed' }
          }
      - name: Stage the real desktop console wrapper before binary projection
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        run: node scripts/stage-opencode-console-wrapper.mjs --platform $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM --require
      - name: Install frozen desktop dependencies and build only the real controller
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: ${{ inputs.source_only && 'node-ci' || 'desktop' }}
          # Source controller packages need the same private-copy shape as portable staging.
          pnpm_config_package_import_method: copy
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Desktop install failed' }
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-controller build
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Controller build failed' }
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'MCP build failed' }
      - name: Verify real Windows process identity readers before packaging
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          pnpm exec vitest run test/main/utils/windowsProcessProbe.integration.test.ts --reporter=verbose
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows process identity probe failed before packaging; no model task submitted' }
          pnpm exec vitest run test/scripts/opencodeNativeWindowsCandidate.test.ts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Candidate split delivery regression failed before packaging; no model task submitted' }
          pnpm exec vitest run test/scripts/opencodeNativeCommandMatch.test.ts test/scripts/opencodeNativeV2Transcript.test.ts test/main/services/team/OpenCodeNativeTeamPort.test.ts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Strict native command evidence regression failed before packaging; no model task submitted' }
      - name: Qualify TEST Node staging on Windows
        if: ${{ inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only && inputs.versions != 'v1' }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          pnpm exec vitest run test/scripts/opencodeNativeTestNode.test.ts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'TEST Node staging custody failed' }
      - name: Preflight real native startup and physical stop without model prompts
        if: ${{ !inputs.provider_only && inputs.versions != 'v1' }}
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SELECTED_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
          CURRENT_PIN: ${{ steps.opencode-pins.outputs.current }}
        run: |
          $current = (Resolve-Path "TEST-pins/current/node_modules/@opencode/cli-windows-$($env:NATIVE_ARCH)/bin/opencode.exe").Path
          $node = $env:OPENCODE_NATIVE_TEST_NODE_PATH
          bun scripts/e2e/opencode-native-windows-preflight.ts ../TEST-native-sdk $current $env:SELECTED_MODEL $node $env:CURRENT_PIN
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Source gate failed before packaging; no model tasks submitted' }
      - name: Select Windows release compiler Bun
        if: ${{ !inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only }}
        uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@v2
        with:
          bun-version: '1.4.2'
      - name: Build and stage the verified runtime candidate
        if: ${{ !inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only }}
        working-directory: TEST-native-sdk
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SDK_REF: ${{ inputs.sdk_ref }}
          CANDIDATE_PLATFORM: win32-${{ inputs.arch || 'x64' }}
          CANDIDATE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.sdk_ref }}
          VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.versions }}
          CANDIDATE_OPENCODE_V2_CONTRACT: ${{ steps.opencode-pins.outputs.contract }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          bun scripts/package-runtime.ts --platform $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Runtime candidate build failed' }
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force candidate/runtime | Out-Null
          Copy-Item dist/cli.exe candidate/runtime/claude-multimodel.exe
          foreach ($name in @('cursor-managed', 'local-cli', 'bun')) { Copy-Item "dist/$name" "candidate/runtime/$name" -Recurse }
          bun scripts/ci/verify-packaged-delivery.ts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Physical delivery identity failed' }
          if ($env:VERSIONS -eq 'v1') {
            # Legacy V1 SDKs predate emitted V2 delivery metadata and its registry.
            Set-Content candidate/runtime/COMMIT_SHA $env:SDK_REF
            Set-Content candidate/runtime/VERSION (Get-Content package.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).version
            if (Test-Path dist/opencode-delivery.json) { Copy-Item dist/opencode-delivery.json candidate/runtime/opencode-delivery.json }
          } else {
            foreach ($name in @('COMMIT_SHA', 'VERSION', 'opencode-delivery.json', 'opencode-v2-delivery.json')) { Copy-Item "dist/$name" "candidate/runtime/$name" }
          }
          Compress-Archive candidate/runtime "candidate/TEST-runtime-$($env:NATIVE_PLATFORM).zip"
          Push-Location ../TEST-native-source
          try {
            bun --no-install scripts/e2e/opencode-native-windows-candidate.ts ../TEST-native-sdk $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM $env:SDK_REF $env:VERSIONS
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Candidate split delivery lock staging failed' }
          } finally { Pop-Location }
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ../TEST-native-source/resources | Out-Null
          if (Test-Path ../TEST-native-source/resources/runtime/claude-multimodel.exe) { throw 'Unexpected preexisting runtime' }
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force ../TEST-native-source/resources/runtime | Out-Null
          Copy-Item candidate/runtime/* ../TEST-native-source/resources/runtime -Recurse -Force
      - name: Install and package the desktop app
        if: ${{ !inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY: 'false'
        run: |
          node scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Terminal staging failed' }
          pnpm build
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Desktop build failed' }
          pnpm "pack:win:$($env:NATIVE_ARCH)" --dir --publish never
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Desktop package failed' }
          node scripts/electron-builder/verifyBundle.cjs $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY win32 $env:NATIVE_ARCH
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Desktop native architecture failed' }
      - name: Verify retained candidate bytes and record post-pack manifest
        if: ${{ !inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only }}
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SDK_REF: ${{ inputs.sdk_ref }}
          VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.versions }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          # Apply the existing afterPack pruning policy to the independent candidate.
          # Retained expected bytes still originate from the SDK build, not the app.
          New-Item -ItemType Directory ../TEST-native-sdk/candidate/resources | Out-Null
          Move-Item ../TEST-native-sdk/candidate/runtime ../TEST-native-sdk/candidate/resources/runtime
          node -e "(async () => { const p = require('./scripts/electron-builder/afterPack.cjs')._internal; const root = require('node:path').resolve('../TEST-native-sdk/candidate'); await p.pruneKnownIncompatibleNativeArtifacts(root, 'win32', process.env.NATIVE_ARCH); await p.pruneNodePtyArtifacts(root, 'win32', process.env.NATIVE_ARCH); })().catch(() => process.exit(1))"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Candidate pruning qualification failed' }
          $candidateRoot = (Resolve-Path ../TEST-native-sdk/candidate/resources/runtime).Path
          $packagedRoot = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY resources/runtime)).Path
          $required = @('claude-multimodel.exe', 'COMMIT_SHA', 'VERSION', 'bun/bun.exe', 'local-cli/cli.js')
          if ($env:VERSIONS -ne 'v1') { $required += @('opencode-delivery.json', 'opencode-v2-delivery.json') }
          foreach ($relative in $required) {
            if (!(Test-Path (Join-Path $candidateRoot $relative) -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Required candidate component missing: $relative" }
          }
          if ((Get-Content (Join-Path $candidateRoot 'COMMIT_SHA') -Raw).Trim() -ne $env:SDK_REF) { throw 'Candidate commit identity mismatch' }
          $candidateEntries = @(Get-ChildItem $candidateRoot -Recurse -Force)
          if ($candidateEntries | Where-Object { $_.Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint }) { throw 'Candidate link forbidden' }
          $digests = [ordered]@{}
          # builder-util copyDir omits these two metadata names before extraResources copying.
          $candidateEntries | Where-Object { !$_.PSIsContainer -and $_.Name -cnotin @('.gitkeep', '.DS_Store') } | Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object {
            $relative = [System.IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($candidateRoot, $_.FullName).Replace([char]92, [char]47)
            $expectedHash = (Get-FileHash $_.FullName -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
            $delivered = Join-Path $packagedRoot $relative
            if (!(Test-Path $delivered -PathType Leaf) -or ((Get-Item $delivered).Attributes -band [IO.FileAttributes]::ReparsePoint)) { throw "Retained candidate component missing: $relative" }
            if ((Get-FileHash $delivered -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne $expectedHash) { throw "Packaged candidate bytes changed: $relative" }
            $digests[$relative] = $expectedHash
          }
          $manifest = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'TEST-opencode-runtime-manifest.json'
          $candidateEvidence = Get-Content runtime-native-candidate-evidence.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $candidateEvidence | Add-Member -NotePropertyName files -NotePropertyValue $digests
          $candidateEvidence | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content $manifest -Encoding utf8NoBOM
          "OPENCODE_NATIVE_EXPECTED_RUNTIME_MANIFEST=$manifest" | Out-File $env:GITHUB_ENV -Append -Encoding utf8
      - name: Real V1 and V2 tasks through the bundled runtime
        if: ${{ !inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only }}
        id: real_tasks
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          SELECTED_MODEL: ${{ inputs.model }}
          VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.versions }}
          SHORT_TASKS: ${{ inputs.short_tasks }}
          V1_PIN: ${{ steps.opencode-pins.outputs.v1 }}
          CURRENT_PIN: ${{ steps.opencode-pins.outputs.current }}
          OPENCODE_NATIVE_DIAGNOSTIC_SDK_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/TEST-native-sdk
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $env:TEMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TMPDIR = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $app = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY AgentTeamsAI.exe)).Path
          if ($env:VERSIONS -ne 'v1') {
            $delivery = Get-Content ../TEST-native-sdk/dist/opencode-v2-delivery.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
            $env:OPENCODE_NATIVE_CANDIDATE_SUPPORT_ARCHIVE = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path ../TEST-native-sdk/dist $delivery.archive.file)).Path
          }
          $failedPins = @()
          foreach ($pin in @(@('v1', 'opencode-windows-x64', $env:V1_PIN), @('current', "@opencode/cli-windows-$($env:NATIVE_ARCH)", $env:CURRENT_PIN))) {
            if ($env:VERSIONS -eq 'v1' -and $pin[0] -ne 'v1') { continue }
            if ($env:VERSIONS -eq 'current' -and $pin[0] -ne 'current') { continue }
            if (!$pin[2]) { throw "Resolved $($pin[0]) CLI pin missing" }
            $binary = (Resolve-Path "TEST-pins/$($pin[0])/node_modules/$($pin[1])/bin/opencode.exe").Path
            $versionOutput = (& $binary --version).Trim()
            $versionExit = $LASTEXITCODE
            $version = $versionOutput -replace '^opencode\s*v?\s*', ''
            if ($versionExit -ne 0 -or $version -ne $pin[2]) { throw 'Selected CLI version mismatch' }
            $scenario = @()
            if ($env:SHORT_TASKS -eq 'true') { $scenario = @('--short') }
            pnpm exec tsx scripts/e2e/opencode-native-windows-full.ts $app bundled $binary $env:SELECTED_MODEL $env:OPENCODE_NATIVE_E2E_AUTH_FILE @scenario
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { $failedPins += $pin[0] }
          }
          if ($failedPins.Count -gt 0) { throw ('Real Windows task scenarios failed: ' + ($failedPins -join ',') + '; no automatic replay') }
      - name: Preserve only sanitized scenario proofs
        if: ${{ always() && !inputs.source_only && !inputs.provider_only && steps.real_tasks.outcome != 'skipped' && steps.real_tasks.outcome != '' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: opencode-native-windows-${{ inputs.arch || 'x64' }}-proof-${{ github.sha }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-oc-*/proof.json
            TEST-native-source/runtime-native-candidate-evidence.json

name: OpenCode packaged Windows E2E

on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      native_arch:
        type: string
        default: x64
      v2_support_repair:
        type: boolean
        default: false
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      native_arch:
        description: Native Windows architecture; ARM64 qualifies V2 only
        type: choice
        options: [x64, arm64]
        default: x64
      v2_support_repair:
        description: Qualify published V2 fresh install, warm starts and support-only repair; no candidate fixture
        type: boolean
        default: false
      native_sdk_ref:
        description: 'Exact reviewed SDK SHA required for native tasks, source-only and provider-only; empty with both flags off keeps diagnostics'
        type: string
        default: ''
      native_model:
        description: 'Explicit openrouter/provider-model required for native tasks and source-only startup; it must be in the newest V2 catalog; unused for provider-only'
        type: string
        default: ''
      native_versions:
        description: 'Run the newest V2 only, V1 and the newest V2, or V1 only; reuse compatible completed proofs'
        type: choice
        options: [current, all, v1]
        default: current
      native_provider_only:
        description: Compare verified published V1 provider commands only; no native startup or packaging
        type: boolean
        default: false
      native_source_only:
        description: 'Requires native_sdk_ref and native_model; real startup/stop only, no packaging or model prompts'
        type: boolean
        default: false
      runtime_candidate_run:
        description: 'Optional runtime CI run with a successful complete Windows packaged-delivery job'
        type: string
        default: ''
      runtime_candidate_sha:
        description: 'Exact runtime source SHA (required with candidate run)'
        type: string
        default: ''
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, converted_to_draft]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/opencode-packaged-e2e.yml
      # Focused source changes requiring installed-app provider compatibility proof.
      # Explicit project-scoped provider preflight must pass installed-app E2E.
      - src/main/services/infrastructure/CliInstallerService.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/core/domain/openCodeProviderCompatibility.ts
      - src/features/runtime-provider-management/renderer/ui/OpenCodeProviderCompatibilityStatus.tsx
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/packaged*.mjs
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/v2-support-repair*.mjs
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/stage-candidate*.mjs
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/run-packaged.mjs
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/selected-identity-diagnostic.mts
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/native-test-pin.mts
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/selected-identity-diagnostic.tsconfig.json
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics-desktop.mjs
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/platform.mjs
      - scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/catalog.mjs
      - runtime.lock.json
      - scripts/stage-runtime.mjs
      - scripts/lib/github-release-download-error.mjs
      - scripts/lib/runtime-archive-checksum.mjs
      - scripts/lib/runtime-payload-cache.mjs
      - scripts/lib/runtime-payload-inventory.mts
      - scripts/lib/runtime-windows-zip-extraction.mts
      - scripts/lib/runtime-windows-zip-extraction.test.mts
      - scripts/lib/runtime-archive-extraction.mts

permissions:
  contents: read

# Called by the V2 wrapper. Workflow-level concurrency would inherit the
# caller's workflow identity and could cancel/block its own parent.
# The packaged job retains isolated V1/V2 PR supersession below.

jobs:
  validate-native-inputs:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (inputs.native_sdk_ref != '' || inputs.native_source_only || inputs.native_provider_only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 1
    steps:
      - name: Require exact native dispatch inputs before Windows allocation
        shell: bash
        env:
          SDK_REF: ${{ inputs.native_sdk_ref }}
          SELECTED_MODEL: ${{ inputs.native_model }}
          PROVIDER_ONLY: ${{ inputs.native_provider_only }}
          VERSIONS: ${{ inputs.native_versions }}
          V2_SUPPORT_REPAIR: ${{ inputs.v2_support_repair }}
        run: |
          if [[ "$V2_SUPPORT_REPAIR" == 'true' ]]; then
            echo '::error::Published V2 support repair cannot be combined with native SDK, source-only or provider-only scenarios'
            exit 1
          fi
          case "$VERSIONS" in
            all|v1|current) ;;
            *) echo '::error::Unknown Windows version selection'; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          if [[ ! "$SDK_REF" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo '::error::native_sdk_ref must be an exact reviewed SDK SHA for native, source-only and provider-only runs'
            exit 1
          fi
          if [[ "$PROVIDER_ONLY" != 'true' && ! "$SELECTED_MODEL" =~ ^openrouter/[a-zA-Z0-9_./:~-]+$ ]]; then
            echo '::error::native_model is required for native and source-only startup; source-only submits no model prompts'
            exit 1
          fi
  native-real-tasks:
    needs: validate-native-inputs
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && (inputs.native_sdk_ref != '' || inputs.native_source_only || inputs.native_provider_only)
    uses: ./.github/workflows/opencode-native-windows-e2e.yml
    with:
      arch: ${{ inputs.native_arch }}
      sdk_ref: ${{ inputs.native_sdk_ref }}
      model: ${{ inputs.native_model }}
      source_only: ${{ inputs.native_source_only }}
      provider_only: ${{ inputs.native_provider_only }}
      versions: ${{ inputs.native_versions }}
      runtime_candidate_run: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_run }}
      runtime_candidate_sha: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_sha }}
    secrets:
      RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
      OPENROUTER_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}
  packaged-windows:
    if: (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true) && inputs.native_sdk_ref == '' && !inputs.native_source_only && !inputs.native_provider_only
    # Distinct from the outer workflow's group; never self-cancel the caller.
    concurrency:
      group: opencode-packaged-job-${{ inputs.v2_support_repair && 'v2' || 'v1' }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || github.run_id }}
      cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}
    runs-on: ${{ inputs.native_arch == 'arm64' && 'windows-11-arm' || 'windows-latest' }}
    env:
      NATIVE_ARCH: ${{ inputs.native_arch || 'x64' }}
      NATIVE_PLATFORM: win32-${{ inputs.native_arch || 'x64' }}
      NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY: ${{ inputs.native_arch == 'arm64' && 'release/win-arm64-unpacked' || 'release/win-unpacked' }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Enable long paths
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Validate native packaged qualification inputs
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          V2_SUPPORT_REPAIR: ${{ inputs.v2_support_repair }}
          CANDIDATE_RUN: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_run }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_sha }}
        run: |
          $nativeIdentity = node -p 'process.platform + "-" + process.arch'
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $nativeIdentity -cne $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM) { throw 'Pinned Node native Windows architecture mismatch' }
          if ($env:NATIVE_ARCH -eq 'arm64' -and $env:V2_SUPPORT_REPAIR -ne 'true') { throw 'ARM64 published diagnostics require explicit V2 support repair qualification' }
          if (($env:NATIVE_ARCH -eq 'arm64' -or $env:V2_SUPPORT_REPAIR -eq 'true') -and ($env:CANDIDATE_RUN -or $env:CANDIDATE_SHA)) { throw 'ARM64 candidate teams use the native SDK workflow; published diagnostics accept no candidate fixture' }
      - uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Verify harness contracts
        run: node --test scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/platform.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/packaged.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/catalog.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/stage-candidate.test.mjs scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/v2-support-repair.test.mjs
      - name: Typecheck admission diagnostic
        run: node node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/selected-identity-diagnostic.tsconfig.json
      - name: Stage pinned runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM
      - name: Stage verified test-only runtime candidate
        if: inputs.runtime_candidate_run != '' || inputs.runtime_candidate_sha != ''
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_RUN: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_run }}
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_sha }}
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_BUN_VERSION: '1.4.3'
        run: node scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/stage-candidate.mjs
      - name: Stage pinned terminal runtime
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM
      - name: Build application
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: --max-old-space-size=8192
        run: pnpm build
      - name: Stage native OpenCode wrapper
        run: node scripts/stage-opencode-console-wrapper.mjs --platform $env:NATIVE_PLATFORM --require
      - name: Verify wrapper native handle and job isolation
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $compiler = Join-Path $env:SystemRoot 'Microsoft.NET/Framework64/v4.0.30319/csc.exe'
          $fixture = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'TEST-wrapper-native-fixture.exe'
          $fixtureSource = (Resolve-Path 'tools/opencode-console-wrapper/WrapperNativeFixture.cs').Path
          & $compiler /nologo /target:exe /optimize "/out:$fixture" $fixtureSource
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native wrapper fixture compilation failed' }
          & $fixture (Resolve-Path resources/runtime/opencode-console/opencode.exe).Path
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Native wrapper handle/job isolation failed' }
      - name: Package without publishing
        run: pnpm "pack:win:$($env:NATIVE_ARCH)" --dir --publish never
      - name: Verify packaged candidate identity
        if: inputs.runtime_candidate_run != ''
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $candidate = Get-Content runtime-candidate-evidence.json | ConvertFrom-Json
          $env:PACKAGED_CANDIDATE_ROOT = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY resources/runtime)).Path
          node --input-type=module -e "import {readFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; import {verifyCandidatePayload} from './scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/stage-candidate.mjs'; await verifyCandidatePayload(process.env.PACKAGED_CANDIDATE_ROOT, JSON.parse(await readFile('runtime-candidate-evidence.json','utf8')), {packaged:true});"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Validate bundle
        run: node scripts/electron-builder/verifyBundle.cjs $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY win32 $env:NATIVE_ARCH
      - name: Prove compiled legacy Windows saved-file read and native image on loopback model
        if: inputs.runtime_candidate_run != ''
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:TMPDIR = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TEMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $executable = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY AgentTeamsAI.exe)).Path
          $candidate = (Resolve-Path 'runtime-candidate-evidence.json').Path
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/windows-attachments.mts $executable $candidate
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
      - name: Qualify cold and warm packaged starts
        id: qualify
        env:
          RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_RUN: ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_run }}
          V2_SUPPORT_REPAIR: ${{ inputs.v2_support_repair }}
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $env:TMPDIR = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TEMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $env:TMP = $env:RUNNER_TEMP
          $executable = (Resolve-Path (Join-Path $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY AgentTeamsAI.exe)).Path
          $runtimeSetup = if ($env:V2_SUPPORT_REPAIR -eq 'true') { 'app-install-v2-repair' } else { 'app-install' }
          $options = @('--packaged-executable', $executable, '--runtime-setup', $runtimeSetup)
          if ($env:RUNTIME_CANDIDATE_RUN) { $options += @('--candidate-evidence', (Resolve-Path 'runtime-candidate-evidence.json').Path) }
          node scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/run-packaged.mjs @options | Tee-Object -Variable qualificationOutput
          $qualificationExit = $LASTEXITCODE
          $roots = @($qualificationOutput | Where-Object { $_ -match '^Packaged artifacts/profile: ' })
          if ($roots.Count -eq 1) { "root=$($roots[0].Substring('Packaged artifacts/profile: '.Length))" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT -Encoding utf8 -Append }
          if ($qualificationExit -ne 0) { exit $qualificationExit }
      - name: Checkout exact SDK admission source
        id: sdk_source
        if: always() && failure() && steps.qualify.outcome == 'failure'
        continue-on-error: true
        timeout-minutes: 5
        env:
          GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '1'
          GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
          GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          repository: 777genius/agent_teams_orchestrator
          ref: d6361e0f50821ffc31cc5a9efd0dcaf6643c850d
          token: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          path: .test-tmp/sdk-admission
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 1
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            src/services/opencode/OpenCodeBinaryResolver.ts
            src/services/opencode/OpenCodeCursorAgentTreeKill.ts
            src/services/opencode/compatibility/OpenCodeGenerationPolicy.ts
            src/services/opencode/compatibility/OpenCodeNativeIdentity.ts
            src/services/opencode/compatibility/OpenCodeVersionProbe.ts
            src/services/opencode/profile/OpenCodeV2ManagedConfig.ts
            src/services/opencode/transport/OpenCodeBoundedFetch.ts
            src/utils/portableCli.ts
            src/utils/processKill.ts
      - name: Record selected identity admission failure evidence
        if: always() && failure() && steps.qualify.outcome == 'failure'
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          QUALIFICATION_ROOT: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.root }}
          SDK_CHECKOUT_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.sdk_source.outcome }}
        run: |
          $sdk = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE '.test-tmp/sdk-admission'
          $packaged = Join-Path $env:GITHUB_WORKSPACE $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY
          $bun = Join-Path $packaged 'resources/runtime/bun/bun.exe'
          $receipt = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'selected-identity-diagnostic.json'
          if (!(Test-Path $bun)) {
            '{"schemaVersion":1,"outcome":"NOT_RUN","phase":"packaged_bun_missing","admissionCalls":0,"physicalRetirement":"unproven"}' | Set-Content $receipt -Encoding utf8
          } else {
            '{"schemaVersion":1,"outcome":"NOT_RUN","phase":"process_start","admissionCalls":0,"physicalRetirement":"unproven"}' | Set-Content $receipt -Encoding utf8
            & $bun --no-install scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/selected-identity-diagnostic.mts $sdk "$env:QUALIFICATION_ROOT" $packaged $receipt
            if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
          }
      - name: Archive qualified Windows test build
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $archive = "AgentTeamsAI-windows-test-$env:GITHUB_SHA.zip"
          Compress-Archive -Path $env:NATIVE_APP_DIRECTORY -DestinationPath "release/$archive"
          $digest = (Get-FileHash "release/$archive" -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          "$digest  $archive" | Set-Content release/test-build-SHA256SUMS.txt
          @"
          Windows test build, not an installer or an updater release.
          Source commit: $env:GITHUB_SHA
          Runtime payload version: $((Get-Content runtime.lock.json | ConvertFrom-Json).version)
          Runtime candidate source (empty for published pin): ${{ inputs.runtime_candidate_sha }}
          If a candidate source is present this is an unreleased test runtime. See runtime-candidate-evidence.json.
          Extract the ZIP. Do not launch AgentTeamsAI.exe directly with your everyday profile.
          Use the separate disposable-profile instructions supplied with this test build.
          Do not launch teams in real projects.
          Qualification reports and screenshots are in opencode-packaged-windows-$env:GITHUB_SHA.
          "@ | Set-Content release/test-build-README.txt
      - name: Preserve qualified Windows test build
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: opencode-windows-test-build-${{ github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          path: |
            release/AgentTeamsAI-windows-test-*.zip
            release/test-build-SHA256SUMS.txt
            release/test-build-README.txt
            runtime-candidate-evidence.json
      - name: Preserve qualification evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: opencode-packaged-windows-${{ github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/selected-identity-diagnostic.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/*.json
            scripts/e2e/opencode-diagnostics/windows-attachments.mts
            runtime-candidate-evidence.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/cold/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/cold/*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/cold/*.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/cold/*.ndjson
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/cold/desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/warm-*/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/warm-*/*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/warm-*/*.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/warm-*/*.ndjson
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/warm-*/desktop.log
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/support-repair*/*.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/support-repair*/*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/support-repair*/*.txt
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/support-repair*/*.ndjson
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-diagnostics-e2e-*/support-repair*/desktop.log

name: OpenCode V2 Stage1 static preflight (TEST only)

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    paths:
      # The preflight test reads the actual Stage1 runtime lock and builds
      # the pinned provider package; changing either must invalidate its proof.
      - runtime.lock.json
      - pnpm-lock.yaml
      # Root manifest/workspace membership and Host TS project files affect
      # this exact pinned install, build and source test, even without a lock change.
      - package.json
      - pnpm-workspace.yaml
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/package.json
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/tsconfig*.json
      # The job builds the full Host package and typechecks its TEST tree;
      # every Host source/test change invalidates the exact native proof.
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/src/**
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/**
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/native/**
      - packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/**
      - scripts/legacy-agent-host/**

      - scripts/lib/opencode-v2-base-inventory.mts
      - scripts/lib/runtime-archive-checksum.mjs
      - scripts/lib/runtime-payload-cache.mjs
      # Selection/update policy is tested with the same pinned Node/workspace.
      - src/features/opencode-runtime-installer/**
      - src/features/opencode-compatibility/**
      - src/main/services/infrastructure/openCode*.ts
      - src/main/services/runtime/openCode*.ts
      - src/main/services/infrastructure/OpenCodeRuntimeInstallerService.ts
      - src/main/services/infrastructure/openCodeRuntimePackageMetadata.ts
      - test/features/opencode-runtime-installer/**

concurrency:

  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  static-preflight:
    name: Static V01 source test (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-24.04, windows-2022]
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require immutable PR source HEAD
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_PR_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_PR_HEAD"
      # Read the actual moving Desktop product lock separately from this
      # historical Stage1 stacked checkout. The test requires both releases
      # to agree before returning even a static read-only candidate.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: main
          path: .current-product-lock
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: runtime.lock.json
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false
      - name: Record exact current product commit
        shell: bash
        run: git -C .current-product-lock rev-parse HEAD
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prove retry classification on the exact source HEAD
        run: node --test test/scripts/installDependenciesWithRetry.test.mjs
      - name: Install pinned workspace dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build Stage1 Host without launching providers
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Typecheck Host TEST contracts
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host typecheck:test
      - name: Verify captured and native model variants through Host SPI
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-model-variant.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-model-variant-spi.test.ts
      - name: Verify generation-preserving install and update policy
        run: pnpm exec vitest run test/features/opencode-runtime-installer/installPolicy.test.ts test/main/services/infrastructure/OpenCodeRuntimeInstallerService.test.ts
      - name: Execute V2 static preflight, current-main lock and FIFO negatives
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_CURRENT_PRODUCT_LOCK: ${{ github.workspace }}/.current-product-lock/runtime.lock.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-static-preflight.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-static-capture.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-host-spi.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-receipt.test.mjs packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-process-guard.test.mjs packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-request-admission.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v1-version-receipt.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v1-version-source.test.ts
      - name: Native V1 baseline and latest Host compatibility (Linux TEST)
        if: matrix.os == 'ubuntu-24.04'
        timeout-minutes: 20
        env:
          OPENCODE_V1_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: desktop
          ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: ''
        run: |
          node scripts/postinstall-electron.cjs
          node packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v1-version-runner.ts
      - name: Preserve native V1 version evidence
        if: always() && matrix.os == 'ubuntu-24.04'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v1-version-host-linux
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: opencode-v1-version-evidence/*.json

  native-host-instructions:
    name: Native V2.0.21 Host SPI instructions (Ubuntu TEST only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      npm_config_audit: 'false'
      npm_config_fund: 'false'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require immutable PR native source HEAD
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_PR_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_PR_HEAD"
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install pinned Host workspace dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build Host V2 SPI with real pinned private driver
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Check native TEST proof syntax
        run: node --check packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-instructions.mjs
      - name: Test direct-shell HTTP mutation/no-replay diagnostic boundary
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-direct-shell-probe.test.mjs
      - name: Install exact official V2 CLI in isolated runner prefix, without scripts
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli"
          (cd "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli" && npm init -y)
          npm install --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli" --save-exact \
            --package-lock=true --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund @opencode/cli@2.0.21
          npm ls --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli" --depth=0 @opencode/cli
          test -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-host-cli/package-lock.json"
      - name: Confirm native ELF interruption and original process identity
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_NPM_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-host-cli/node_modules/@opencode
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-http-interrupt-negative.test.mjs
      - name: Exercise real pinned native server against existing Host Session SPI
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_NPM_ROOT: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-host-cli/node_modules/@opencode
          OPENCODE_V2_HOST_NATIVE_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-host-native-instructions.json
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-instructions.mjs
      # Passing the native runner alone is not evidence: a missing receipt must
      # fail this job even when the pinned npm lockfile still uploads successfully.
      # Keep the always() upload below for sanitized failure/HOLD artifacts.
      - name: Require complete native TEST receipt before success
        shell: bash
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s opencode-v2-host-native-instructions.json
          node packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-receipt-verify.mjs opencode-v2-host-native-instructions.json
      - name: Preserve exact native TEST proof or HOLD receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v2-stage1-host-native-instructions-ubuntu
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            opencode-v2-host-native-instructions.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-host-cli/package-lock.json

  published-v2-http-persist:
    name: Published V2.0.21 durable HTTP process (TEST discovery only)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 12
    env:
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      npm_config_audit: 'false'
      npm_config_fund: 'false'
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require immutable PR source HEAD
        shell: bash
        env:

        run: |

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6

          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install exact private Stage1 Session SPI dependencies
        env:
          AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci

      - name: Build isolated Stage1 V2 Session SPI for TEST-only HTTP proof
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build

        run: node --check packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-published-http-persist.mjs

        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-shell-flag-policy-probe.test.mjs

          npm ls --prefix "$RUNNER_TEMP/opencode-v2-http-test" --depth=0 @opencode/sdk
      - name: Negative valid-SDK post-copy cleanup cannot touch shared package prefix
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SDK_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-http-test

        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-http-setup-negative.test.mjs
      - name: Negative owned-worker cleanup on parent SIGINT and SIGTERM
        env:
