          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-http-interrupt-negative.test.mjs
      - name: Probe actual published server HTTP durable-log and cold restart
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SDK_PREFIX: ${{ runner.temp }}/opencode-v2-http-test
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          OPENCODE_V2_TEST_HTTP_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-http-persist.json
        run: node packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-published-http-persist.mjs
      - name: Require exact-HEAD TEST receipt (never a Host/model certificate)
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_PR_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -s opencode-v2-http-persist.json
          node --input-type=module -e "
            import fs from 'node:fs';
            const r=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('opencode-v2-http-persist.json','utf8'));
            if(r.sourceHead!==process.env.EXPECTED_PR_HEAD ||
               r.kind!=='TEST_V2_HTTP_DURABLE_DISCOVERY' || r.qualified!==false ||
               r.packagedElectronQualified!==false || r.modelTurnProven!==false ||
               r.processCustodyQualified!==false || r.cleanup!==true ||
               r.durableHTTPEvents!==1 || r.hostSpiReadinessProven!==true ||
               r.nativeSessionPermissionOrderReadbackProven!==true ||
               r.nativeShellFlagPermissionSplitObserved!==true ||
               r.nativePermissionResolverProven!==true ||
               r.nativePermissionReplyRejectNoReplayProven!==true ||
               r.nativeSavedAlwaysOverridesAskProven!==true ||
               r.nativeExplicitDenyBeatsSavedAlwaysProven!==true ||
               r.nativeSavedGrantSurvivesColdRestartProven!==true ||
               r.nativeFreshSessionSavedGrantSurvivesColdRestartProven!==true ||
               r.nativeSavedGrantRemainsProjectScopedAfterRestartProven!==true ||
               r.nativeUnauthenticatedDeleteRejected!==true ||
               r.nativeUnauthenticatedPermissionGrantRejected!==true ||
               r.nativeStalePermissionAfterRestartRejected!==true ||
               r.nativeStaleGrantAfterRestartRejected!==true ||
               r.failure !== undefined) process.exit(1);
            // A fabricated six-element receipt is not a completed native proof.
            // Require each physical TEST stage in its original order.
            const requiredSteps=[
              'TEST_published_server_real_authenticated_HTTP_ready',
              'TEST_no_unauthenticated_HTTP_access',
              'TEST_native_shell_flag_permission_split_not_tool_enforcement',
              'TEST_native_unauthenticated_mutations_rejected',
              'TEST_published_native_permission_resolver_and_nonreplay',
              'TEST_real_pending_permission_exists_before_cold_restart',
              'TEST_official_HTTP_session_created_event_persisted',
              'TEST_cold_native_permission_not_replayed_or_accepted',
              'TEST_native_persisted_always_vs_deny_survives_cold_restart',
              'TEST_durable_HTTP_session_identity_survives_cold_restart_no_prompt',
              'TEST_real_published_HTTP_Stage1_SPI_ready_no_model_turn',
              'TEST_Stage1_SPI_readiness_recheck_and_owned_cleanup_no_replay',
            ];
            if(!Array.isArray(r.steps) || r.steps.length!==requiredSteps.length ||
               r.steps.some((step,index)=>step!==requiredSteps[index])) process.exit(1);
          "
      - name: Preserve TEST-only receipt on success or safe failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v2-published-http-persist-ubuntu
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: opencode-v2-http-persist.json

  embedded-v2-native-host:
    name: Embedded V2.1.4 original Host (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: ubuntu-24.04
            platform: linux-x64
            candidate-build: ''
          - os: macos-15
            platform: darwin-arm64
            candidate-build: 24H232
          - os: macos-15-intel
            platform: darwin-x64
            candidate-build: 24G830
          - os: windows-2022
            platform: win32-x64
            candidate-build: ''
          - os: windows-11-arm
            platform: win32-arm64
            candidate-build: ''
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
      ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD: '1'
      npm_config_audit: 'false'
      npm_config_fund: 'false'
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
      OPENCODE_V2_TEST_DARWIN_CANDIDATE_BUILD: ${{ matrix.candidate-build }}
      OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_INPUTS_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-embedded-inputs.json
      OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_DARWIN_CUSTODY_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-darwin-custody.json
      OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_WINDOWS_CUSTODY_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-windows-custody.json
      OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-embedded-host.json
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require immutable source HEAD and record actual runner tuple
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD"
          uname -sm
          if [ "$RUNNER_OS" = macOS ]; then /usr/sbin/sysctl -n kern.osversion; fi
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Install exact source workspace dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      - name: Build original Host and its pinned provider implementation
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      - name: Check original graph and custody boundaries
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-embedded-graph.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-build-selection.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-job-custody.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-native-paths.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/owner-scoped-backup.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/member-attachment-delivery.test.ts
      - name: Stage checksum-pinned base archive without executing the legacy CLI
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
      - name: Prepare exact Bun, engine graph and original-process artifact
        run: node --import tsx scripts/legacy-agent-host/prepare-opencode-v2-native.ts
      - name: Prove actual Darwin executable custody and adversarial cleanup
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_DARWIN_CUSTODY_GO: '1'
        run: node --experimental-test-module-mocks --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-executable.native.ts
      - name: Require complete Darwin evidence for this exact candidate or product tuple
        if: runner.os == 'macOS'
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e "
            import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
            import fs from 'node:fs';
            const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_DARWIN_CUSTODY_RECEIPT, 'utf8'));
            const candidate = process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED !== '1';
            assert.equal(r.kind, candidate ? 'TEST_DARWIN_CUSTODY_CANDIDATE' : 'TEST_DARWIN_CUSTODY_PRODUCT_PATH');
            assert.equal(r.sourceHead, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(r.platform + '-' + r.arch, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM);
            assert.equal(r.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(r.cleanup, 'confirmed');
            assert.equal(r.productQualified, false);
            assert.equal(r.replacementRefused, true);
            assert.equal(r.siblingSurvivedTargetStop, true);
            assert.equal(r.bunSha256, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_BUN_SHA256);
            assert.equal(r.processArtifactManifestSha256, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PROCESS_CUSTODY_MANIFEST_SHA256);
            assert.notEqual(r.original.startIdentity, r.sibling.startIdentity);
            if (candidate) assert.equal(r.osBuild, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_DARWIN_CANDIDATE_BUILD);
          "
      - name: Prove original Windows Job custody and surviving descendant cleanup
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_WINDOWS_CUSTODY_GO: '1'
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/windows-job-custody.native.ts
      - name: Require exact Windows original-process evidence
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e "
            import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
            import fs from 'node:fs';
            const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_WINDOWS_CUSTODY_RECEIPT, 'utf8'));
            assert.equal(r.kind, 'TEST_WINDOWS_ORIGINAL_JOB_CUSTODY');
            assert.equal(r.sourceHead, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(r.platform, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM);
            assert.equal(r.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0');
            assert.equal(r.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(r.cleanup, true);
            assert.equal(r.captureBeforeInput, true);
            assert.equal(r.descendantSurvivedRootExit, true);
            assert.equal(r.originalJobCleanup, 'confirmed');
            assert.equal(r.neighborSurvivedTargetStop, true);
            assert.equal(r.neighborJobCleanup, 'confirmed');
            assert.equal(r.bunSha256, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_BUN_SHA256);
            assert.equal(r.manifestSha256, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MANIFEST_SHA256);
            assert.equal(r.productQualified, false); assert.equal(r.desktopQualified, false);
          "
      - name: Check original Desktop private recipe composition
        if: env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1' && runner.os != 'Windows'
        run: node --test scripts/legacy-agent-host/desktop-opencode-v2-fixture.test.ts
      - name: Exercise native model, tool, MCP, approval, Stop and cold Host Resume
        if: env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_GO: '1'
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-embedded-host.native.ts
      - name: Exercise Windows automatic approval and cold Host Resume
        if: runner.os == 'Windows' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_APPROVAL_MODE: auto
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-embedded-host-auto.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-embedded-host.native.ts
      - name: Exercise native catalog and model probe without tool allocation
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_MODEL_PROBE_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_MODEL_PROBE_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-model-probe.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-model-probe.native.ts
      - name: Exercise native key connection, saved-key reuse and cold original-intent recovery
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_CREDENTIAL_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_CREDENTIAL_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-credentials.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-credentials.native.ts
      - name: Exercise effective permissions and active Stop with a surviving sibling
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_PERMISSION_LIFECYCLE_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_PERMISSION_LIFECYCLE_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-permission-lifecycle.json
        run: node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-permission-lifecycle.native.ts
      - name: Exercise captured external MCP and app-only through the native Host
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_CAPTURED_MCP_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_CAPTURED_MCP_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-captured-mcp.json
        run: |
          node --check packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/fixtures/native-opencode-v2-mcp/server.mjs
          node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/opencode-v2-captured-mcp.native.ts
      - name: Require complete native management and permission evidence
        if: runner.os == 'Linux' && env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED == '1'
        run: |
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          for (const [path, kind] of [
            ['opencode-v2-model-probe.json', 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_MODEL_PROBE'],
            ['opencode-v2-credentials.json', 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_CREDENTIAL'],
            ['opencode-v2-permission-lifecycle.json', 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_PERMISSION_LIFECYCLE'],
            ['opencode-v2-captured-mcp.json', 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_CAPTURED_MCP'],
          ]) {
            const receipt = JSON.parse(readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
            assert.equal(receipt.kind, kind);
            assert.equal(receipt.sourceHead, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(receipt.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(receipt.cleanup, true);
            assert.equal(receipt.digests.bun, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_BUN_SHA256);
            assert.equal(receipt.digests.manifest, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MANIFEST_SHA256);
            if (kind === 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_MODEL_PROBE') {
              assert.equal(receipt.configurationSource, 'global-symlink-project-regular');
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.requests, [
                { tools: 0, promptMatched: true, model: 'TEST-model', configScope: 'global' },
                { tools: 0, promptMatched: true, model: 'TEST-model-B', effort: 'high', configScope: 'project' },
                { tools: 0, promptMatched: true, model: 'TEST-model-B', effort: 'high', configScope: 'project' },
              ]);
              assert.ok(receipt.steps.includes('unlisted_variant_refused_without_model_request_and_owned_cleanup_confirmed'));
              assert.ok(receipt.steps.includes('published_global_and_project_sources_reached_native_body_headers_limits_and_default'));
            }
            if (kind === 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_CAPTURED_MCP') {
              assert.equal(receipt.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0');
              assert.equal(receipt.version, '2.1.4');
              assert.equal(receipt.manualPermissionBeforeEffect, true);
              assert.equal(receipt.excludedProcessStarts, 0);
              assert.equal(receipt.externalProcessStarts, 1);
              assert.equal(receipt.externalToolCalls, 1);
              assert.equal(receipt.externalProcessCloses, 1);
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.modelFailures, []);
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.modelRequests.map(row => [row.turn, row.step]), [
                ['ALLOW', 0], ['ALLOW', 1], ['ALLOW', 2], ['APP_ONLY', 0], ['APP_ONLY', 1],
              ]);
              assert.equal(receipt.modelRequests[0].tool, 'TEST_selected_write_marker');
              assert.ok(receipt.modelRequests.filter(row => row.tool?.endsWith('message_send')).length === 2);
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.steps, [
                'captured_allowlist_actual_tool_once_permission_original_result_and_cleanup',
                'app_only_has_no_external_tool_or_process_and_preserves_team_reply',
                'cold_original_receipts_and_readback_do_not_replay_native_or_external_tools',
              ]);
              assert.equal(receipt.hosts.length, 2);
              assert.ok(receipt.hosts.every(row => row.exitCode === 0 && row.signalCode === null && row.stdoutValid));
              assert.equal(receipt.vendorAuthQualified, false);
              assert.equal(receipt.desktopQualified, false);
              assert.equal(receipt.releaseQualified, false);
            }
            if (kind === 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_CREDENTIAL') {
              assert.equal(receipt.nativeCredentialCount, 3);
              assert.deepEqual(receipt.requests, ['refused', 'OK', 'OK', 'timeout'].map(outcome => ({
                authorizationMatched: true, tools: 0, promptMatched: true, outcome,
              })));
              for (const step of [
                'passive_all_provider_directory_without_import_or_inference',
                'native_key_one_verification_original_receipt_after_lost_ack',
                'native_401_saved_unverified_then_cold_explicit_corrected_key_succeeds',
                'runtime_source_revision_preserves_original_rejected_key_replacement_authority',
                'cold_directory_and_explicit_check_reuse_saved_selected_key',
                'cold_unverified_original_intent_blocks_changed_key_and_new_id_without_replay',
                'selected_native_db_only_foreign_auth_preserved_secret_free_receipts',
              ]) assert.ok(receipt.steps.includes(step));
              assert.equal(receipt.vendorAuthQualified, false);
            }
          }
          NODE
      - name: Require product-path Host proof after exact candidate qualification
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e "
            import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
            import fs from 'node:fs';
            assert.equal(process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_PRODUCT_ADMITTED, '1',
              'HOLD: candidate custody evidence is available; qualify only this exact tuple and rerun the unmodified product path');
            const receipts = [[process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST_RECEIPT, 'manual']];
            if (process.platform === 'win32') receipts.push(['opencode-v2-embedded-host-auto.json', 'auto']);
            for (const [path, mode] of receipts) {
            const r = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path, 'utf8'));
            assert.equal(r.kind, 'TEST_NATIVE_V2_EMBEDDED_HOST');
            assert.equal(r.sourceHead, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_SOURCE_HEAD);
            assert.equal(r.platform, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_TEST_PLATFORM);
            assert.equal(r.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(r.cleanup, true);
            assert.equal(r.nodeVersion, 'v24.21.0'); assert.equal(r.version, '2.1.4');
            assert.equal(r.approvalMode, mode); assert.equal(r.modelRequests, 11);
            assert.deepEqual(r.modelSelection,
              { providerId: 'TEST-local', modelId: 'TEST-model-B', variant: 'high' });
            assert.deepEqual(r.configurationSelection,
              { scope: 'project', original: 'project-A', later: 'project-B' });
            assert.deepEqual(r.preferencesSelection,
              { nativeDefault: 'TEST-local/TEST-model', appDefault: 'TEST-local/TEST-model-B' });
            assert.deepEqual(r.modelFailures, []);
            assert.equal(r.digests.bun, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_BUN_SHA256);
            assert.equal(r.digests.manifest, process.env.OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_MANIFEST_SHA256);
            const coordination = process.platform === 'linux' && process.arch === 'x64';
            if (coordination) {
              assert.equal(r.coordination.status, 'PASS'); assert.equal(r.coordination.cleanup, true);
            }
            assert.deepEqual(r.steps, [
              ...(coordination ? ['original_native_coordination_and_cleanup_before_business_host'] : []),
              'original_host_embedded_native_and_mcp_ready',
              'native_model_tool_effect_permission_mcp_task_and_reply_completed_once',
              'changed_project_config_did_not_retarget_running_native_session',
              'original_uploaded_PNG_native_image_inference_and_public_readback',
              'checkpoint_and_original_host_native_cleanup_confirmed',
              'cold_host_restored_native_history_without_model_or_tool_replay',
            ]);
            assert.equal(r.vendorAuthQualified, false);
            assert.equal(r.desktopQualified, false); assert.equal(r.releaseQualified, false);
            if (process.platform === 'win32') assert.match(r.digests.windowsShell, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
            }
          "
      - name: Observe POSIX original-path exec and explicit mutation counterexamples
        if: always() && runner.os != 'Windows'
        env:
          OPENCODE_V2_POSIX_EXEC_GO: '1'
          OPENCODE_V2_POSIX_EXEC_RECEIPT: ${{ github.workspace }}/opencode-v2-posix-exec.json
          # This independent TEST syscall proof admits no production tuple or module mock.
          OPENCODE_V2_EMBEDDED_DARWIN_CANDIDATE_BUILD: ''
        run: node --test --test-name-pattern='^POSIX original-path' packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-executable.native.ts
      - name: Preserve exact native evidence or candidate HOLD
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: opencode-v2-embedded-native-${{ matrix.platform }}
          retention-days: 7
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            opencode-v2-embedded-inputs.json
            opencode-v2-darwin-custody.json
            opencode-v2-windows-custody.json
            opencode-v2-embedded-host.json
            opencode-v2-embedded-host-auto.json
            opencode-v2-model-probe.json
            opencode-v2-credentials.json
            opencode-v2-permission-lifecycle.json
            opencode-v2-captured-mcp.json
            opencode-v2-posix-exec.json

name: Prepare immutable Windows native updater inputs

on:

      - name: Install genuine OpenCode V1 in runner-owned scratch
        shell: bash
        run: |
          # npm 11/12 blocks dependency postinstall by default. Permit only this
          # reviewed, pinned public V1 package inside the disposable test prefix.
          node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); const dir = path.join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'real-opencode-v1'); fs.mkdirSync(dir, {recursive:true}); fs.writeFileSync(path.join(dir, 'package.json'), JSON.stringify({name:'agent-teams-test-opencode',private:true,version:'1.0.0',allowScripts:{'opencode-ai@1.18.31':true}}));"

          # source of a provider-status probe failure. Never fall back silently.
          node -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const path = require('node:path'); const root = path.join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, 'real-opencode-v1', 'node_modules'); const win = process.platform === 'win32'; const binary = win ? path.join(root, 'opencode-windows-x64', 'bin', 'opencode.exe') : path.join(root, '.bin', 'opencode'); if (win) { const pkg = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(root, 'opencode-windows-x64', 'package.json'), 'utf8')); if (pkg.version !== '1.18.31') throw Error('Wrong native OpenCode V1 version'); } if (!fs.statSync(binary, {throwIfNoEntry:false})?.isFile()) throw Error('Native OpenCode V1 install missing'); fs.appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, 'REAL_OPENCODE_TEST_BINARY=' + binary + String.fromCharCode(10));"

        env:

on:

      prepared_run_id: { type: string, required: true }
      prepared_artifact_id: { type: string, required: true }

  contents: read

  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish-reviewed-carry:
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Authenticate immutable prepared plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PREPARED_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_id }}
          PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_artifact_id }}
          PLAN_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.plan_digest }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$GITHUB_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$PLAN_DIGEST" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
          [[ "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && "$PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$PREPARED_RUN_ID" > prepared-run.json
          jq -e --arg sha "$GITHUB_SHA" '.head_sha == $sha and .path == ".github/workflows/stage-existing-partial-draft.yml" and .event == "workflow_dispatch" and .status == "completed" and .conclusion == "success"' prepared-run.json
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID" > prepared-artifact.json
          jq -e --arg sha "$GITHUB_SHA" --argjson run "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" '.expired == false and .name == "existing-draft-stage-plan" and .workflow_run.id == $run and .workflow_run.head_sha == $sha and (.digest | test("^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$"))' prepared-artifact.json
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID/zip" > plan.zip
          [[ "$(sha256sum plan.zip | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" == "$(jq -r '.digest | sub("^sha256:"; "")' prepared-artifact.json)" ]]
          [[ "$(unzip -Z1 plan.zip | LC_ALL=C sort | tr '\n' ' ')" == "stage-plan.json stage-plan.sha256 " ]]
          [[ "$(unzip -p plan.zip stage-plan.sha256)" == "$PLAN_DIGEST" ]]
          unzip -p plan.zip stage-plan.json > stage-plan.json
          [[ "$(sha256sum stage-plan.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" == "$PLAN_DIGEST" ]]
          jq -e --arg sha "$GITHUB_SHA" --arg tag "$RELEASE_TAG" '.input.toolingSha == $sha and .input.target.tag == $tag and .input.mode == "carry-mac"' stage-plan.json
      - name: Verify complete native readiness and optionally publish

          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          NATIVE_RECEIPT_JSON: ${{ inputs.native_receipt_json }}
          PLAN_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.plan_digest }}
          PUBLISH_RELEASE: ${{ inputs.publish_release }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flags=()
          if [[ "$PUBLISH_RELEASE" == true ]]; then flags=(--publish); fi

      # A failed prerequisite must not leave an unaudited stable release public.
      - name: Return unaudited release to draft after any guard failure
        if: ${{ always() && steps.verify.outcome != 'success' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          RELEASE_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
          RELEASE_ID: ${{ github.event.release.id }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$RELEASE_REPOSITORY" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$ ]]
          [[ "$RELEASE_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$RELEASE_TAG" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
          endpoint="repos/${RELEASE_REPOSITORY}/releases/${RELEASE_ID}"
          state="$(gh api "$endpoint" --jq '[.tag_name, .draft] | @tsv')"
          IFS=$'\t' read -r actual_tag actual_draft <<< "$state"
          [[ "$actual_tag" == "$RELEASE_TAG" ]]
          if [[ "$actual_draft" != true ]]; then
            gh api --method PATCH "$endpoint" -F draft=true -f make_latest=false >/dev/null
          fi
          state="$(gh api "$endpoint" --jq '[.tag_name, .draft] | @tsv')"
          IFS=$'\t' read -r actual_tag actual_draft <<< "$state"
          [[ "$actual_tag" == "$RELEASE_TAG" && "$actual_draft" == true ]]
          echo "[release-updater-guard] Unaudited ${RELEASE_TAG} is draft"

name: Release

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_tag:
        description: Release tag to build into a draft, for example v2.0.0
        required: true
        type: string
      publish_release:
        description: Publish the release after all assets are uploaded
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
      reuse_existing_draft_assets:
        description: Promote an existing validated draft without rebuilding platform installers
        required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean

      prepared_run_id: { type: string, description: Full220 prepared stage run ID }
      prepared_run_attempt: { type: string, description: Full220 prepared stage run attempt }
      prepared_artifact_id: { type: string, description: Full220 prepared stage artifact ID }
      prepared_artifact_sha256:
        { type: string, description: Full220 prepared stage whole ZIP SHA256 }
      plan_digest: { type: string, description: Full220 prepared plan SHA256 }
      native_receipt_json: { type: string, description: Full220 complete native readiness receipt }

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ inputs.release_tag || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

env:
  IS_RELEASE_BUILD: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' }}
  RELEASE_TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
  PUBLISH_RELEASE: ${{ inputs.publish_release }}

jobs:
  signing-custody:
    name: Validate signing source before release builds
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Reject untrusted new-build dispatch
        env:
          REPOSITORY_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          TRIGGERING_ACTOR: ${{ github.triggering_actor }}
          REUSE_EXISTING_DRAFT: ${{ inputs.reuse_existing_draft_assets }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ "$REUSE_EXISTING_DRAFT" = true ]; then
            exit 0
          fi
          test "$GITHUB_EVENT_NAME" = workflow_dispatch
          test "$GITHUB_ACTOR" = "$REPOSITORY_OWNER"
          test "$TRIGGERING_ACTOR" = "$REPOSITORY_OWNER"
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = refs/heads/release/macos-signing

      - name: Checkout signing source
        if: ${{ !inputs.reuse_existing_draft_assets }}
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require selected release tag to match workflow commit
        if: ${{ !inputs.reuse_existing_draft_assets }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG"
          test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD^{commit})" = "$GITHUB_SHA"

  build:
    needs: signing-custody
    if: ${{ !inputs.reuse_existing_draft_assets }}
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 30

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Restore pnpm node-gyp executable bit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          PNPM_STORE="$(pnpm store path)"
          PNPM_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"
          for path in "$PNPM_STORE" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$PNPM_BIN_DIR"; do
            if [ -d "$path" ]; then
              find "$path" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs

      - name: Validate release metadata
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${RELEASE_TAG:-}" in
            v[0-9]*) ;;
            *)
              echo "release_tag must start with v and include a numeric version, got '${RELEASE_TAG:-<empty>}'" >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Set version from release tag
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
          pnpm pkg set version="$VERSION"

      - name: Verify Sentry release env
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-sentry-release.cjs prebuild

      - name: Verify PostHog release env
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-posthog-release.cjs prebuild

      - name: Build app
        env:
          NODE_OPTIONS: '--max-old-space-size=8192'
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && secrets.SENTRY_DSN || '' }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN || '' }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && secrets.POSTHOG_KEY || '' }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Verify Sentry source map upload
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-sentry-release.cjs postbuild

      - name: Verify PostHog renderer bundle
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-posthog-release.cjs postbuild

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TAG="${RELEASE_TAG}"
          existing_is_draft="$(gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if [ -n "$existing_is_draft" ]; then
            if [ "${PUBLISH_RELEASE}" != "true" ] && [ "$existing_is_draft" != "true" ]; then
              echo "Release $TAG already exists and is not a draft; refusing to overwrite it from draft mode." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Release $TAG already exists, skipping creation"
            exit 0
          fi
          gh release create "$TAG" \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --title "$TAG" \
            --generate-notes \
            --draft=true

      - name: Upload dist artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: dist
          path: |
            out/renderer
            dist-electron
          retention-days: 1

  prepare-runtime:
    needs: signing-custody
    if: ${{ !inputs.reuse_existing_draft_assets }}
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 90

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Validate release metadata
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          case "${RELEASE_TAG:-}" in
            v[0-9]*) ;;
            *)
              echo "release_tag must start with v and include a numeric version, got '${RELEASE_TAG:-<empty>}'" >&2
              exit 1
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Create GitHub Release
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          TAG="${RELEASE_TAG}"
          existing_is_draft="$(gh release view "$TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft' 2>/dev/null || true)"
          if [ -n "$existing_is_draft" ]; then
            if [ "${PUBLISH_RELEASE}" != "true" ] && [ "$existing_is_draft" != "true" ]; then
              echo "Release $TAG already exists and is not a draft; refusing to overwrite it from draft mode." >&2
              exit 1
            fi
            echo "Release $TAG already exists, skipping creation"
            exit 0
          fi
          gh release create "$TAG" \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --target "$GITHUB_SHA" \
            --title "$TAG" \
            --generate-notes \
            --draft=true

      - name: Skip runtime asset preparation for non-release builds
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD != 'true' }}
        run: echo "Runtime asset preparation is only needed for release builds."

      - name: Check runtime assets
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        id: runtime-assets
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RELEASE_REPO="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs release-repository)"
          RELEASE_TAG="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs release-tag)"
          existing="$(gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$RELEASE_REPO" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name' 2>/dev/null || true)"
          missing=0
          while IFS= read -r asset; do
            [ -n "$asset" ] || continue
            if ! grep -Fqx "$asset" <<<"$existing"; then
              echo "Missing runtime asset: $asset"
              missing=1
            fi
          done < <(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs asset-list)
          echo "missing=$missing" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run and wait for private runtime build
        if: steps.runtime-assets.outputs.missing == '1'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "Missing RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN secret" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          SOURCE_REPO="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs source-repository)"
          SOURCE_REF="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs source-ref)"
          RELEASE_REPO="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs release-repository)"
          RELEASE_TAG="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs release-tag)"
          RUNTIME_VERSION="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs version)"
          RUN_TITLE="runtime ${RUNTIME_VERSION} -> ${RELEASE_REPO}@${RELEASE_TAG}"
          STARTED_AT="$(node -e 'console.log(new Date(Date.now() - 120000).toISOString())')"

          gh workflow run release-runtime.yml \
            --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
            --ref main \
            -f "source_ref=$SOURCE_REF" \
            -f "runtime_version=$RUNTIME_VERSION" \
            -f "target_release_repo=$RELEASE_REPO" \
            -f "target_release_tag=$RELEASE_TAG"

          run_id=""
          for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
            run_id="$(
              gh run list \
                --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
                --workflow release-runtime.yml \
                --event workflow_dispatch \
                --limit 30 \
                --json databaseId,displayTitle,createdAt \
                --jq '.[] | select(.displayTitle == "'"$RUN_TITLE"'" and .createdAt >= "'"$STARTED_AT"'") | .databaseId' \
                | head -n 1
            )"

            if [ -n "$run_id" ]; then
              echo "Found orchestrator runtime workflow run: $run_id"
              for wait_attempt in $(seq 1 240); do
                run_state="$(
                  gh run view "$run_id" \
                    --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
                    --json status,conclusion,url \
                    --jq '[.status, (.conclusion // ""), .url] | @tsv'
                )"
                IFS=$'\t' read -r status conclusion url <<< "$run_state"

                if [ "$status" = "completed" ]; then
                  if [ "$conclusion" = "success" ]; then
                    echo "Orchestrator runtime workflow succeeded: $url"
                    exit 0
                  fi

                  echo "Orchestrator runtime workflow failed with conclusion '$conclusion': $url" >&2
                  exit 1
                fi

                echo "Orchestrator runtime workflow status: $status - wait $wait_attempt/240"
                sleep 15
              done

              echo "Timed out waiting for orchestrator runtime workflow completion: $run_id" >&2
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Waiting for orchestrator runtime workflow run - attempt $attempt/60"
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Timed out waiting for orchestrator runtime workflow run: $RUN_TITLE" >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Verify runtime assets
        if: steps.runtime-assets.outputs.missing == '1'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RELEASE_REPO="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs release-repository)"
          RELEASE_TAG="$(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs release-tag)"
          for attempt in $(seq 1 12); do
            existing="$(gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$RELEASE_REPO" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name' 2>/dev/null || true)"
            all_found=1
            while IFS= read -r asset; do
              [ -n "$asset" ] || continue
              if ! grep -Fqx "$asset" <<<"$existing"; then
                all_found=0
                break
              fi
            done < <(node ./scripts/runtime-lock.mjs asset-list)

            if [ "$all_found" -eq 1 ]; then
              echo "Runtime assets are ready"
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for runtime assets after orchestrator success - attempt $attempt/12"
            sleep 10
          done

          echo "Timed out waiting for runtime assets in release $RELEASE_REPO@$RELEASE_TAG" >&2
          exit 1

  prepare-terminal-platform-runtime:
    needs: signing-custody
    if: ${{ !inputs.reuse_existing_draft_assets }}
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 90

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Skip terminal-platform asset preparation for non-release builds
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD != 'true' }}
        run: echo "Terminal-platform asset preparation is only needed for release builds."

      - name: Check terminal-platform runtime assets
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        id: terminal-platform-assets
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RELEASE_REPO="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs release-repository)"
          RELEASE_TAG="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs release-tag)"
          existing="$(gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$RELEASE_REPO" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name' 2>/dev/null || true)"
          missing=0
          while IFS= read -r release_file; do
            [ -n "$release_file" ] || continue
            if ! grep -Fqx "$release_file" <<<"$existing"; then
              echo "Missing terminal-platform release file: $release_file"
              missing=1
            fi
          done < <(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs release-file-list)
          echo "missing=$missing" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Run and wait for terminal-platform runtime build
        if: steps.terminal-platform-assets.outputs.missing == '1'
        env:
          RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          TERMINAL_PLATFORM_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TERMINAL_PLATFORM_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export GH_TOKEN="${TERMINAL_PLATFORM_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN:-${RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN:-}}"
          if [ -z "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
            echo "Missing TERMINAL_PLATFORM_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN secret" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

          SOURCE_REPO="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs source-repository)"
          SOURCE_REF="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs source-ref)"
          RUNTIME_VERSION="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs version)"
          RELEASE_REPO="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs release-repository)"
          RELEASE_TAG="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs release-tag)"
          RUN_TITLE="terminal-platform runtime ${RUNTIME_VERSION} -> ${RELEASE_REPO}@${RELEASE_TAG}"
          STARTED_AT="$(node -e 'console.log(new Date(Date.now() - 120000).toISOString())')"

          gh workflow run release-runtime.yml \
            --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
            --ref "$SOURCE_REF" \
            -f "source_ref=$SOURCE_REF" \
            -f "runtime_version=$RUNTIME_VERSION" \
            -f "target_release_repo=$RELEASE_REPO" \
            -f "target_release_tag=$RELEASE_TAG"

          run_id=""
          for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do
            run_id="$(
              gh run list \
                --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
                --workflow release-runtime.yml \
                --event workflow_dispatch \
                --limit 30 \
                --json databaseId,displayTitle,createdAt \
                --jq '.[] | select(.displayTitle == "'"$RUN_TITLE"'" and .createdAt >= "'"$STARTED_AT"'") | .databaseId' \
                | head -n 1
            )"

            if [ -n "$run_id" ]; then
              echo "Found terminal-platform runtime workflow run: $run_id"
              for wait_attempt in $(seq 1 240); do
                run_state="$(
                  gh run view "$run_id" \
                    --repo "$SOURCE_REPO" \
                    --json status,conclusion,url \
                    --jq '[.status, (.conclusion // ""), .url] | @tsv'
                )"
                IFS=$'\t' read -r status conclusion url <<< "$run_state"

                if [ "$status" = "completed" ]; then
                  if [ "$conclusion" = "success" ]; then
                    echo "Terminal-platform runtime workflow succeeded: $url"
                    exit 0
                  fi

                  echo "Terminal-platform runtime workflow failed with conclusion '$conclusion': $url" >&2
                  exit 1
                fi

                echo "Terminal-platform runtime workflow status: $status - wait $wait_attempt/240"
                sleep 15
              done

              echo "Timed out waiting for terminal-platform runtime workflow completion: $run_id" >&2
              exit 1
            fi

            echo "Waiting for terminal-platform runtime workflow run - attempt $attempt/60"
            sleep 5
          done

          echo "Timed out waiting for terminal-platform runtime workflow run: $RUN_TITLE" >&2
          exit 1

      - name: Verify terminal-platform runtime assets
        if: steps.terminal-platform-assets.outputs.missing == '1'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          RELEASE_REPO="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs release-repository)"
          RELEASE_TAG="$(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs release-tag)"
          for attempt in $(seq 1 12); do
            existing="$(gh release view "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$RELEASE_REPO" --json assets --jq '.assets[].name' 2>/dev/null || true)"
            all_found=1
            while IFS= read -r release_file; do
              [ -n "$release_file" ] || continue
              if ! grep -Fqx "$release_file" <<<"$existing"; then
                all_found=0
                break
              fi
            done < <(node ./scripts/terminal-platform-lock.mjs release-file-list)

            if [ "$all_found" -eq 1 ]; then
              echo "Terminal-platform runtime assets are ready"
              exit 0
            fi

            echo "Waiting for terminal-platform assets after workflow success - attempt $attempt/12"
            sleep 10
          done

          echo "Timed out waiting for terminal-platform assets in release $RELEASE_REPO@$RELEASE_TAG" >&2
          exit 1

  verify-public-runtime:
    name: verify runtime (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: prepare-runtime
    if: ${{ always() && (needs.prepare-runtime.result == 'success' || (inputs.publish_release && inputs.reuse_existing_draft_assets)) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: linux-x64
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
          - platform: win32-x64
            runner: windows-2022
          - platform: win32-arm64
            runner: windows-11-arm
          - platform: darwin-arm64
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15' }}
          - platform: darwin-x64
            runner: macos-15-intel

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Require the selected release tag to match the workflow commit
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git fetch --no-tags origin "refs/tags/$RELEASE_TAG"
          test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD^{commit})" = "$GITHUB_SHA"

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version

      - name: Verify runtime lock pins on the release ref
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-runtime-lock.mjs

      - name: Verify draft runtime archive before packaging
        if: ${{ !inputs.publish_release }}
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          node ./scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform ${{ matrix.platform }}
          node ./scripts/ci/verify-staged-runtime-version.mjs

      - name: Verify anonymous runtime bootstrap before packaging
        if: ${{ inputs.publish_release }}
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-public-runtime-bootstrap.mjs

  release-mac:
    if: ${{ github.actor == github.repository_owner && github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner && github.ref == 'refs/heads/release/macos-signing' }}
    environment: macos-signing
    needs: [build, prepare-runtime, prepare-terminal-platform-runtime, verify-public-runtime]
    # On the 4-vCPU Intel runner the per-file phases of the ~95k-file bundle run
    # about six times slower than on the ARM runner (an estimated ~70 minutes
    # before any retry). Its budget also covers one full packaging retry (up to
    # ~50 minutes) with room for slow notarization.

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: arm64
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15' }}

            bundle: release/mac-arm64/Agent Teams AI.app
            timeout_minutes: 90
          - arch: x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
            dist_command: pnpm pack:mac:x64
            bundle: release/mac/Agent Teams AI.app
            timeout_minutes: 180
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Download dist artifact
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: dist

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm

      - name: Setup Python for node-gyp
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Restore pnpm node-gyp executable bit
        run: |
          PNPM_STORE="$(pnpm store path)"
          PNPM_BIN_DIR="$(dirname "$(command -v pnpm)")"
          for path in "$PNPM_STORE" "${PNPM_HOME:-}" "$PNPM_BIN_DIR"; do
            if [ -d "$path" ]; then
              find "$path" -path '*/node-gyp/gyp/gyp_main.py' -exec chmod +x {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
            fi
          done

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs

      - name: Set version from release tag
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        run: |
          VERSION="${RELEASE_TAG#v}"
          pnpm pkg set version="$VERSION"

      - name: Stage bundled runtime (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
        shell: bash
        run: node ./scripts/stage-runtime.mjs --platform "darwin-${{ matrix.arch }}"

      - name: Stage terminal-platform runtime (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        env:

        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          SENTRY_DSN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_DSN }}
          SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          SENTRY_ORG: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_ORG }}
          SENTRY_PROJECT: ${{ secrets.SENTRY_PROJECT }}
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-sentry-release.cjs postbuild

      - name: Verify PostHog renderer bundle (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        if: ${{ env.IS_RELEASE_BUILD == 'true' }}
        env:
          POSTHOG_KEY: ${{ secrets.POSTHOG_KEY }}
          POSTHOG_HOST: https://eu.i.posthog.com
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-posthog-release.cjs postbuild

      - name: Verify packaged inputs (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        run: |
          test -f dist-electron/main/index.cjs

          test -f out/renderer/index.html
          test -f mcp-server/dist/index.js
          test -f resources/runtime/VERSION
          test -f resources/terminal-platform/VERSION
          test -f resources/terminal-platform/terminal-daemon
          test -f resources/terminal-platform/terminal-platform-node/index.mjs

      - name: Verify Apple signing credentials (macOS)
        env:
          APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64 }}
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.CSC_LINK }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}
          APPLE_API_ISSUER: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_ISSUER }}
          APPLE_TEAM_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_TEAM_ID }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "${APPLE_TEAM_ID:-}" = "86399583GS" || { echo "Unexpected APPLE_TEAM_ID" >&2; exit 1; }
          for name in CSC_LINK CSC_KEY_PASSWORD APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64 APPLE_API_KEY_ID APPLE_API_ISSUER; do
            test -n "${!name:-}" || { echo "Missing $name" >&2; exit 1; }
          done

      - name: Prepare Apple notarization API key
        env:
          APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64 }}
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYTHON'
          import base64, os, pathlib
          key = base64.b64decode(os.environ['APPLE_API_KEY_BASE64'], validate=True)
          if not key:
              raise SystemExit('Apple notarization API key is empty')
          path = pathlib.Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'apple-notary-key.p8'
          with path.open('wb') as stream:
              os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), 0o600)
              stream.write(key)
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_ENV'], 'a') as stream:
              stream.write(f'APPLE_API_KEY={path}\n')
          PYTHON

      - name: Package (macOS ${{ matrix.arch }})
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          CSC_LINK: ${{ secrets.CSC_LINK }}
          CSC_KEY_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CSC_KEY_PASSWORD }}
          APPLE_API_KEY_ID: ${{ secrets.APPLE_API_KEY_ID }}

name: ReviewRouter Interaction

on:
  pull_request_review_comment:
    types: [created, edited]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created, edited]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  interaction:
    name: interaction
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || ((github.event_name != 'issue_comment' || github.event.issue.pull_request) && github.event.comment.user.type != 'Bot') }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: read
      pull-requests: read
      id-token: write
    env:
      RR_RUNTIME_REF: "9bac08daa9ff4a2f0e3c1edf82c36938d64134a8"
      REVIEWROUTER_API_URL: "https://api.reviewrouter.site"
      REVIEWROUTER_OIDC_AUDIENCE: "reviewrouter"
      REVIEWROUTER_RUNTIME_CONFIG_MODE: "oidc"
      REVIEWROUTER_STATIC_CONFIG_FALLBACK: "true"
      REVIEWROUTER_COMMENT_TOKEN_MODE: "app-oidc"
      CODEX_AUTH_JSON_PRESENT: ${{ secrets.REVIEWROUTER_CODEX_AUTH_JSON != '' && '1' || '0' }}
      REVIEW_ROUTER_REVIEW_WORKFLOW_FILE: "reviewrouter-codex.yml"
      REVIEW_ROUTER_MEMORY_ENABLED: "true"
      REVIEW_ROUTER_MEMORY_PROTOCOL_VERSION: "1"
      REVIEW_ROUTER_MEMORY_BUNDLE_ENDPOINT: "/api/action/v1/memory"
      REVIEW_ROUTER_MEMORY_CANDIDATE_ENDPOINT: "/api/action/v1/memory-candidates"
      REVIEW_ROUTER_MEMORY_COMMAND_ENDPOINT: "/api/action/v1/memory-commands"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout ReviewRouter interaction runtime
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803
        with:
          repository: 777genius/review-router
          ref: ${{ env.RR_RUNTIME_REF }}
          path: .reviewrouter-runtime
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38
        with:
          # This job does not check out the repository, so .node-version is unavailable.
          # Keep in sync with .node-version.
          node-version: "26.12.1"

      - name: Preflight ReviewRouter interaction
        id: preflight
        shell: bash
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          REVIEW_ROUTER_MODE: "interaction-preflight"
          REVIEW_ROUTER_DISCUSSION_MODE: ${{ vars.REVIEW_ROUTER_DISCUSSION_MODE || 'off' }}
        run: node .reviewrouter-runtime/dist/index.js

      - name: Install Codex CLI for discussion replies
        if: ${{ steps.preflight.outputs.needs_discussion == 'true' && env.CODEX_AUTH_JSON_PRESENT == '1' }}
        shell: bash
        run: npm install -g @openai/codex@0.144.0

      - name: Restore Codex subscription auth for discussion replies
        if: ${{ steps.preflight.outputs.needs_discussion == 'true' && env.CODEX_AUTH_JSON_PRESENT == '1' }}
        shell: bash
        env:
          CODEX_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.REVIEWROUTER_CODEX_AUTH_JSON }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [ -z "${CODEX_AUTH_JSON:-}" ]; then

            exit 1
          fi
          export CODEX_HOME="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}"

          chmod 700 "$CODEX_HOME"

        run: node .reviewrouter-runtime/dist/index.js

jobs:
  bootstrap:
    if: github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true
    name: anonymous bootstrap (${{ matrix.platform }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: ${{ matrix.platform == 'win32-x64' && 45 || 15 }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - platform: linux-x64
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
          - platform: win32-x64
            runner: windows-2022
          - platform: darwin-arm64
            runner: ${{ vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15' }}
          - platform: darwin-x64
            runner: macos-15-intel

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version

      - name: Verify native Windows ZIP extraction and containment
        if: matrix.platform == 'win32-x64'
        run: node --test --test-name-pattern="Windows inbox ZIP" scripts/lib/runtime-payload-cache.test.mjs

      - name: Verify ZIP metadata and native reader differentials
        if: matrix.platform != 'linux-x64'
        run: node --test scripts/lib/runtime-archive-extraction.test.mts
      - name: Verify ZIP extraction and companion integrity
        run: node --test --test-name-pattern="ZIP extraction" scripts/lib/runtime-payload-cache.test.mjs

      - name: Verify literal Windows ZIP reader and streamed integrity
        run: node --test scripts/lib/runtime-windows-zip-extraction.test.mts

      - name: Verify complete payload cache and publication lock ordering
        run: node --test scripts/lib/runtime-payload-cache.test.mjs

      - name: Verify asynchronous payload inventory, rollback, and reader drain
        run: node --test scripts/lib/runtime-payload-cache-async.test.mts

      - name: Download, extract, and execute pinned runtime anonymously
        env:
          CLAUDE_DEV_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTICS: '1'
        run: node ./scripts/ci/verify-public-runtime-bootstrap.mjs

jobs:
  linux-registered:
    if: (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true) && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)
    name: registered native (linux x64 pidfs)
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 45
    env:
      EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6.1.0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Bind exact source and install frozen dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_SOURCE_SHA"
          node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
          pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
          pnpm typecheck:legacy-host-scripts
          node --test packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-build-selection.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-capture-records.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-commands.test.ts packages/legacy-agent-host/tests/registered-process-owner.test.ts
          mkdir -p native-evidence
          git rev-parse HEAD > native-evidence/source-sha.txt
      - name: Genuine repository Node pidfs and cold-original gates
        env:
          LEGACY_REGISTERED_PROCESS_NATIVE_GO: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          headers=$(node -p "require('path').resolve(require('path').dirname(process.execPath),'../include/node')")
          node packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/qualifyLinuxProcessNative.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-node26-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" "$headers" | tee native-evidence/linux-node26.log
          cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-node26-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" native-evidence/node26
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7.0.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.21.0
      - name: Genuine Host Node pidfs and cold-original gates
        env:
          LEGACY_REGISTERED_PROCESS_NATIVE_GO: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          headers=$(node -p "require('path').resolve(require('path').dirname(process.execPath),'../include/node')")
          node packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/qualifyLinuxProcessNative.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-node24-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" "$headers" | tee native-evidence/linux-node24.log
          cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-node24-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" native-evidence/node24
      - name: Genuine pinned Electron N-API and original-identity gates
        env:
          LEGACY_REGISTERED_PROCESS_NATIVE_GO: '1'
          ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          headers=$(node -p "require('path').resolve(require('path').dirname(process.execPath),'../include/node')")
          node_modules/electron/dist/electron packages/legacy-agent-host/scripts/qualifyLinuxProcessNative.ts "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-electron-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$(command -v cc)" "$(command -v readelf)" "$headers" | tee native-evidence/linux-electron.log
          cp -R "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-electron-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" native-evidence/electron
      - name: Prepare private Linux Desktop dependencies
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y xvfb xauth lsof
          node scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs --strict
          node -e "require('node:assert/strict').equal(require('electron/package.json').version, '44.10.1')"
          pnpm exec electron-rebuild --module-dir . --force --only better-sqlite3 --version 44.10.1
      - name: Genuine Linux SDK background services and selected Stop
        env:
          LEGACY_PROCESS_NORMAL_SDK_GO: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-controller build
          pnpm --filter agent-teams-mcp build
          selected_inputs="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-sdk-inputs-XXXXXX")"
          mkdir "$selected_inputs/cache"
          printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$selected_inputs/package.json"
          pnpm --dir "$selected_inputs" add --ignore-scripts --save-exact corepack@0.36.0
          corepack_entry=$(node -e "console.log(require('node:fs').realpathSync(process.argv[1]))" "$selected_inputs/node_modules/corepack/dist/pnpm.js")
          COREPACK_HOME="$selected_inputs/cache" node "$corepack_entry" --version
          printf 'LINUX_PROCESS_PNPM_ENTRY=%s\nLEGACY_DESKTOP_COREPACK_HOME=%s\n' "$corepack_entry" "$selected_inputs/cache" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
          selection="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-node24-$GITHUB_RUN_ID/selection.json"
          selection_sha=$(node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1])).digest('hex'))" "$selection")
          child_exec_pin="$(node --input-type=module - "$selection" "$selection_sha" <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
          import { appendFileSync, readFileSync, realpathSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { dirname, join, sep } from 'node:path';
          const digest = path => createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex');
          assert.equal(digest(process.argv[2]), process.argv[3]);
          const pin = JSON.parse(readFileSync(process.argv[2], 'utf8')).linuxChildExec;
          assert.deepEqual(Object.keys(pin).sort(), ['binarySha256', 'manifestPath', 'manifestSha256']);
          assert.ok(pin.manifestPath.startsWith(dirname(process.argv[2]) + sep));
          assert.equal(realpathSync(pin.manifestPath), pin.manifestPath);
          assert.ok(!/[\r\n]/.test(pin.manifestPath));
          assert.match(pin.manifestSha256, /^[a-f0-9]{64}$/);
          assert.equal(digest(pin.manifestPath), pin.manifestSha256);
          const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(pin.manifestPath, 'utf8'));
          assert.equal(manifest.protocol, 'linux-child-exec-v1');
          assert.equal(manifest.sourceSha256, digest('packages/legacy-agent-host/native/linux-child-exec.c'));
          assert.equal(manifest.binarySha256, pin.binarySha256);
          assert.equal(digest(join(dirname(pin.manifestPath), 'linux-child-exec')), pin.binarySha256);
          appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV, `LEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_MANIFEST=${pin.manifestPath}\nLEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_SHA256=${pin.manifestSha256}\n`);
          process.stdout.write(`${pin.manifestPath}\n${pin.manifestSha256}\n`);
          NODE
          )"
          readarray -t child_exec_values <<< "$child_exec_pin"
          test "${#child_exec_values[@]}" -eq 2
          export LEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_MANIFEST="${child_exec_values[0]}"
          export LEGACY_LINUX_CHILD_EXEC_SHA256="${child_exec_values[1]}"
          LEGACY_DESKTOP_COREPACK_HOME="$selected_inputs/cache" node scripts/legacy-agent-host/qualify-linux-process-sdk.ts \
            "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-sdk-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$selection" "$selection_sha" "$corepack_entry" \
            2>&1 | tee native-evidence/linux-sdk.log
      - name: Genuine cold Host Processes UI Stop and history
        env:
          LEGACY_PROCESS_COLD_UI_GO: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdk_receipt="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-sdk-$GITHUB_RUN_ID/sdk-receipt.json"
          sdk_receipt_sha=$(node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1])).digest('hex'))" "$sdk_receipt")
          xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24 -nolisten tcp' \
            bash -euo pipefail -c 'export LEGACY_DESKTOP_TEST_DISPLAY="$DISPLAY" LEGACY_DESKTOP_TEST_XAUTHORITY="$XAUTHORITY"; exec node scripts/legacy-agent-host/qualify-linux-process-cold-ui.ts "$@"' \
            bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-cold-ui-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$sdk_receipt" "$sdk_receipt_sha" "$LINUX_PROCESS_PNPM_ENTRY" \
            2>&1 | tee native-evidence/linux-cold-ui.log
      - name: Prepare pinned Linux candidate inputs and production bundle
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node --max-old-space-size=8192 node_modules/electron-vite/bin/electron-vite.js build
          node scripts/ci/verify-radix-renderer-bundle.mjs
          node scripts/stage-managed-git.mjs --platform linux-x64
          node scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --platform linux-x64
          selected_pack_inputs="$(mktemp -d "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-packed-inputs-XXXXXX")"
          printf '{"private":true}\n' > "$selected_pack_inputs/package.json"
          pnpm --dir "$selected_pack_inputs" add --ignore-scripts --save-exact @openai/codex@0.162.0-linux-x64 opencode-linux-x64@1.19.4
          node --input-type=module - "$selected_pack_inputs" "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-node24-$GITHUB_RUN_ID/selection.json" <<'NODE'
          import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
          import { createHash } from 'node:crypto';
          import { readFileSync, realpathSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
          import { join } from 'node:path';
          const [root, selectionPath] = process.argv.slice(2);
          const pin = path => { path = realpathSync(path); return { path, sha256: createHash('sha256').update(readFileSync(path)).digest('hex') }; };
          const codexRoot = realpathSync(join(root, 'node_modules/@openai/codex'));
          const opencodeRoot = realpathSync(join(root, 'node_modules/opencode-linux-x64'));
          const codexPackage = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(codexRoot, 'package.json'), 'utf8'));
          const opencodePackage = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(opencodeRoot, 'package.json'), 'utf8'));
          assert.equal(codexPackage.name, '@openai/codex'); assert.equal(codexPackage.version, '0.162.0-linux-x64');
          assert.equal(opencodePackage.name, 'opencode-linux-x64'); assert.equal(opencodePackage.version, '1.19.4');
          const bin = join(codexRoot, 'vendor/x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/bin');
          const { directory, manifestSha256 } = JSON.parse(readFileSync(selectionPath, 'utf8'));
          writeFileSync(join(root, 'candidate-native-capture.json'), JSON.stringify({ schemaVersion: 1, platform: 'linux-x64',
            codex: { ...pin(join(bin, 'codex')), protocolRevision: '0.162.0', codeModeHost: pin(join(bin, 'codex-code-mode-host')) },
            opencode: { ...pin(join(opencodeRoot, 'bin/opencode')), protocolRevision: '1.19.4' },
            processCustody: { directory, manifestSha256 } }), { mode: 0o600, flag: 'wx' });
          NODE
          printf 'LINUX_PROCESS_NATIVE_CAPTURE=%s\n' "$selected_pack_inputs/candidate-native-capture.json" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - name: Genuine packed Electron cold Host Processes Stop and history
        env:
          LEGACY_STAGE1_P7_GO: '1'
          LEGACY_PROCESS_COLD_UI_GO: '1'
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cold_receipt="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-cold-ui-$GITHUB_RUN_ID/cold-ui-receipt.json"
          cold_receipt_sha=$(node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1])).digest('hex'))" "$cold_receipt")
          native_capture_sha=$(node -e "console.log(require('node:crypto').createHash('sha256').update(require('node:fs').readFileSync(process.argv[1])).digest('hex'))" "$LINUX_PROCESS_NATIVE_CAPTURE")
          xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24 -nolisten tcp' \
            bash -euo pipefail -c 'export LEGACY_DESKTOP_TEST_DISPLAY="$DISPLAY" LEGACY_DESKTOP_TEST_XAUTHORITY="$XAUTHORITY"; exec node scripts/legacy-agent-host/qualify-linux-process-packed.ts "$@"' \
            bash "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-packed-$GITHUB_RUN_ID" "$cold_receipt" "$cold_receipt_sha" "$LINUX_PROCESS_PNPM_ENTRY" "$LINUX_PROCESS_NATIVE_CAPTURE" "$native_capture_sha" \
            2>&1 | tee native-evidence/linux-packed.log
      - name: Retain original SDK receipt and private TEST fixture
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sdk_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-sdk-$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          if test -d "$sdk_root"; then
            mkdir -p native-evidence/sdk
            for name in sdk-receipt.json fixture; do
              if test -e "$sdk_root/$name"; then cp -R "$sdk_root/$name" native-evidence/sdk/; fi
            done
          fi
      - name: Retain original cold Host and Desktop observations
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cold_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-cold-ui-$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          if test -d "$cold_root"; then
            mkdir -p native-evidence/cold-ui
            for name in cold-ui-receipt.json cold-ui.log controlled-capture.json fixture; do
              if test -e "$cold_root/$name"; then cp -R "$cold_root/$name" native-evidence/cold-ui/; fi
            done
          fi
      - name: Retain packed closure, builder and original UI receipts
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          packed_root="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-linux-packed-$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
          if test -d "$packed_root"; then
            mkdir -p native-evidence/packed
            for name in packed-receipt.json candidate-build.log packed-capture.json TEST-packed-cold-ui; do
              if test -e "$packed_root/$name"; then cp -R "$packed_root/$name" native-evidence/packed/; fi
            done
            if test -f "$packed_root/candidate/legacy-agent-host/candidate.json"; then
              cp "$packed_root/candidate/legacy-agent-host/candidate.json" native-evidence/packed/candidate.json
              cp "$packed_root/candidate/electron-builder.candidate.json" native-evidence/packed/
            fi
          fi
      - name: Retain exact Linux source, artifact and native receipts
        if: always()
