name: Stage Existing Partial Draft

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      operation:
        type: choice
        options: [prepare, stage-draft]
        default: prepare
      mode:
        type: choice
        options: [full, carry-mac]
        default: full
      release_tag: { type: string, required: true }
      application_sha: { type: string, required: true }
      tooling_sha: { type: string, required: true }
      mac_source_tag: { type: string }
      build_run_id: { type: string }
      build_attempt: { type: string }
      build_job_ids: { type: string }
      prepared_run_id: { type: string }
      prepared_artifact_id: { type: string }
      plan_digest: { type: string }

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ inputs.release_tag }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  assemble-draft:
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Require reviewed immutable tooling SHA
        env:
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
        run: |
          [[ "$TOOLING_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$TOOLING_SHA" ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Check all typed native harnesses before preparing immutable inputs
        if: ${{ inputs.operation == 'prepare' }}
        run: |
          node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/*.mts
      - name: Prepare or resume immutable plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation }}
          MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
          TAG: ${{ inputs.release_tag }}
          APPLICATION_SHA: ${{ inputs.application_sha }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          MAC_SOURCE_TAG: ${{ inputs.mac_source_tag }}
          BUILD_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.build_run_id }}
          BUILD_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.build_attempt }}
          BUILD_JOB_IDS: ${{ inputs.build_job_ids }}
          PREPARED_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_id }}
          PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_artifact_id }}
          PLAN_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.plan_digest }}
        run: |
          [[ "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" == "$TOOLING_SHA" ]]
          if [[ "$OPERATION" == prepare ]]; then
            args=(--repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --release-tag "$TAG" --application-sha "$APPLICATION_SHA" --tooling-sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --mode "$MODE" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-stage" --build-run-id "$BUILD_RUN_ID" --build-attempt "$BUILD_ATTEMPT" --build-job-ids "$BUILD_JOB_IDS")
            if [[ -n "$MAC_SOURCE_TAG" ]]; then args+=(--mac-source-tag "$MAC_SOURCE_TAG"); fi
            pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci/prepare-existing-draft.ts "${args[@]}"
          else
            [[ "$OPERATION" == stage-draft && "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$PLAN_DIGEST" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$PREPARED_RUN_ID" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/prepare-run.json"
            jq -e --arg sha "$TOOLING_SHA" '.head_sha == $sha and .status == "completed" and .conclusion == "success" and .path == ".github/workflows/stage-existing-partial-draft.yml"' "$RUNNER_TEMP/prepare-run.json"
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/artifact.json"
            jq -e --argjson run "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" --arg sha "$TOOLING_SHA" '.expired == false and .name == "existing-draft-stage-plan" and .workflow_run.id == $run and .workflow_run.head_sha == $sha' "$RUNNER_TEMP/artifact.json"
            gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID/zip" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.zip"
            expected=$(jq -r .digest "$RUNNER_TEMP/artifact.json")
            [[ "sha256:$(sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$expected" ]]
            mkdir "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-stage"
            unzip -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/plan.zip" stage-plan.json > "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-stage/stage-plan.json"
            plan="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-stage/stage-plan.json"
            jq -e --arg tag "$TAG" --arg app "$APPLICATION_SHA" --arg tooling "$TOOLING_SHA" --arg mode "$MODE" --arg source "$MAC_SOURCE_TAG" '.input.target.tag == $tag and .input.target.applicationSha == $app and .input.toolingSha == $tooling and .input.mode == $mode and (.input.macSource.release.tag // "") == $source' "$plan"
            pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci/stage-existing-draft.ts --plan "$plan" --plan-digest "$PLAN_DIGEST"
            pnpm exec tsx scripts/ci/verify-updater-release.ts --state draft --plan "$plan" --plan-digest "$PLAN_DIGEST"
          fi
      - name: Persist immutable metadata plan
        if: ${{ inputs.operation == 'prepare' }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: existing-draft-stage-plan
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-stage/stage-plan.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-stage/stage-plan.sha256
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  creation-page:
    name: Creation page (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 55
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, windows-latest, macos-latest]
    env:
      AGENT_TEAMS_INSTALL_PROFILE: node-ci
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Enable Windows long paths
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: git config --global core.longpaths true
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prepare Linux virtual display and zh-TW font fallback
        if: runner.os == 'Linux'
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y xvfb fonts-noto-cjk
          fc-cache -f
          fc-match 'Noto Sans CJK TC' | grep -F 'Noto Sans CJK TC'
      - name: Install frozen dependencies
        run: node ./scripts/ci/install-dependencies-with-retry.mjs
      # The Stage 1 extracted Host is a workspace export consumed by Vite's
      # Electron main bundle; installing alone does not produce dist/lifecycle.
      - name: Build isolated Host before Electron startup
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build
      # dev:mcp bootstraps terminal-platform before opening CDP. Stage the exact
      # lockfile-pinned and checksum-verified runtime with Actions credentials,
      # instead of leaving a network download inside the 90s UI startup deadline.
      - name: Stage pinned terminal-platform runtime before Electron startup
        timeout-minutes: 10
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: node ./scripts/stage-terminal-platform-runtime.mjs --ensure
      # node-ci intentionally skips Electron's postinstall. Validate it explicitly
      # so failures retain the installer's diagnostics rather than a CDP timeout.
      - name: Ensure Electron binary before UI E2E
        timeout-minutes: 10
        run: node ./scripts/ensure-electron-install.cjs --strict
      - name: Verify owned Windows process census and fail-closed teardown invariants
        run: node --test scripts/e2e/teams-create-page-owned-processes.test.mjs
      - name: Exercise actual Electron Create/Back/Resume/Copy/Launch
        shell: bash
        env:
          TEAMS_CREATE_E2E_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/teams-create-page-evidence
        run: |
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "Linux" ]]; then
            xvfb-run -a node scripts/e2e/teams-create-page-desktop.mjs
          else
            node scripts/e2e/teams-create-page-desktop.mjs
          fi
      - name: Upload sanitized evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: teams-create-page-${{ matrix.os }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/teams-create-page-evidence/*.png
            ${{ runner.temp }}/teams-create-page-evidence/*.json

name: Native Linux package updater

on:

      - '.github/workflows/updater-linux-packages.yml'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/archive.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/cdp.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/inputs.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/native-release-scenario.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/native-window.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/transport.mts'
      - 'scripts/ci/release/contract.ts'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: 'availability first; ota includes a separate fresh target install'
        type: choice
        options: [availability, ota]
        default: availability
      target_mode:
        description: '2.17.6/2.17.10 require exact prepared stage; 2.17.2 is historical infrastructure evidence only'
        type: choice
        options: [staged-2.17.10, staged-2.17.6, historical-2.17.2]

      stage_artifact:
        description: 'Required immutable prepared stage artifact for 2.17.6/2.17.10'
        type: string
      stage_run_id:
        description: 'Producer run ID for that prepared stage artifact'
        type: string
      plan_sha256:
        description: 'Expected SHA256 of its exact stage-plan.json'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  linux-package-tooling-quality:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages*.mts
      - run: pnpm exec prettier --check scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages*.mts .github/workflows/updater-linux-packages.yml
      - run: node --test scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-seal.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.test.mts

  inputs:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    # Draft reads require push permission. This job only reads release bytes;
    # its token never reaches a desktop process or a native runtime job.
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Require explicit prepared artifact identity
        if: inputs.target_mode == 'staged-2.17.6' || inputs.target_mode == 'staged-2.17.10'
        env:
          TEST_STAGE_NAME: ${{ inputs.stage_artifact }}
          TEST_STAGE_RUN: ${{ inputs.stage_run_id }}
          TEST_PLAN_SHA: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$TEST_STAGE_NAME"
          [[ "$TEST_STAGE_RUN" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
          [[ "$TEST_PLAN_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
      - name: Download immutable prepared stage for the current target
        if: inputs.target_mode == 'staged-2.17.6' || inputs.target_mode == 'staged-2.17.10'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.stage_artifact }}
          run-id: ${{ inputs.stage_run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-linux-package-inputs/stage/
      - name: Download and verify immutable official packages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TEST_TARGET_MODE: ${{ inputs.target_mode || 'historical-2.17.2' }}
          TEST_PLAN_SHA: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          inputs=.artifacts/TEST-linux-package-inputs
          mkdir -p "$inputs"
          gh api repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/398386033 > "$inputs/source-api.json"
          for kind in deb rpm pacman; do
            old=$(node scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.mts --name "$kind" 2.17.1)
            gh release download v2.17.1 --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern "$old" --output "$inputs/$old"
          done
          flags=(--historical-preview)
          if [[ "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.6 || "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.10 ]]; then
            node scripts/e2e/release-updater/inputs.mts --plan-downloads "$inputs/stage" "$TEST_PLAN_SHA" > "$inputs/target-download-identities.json"
            release=$(jq -er '.releaseId' "$inputs/target-download-identities.json")
            target=$(jq -er '.targetVersion' "$inputs/target-download-identities.json")
            test "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" = "staged-$target"
            gh api "repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/$release" > "$inputs/draft-api.json"
            # Consume actual stage-draft upload bytes, rather than rebuilding
            # its generated metadata inside the native harness.
            node scripts/e2e/release-updater/inputs.mts --metadata-downloads "$inputs/stage" "$TEST_PLAN_SHA" "$inputs/draft-api.json" > "$inputs/staged-metadata-downloads.json"
            jq -r '.[] | [.id,.name] | @tsv' "$inputs/staged-metadata-downloads.json" > "$inputs/staged-metadata.tsv"
            while IFS=$'\t' read -r asset name; do
              gh api "repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/assets/$asset" -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' > "$inputs/stage/$name"
            done < "$inputs/staged-metadata.tsv"
            jq -r '.assets[] | [.id,.name] | @tsv' "$inputs/target-download-identities.json" > "$inputs/target-assets.tsv"
            while IFS=$'\t' read -r asset name; do
              gh api "repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/assets/$asset" -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' > "$inputs/$name"
            done < "$inputs/target-assets.tsv"
            flags=(--stage "$inputs/stage" --plan-sha256 "$TEST_PLAN_SHA")
          else
            test "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" = historical-2.17.2
            gh api repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/401358336 > "$inputs/draft-api.json"
            for kind in deb rpm pacman; do
              target=$(node scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.mts --name "$kind" 2.17.2)
              gh release download v2.17.2 --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern "$target" --output "$inputs/$target"
            done
            gh release download v2.17.2 --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern Agent.Teams.AI-2.17.2.AppImage --output "$inputs/Agent.Teams.AI-2.17.2.AppImage"
          fi
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.mts --verify-inputs "$inputs" "${flags[@]}"
          # Immutable official archived dependency for the original 2.17.1 only.
          # Trusted signature validation and installation happen later in its
          # separate offline older-profile container, never the fresh image.
          name=http-parser-2.9.4-2-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst
          curl --fail --location --proto '=https' "https://archive.archlinux.org/packages/h/http-parser/$name" --output "$inputs/$name"
          curl --fail --location --proto '=https' "https://archive.archlinux.org/packages/h/http-parser/$name.sig" --output "$inputs/$name.sig"
          printf '5b88adb54cfedef794fd16105c3799aafc2b95bb6273ff1ddf96c6f195b1b676  %s\n3a0e243348d01c96967fe1543e360a2a8c5e6f794b754f4b89f84099a9501072  %s\n' "$inputs/$name" "$inputs/$name.sig" | sha256sum --check
          test "$(stat -c %s "$inputs/$name")" = 20942
          test "$(stat -c %s "$inputs/$name.sig")" = 566
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-linux-package-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-linux-package-inputs/
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 2

  native:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    needs: inputs
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    # The host supplies a kernel only; each GUI/package manager uses the native
    # distro below. Ubuntu 22 avoids Ubuntu 24's host-global userns restriction.
    # No host sysctl, privileged container, extra capability or AppArmor bypass.
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_2204_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-22.04' }}
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - kind: deb
            image: ubuntu:24.04
          - kind: rpm
            image: fedora:44
          - kind: pacman
            image: archlinux:base
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Strict typed and full typed lint gates
        run: |
          pnpm typecheck
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages*.mts
          pnpm exec prettier --check scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages*.mts .github/workflows/updater-linux-packages.yml
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: TEST-linux-package-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-linux-package-inputs/
      - name: Resolve base digest and prepare frozen native dependencies
        env:
          TEST_IMAGE: ${{ matrix.image }}
          TEST_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          build=.artifacts/TEST-linux-package-build
          mkdir -p "$build" .artifacts/TEST-linux-package-evidence
          docker pull "$TEST_IMAGE"
          base=$(docker image inspect "$TEST_IMAGE" --format '{{index .RepoDigests 0}}')
          test -n "$base"
          printf 'FROM %s\n' "$base" > "$build/Dockerfile"
          case "$TEST_KIND" in
            deb) packages='apt-get update && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends xvfb xauth x11-utils imagemagick tesseract-ocr fonts-dejavu-core sudo util-linux libatomic1 libsecret-1-0 libnss3 libatk1.0-0t64 libatk-bridge2.0-0t64 libcups2t64 libgtk-3-0t64 libnotify4 libxss1 libxtst6 libasound2t64 libdrm2 libgbm1 xdg-utils cpio' ;;
            rpm) packages='dnf install -y xorg-x11-server-Xvfb xorg-x11-xauth xwininfo xprop ImageMagick tesseract tesseract-langpack-eng dejavu-sans-fonts sudo util-linux shadow-utils cpio libatomic nss atk at-spi2-atk cups-libs gtk3 libnotify libXScrnSaver libXtst alsa-lib libdrm mesa-libgbm xdg-utils which && dnf clean all' ;;
            # Include the actual official predecessor's current dependencies;
            # ffmpeg's transitive packages must be installed before network:none.
            # The separately authenticated legacy http-parser stays absent here.
            pacman) packages='pacman -Syu --noconfirm && pacman -S --noconfirm xorg-server-xvfb xorg-xauth xorg-xwininfo xorg-xprop imagemagick tesseract tesseract-data-eng ttf-dejavu sudo util-linux shadow cpio libarchive nss gtk3 libnotify libxss libxtst alsa-lib libdrm mesa xdg-utils which c-ares ffmpeg libevent libvpx libxslt minizip re2 snappy libappindicator' ;;
          esac
          printf 'RUN %s\n' "$packages" >> "$build/Dockerfile"
          if test "$TEST_KIND" = rpm; then
            # Dependencies are prepared online above. Disable every repository
            # section only inside this disposable image so the shipped updater's
            # unchanged plain dnf install can resolve its local package offline.
            cat >> "$build/Dockerfile" <<'OFFLINE'
          RUN for repo in /etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo; do \
                awk '/^[[:space:]]*\[/{print; print "enabled=0"; next} /^[[:space:]]*enabled[[:space:]]*=/{next} {print}' "$repo" > "$repo.TEST-offline" && mv "$repo.TEST-offline" "$repo"; \
              done
          OFFLINE
          fi
          printf 'RUN useradd -m -U TEST-updater && echo "TEST-updater ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL" > /etc/sudoers.d/TEST-updater && chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/TEST-updater\n' >> "$build/Dockerfile"
          docker build --iidfile "$build/image.id" "$build" 2>&1 | tee "$build/build.log"
          docker image inspect "$(cat "$build/image.id")" > "$build/image.json"
          # Pin Docker's default seccomp source. Add only Chromium namespace
          # syscalls; retain clone3 ENOSYS, mount restrictions and default caps.
          gh api 'repos/moby/profiles/contents/seccomp/default.json?ref=2ceae35d351c156cb5a8efc0fdc4a08cf94569d8' --jq .content | base64 --decode > "$build/docker-default.json"
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.mts --seccomp "$build/docker-default.json" "$build/chromium-namespaces.json"
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.mts --security "$build" "$base" "$TEST_KIND" "$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
      - name: Real native package install and unprivileged GUI in offline disposable containers
        env:
          TEST_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          TEST_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode || 'availability' }}
          TEST_PLAN_SHA: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
          TEST_TARGET_MODE: ${{ inputs.target_mode || 'historical-2.17.2' }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          build="$PWD/.artifacts/TEST-linux-package-build"
          nodebin=$(command -v node)
          image=$(cat "$build/image.id")
          modes="$TEST_MODE"
          if test "$TEST_MODE" = ota; then modes='ota fresh'; fi
          result=0
          for mode in $modes; do
            evidence="$PWD/.artifacts/TEST-linux-package-evidence/$mode"
            # Host-owned metadata remains writable by the job runner. Only the
            # native child directory is assigned to the container TEST identity.
            mkdir -p "$evidence/native"
            cid=$(docker create --network none --init --shm-size=1g --security-opt "seccomp=$build/chromium-namespaces.json" \
              --mount "type=bind,src=$PWD,dst=/workspace,readonly" \
              --mount "type=bind,src=$nodebin,dst=/usr/local/bin/node,readonly" \
              --mount "type=bind,src=$evidence,dst=/evidence" \
              --mount "type=bind,src=$build/security.json,dst=/TEST-container-security.json,readonly" \
              --env "TEST_KIND=$TEST_KIND" --env "TEST_MODE=$mode" --env "TEST_PLAN_SHA=$TEST_PLAN_SHA" --env "TEST_TARGET_MODE=$TEST_TARGET_MODE" \
              "$image" /bin/bash -c '
                set -euo pipefail
                inputs=/workspace/.artifacts/TEST-linux-package-inputs
                chown TEST-updater:TEST-updater /evidence/native
                # Preserve exact runtime dependencies even if Node/package setup fails.
                case "$TEST_KIND" in
                  deb) dpkg-query -W > /evidence/os-packages-before.txt ;;
                  rpm) rpm -qa > /evidence/os-packages-before.txt ;;
                  pacman) pacman -Q > /evidence/os-packages-before.txt ;;
                esac
                ldd /usr/local/bin/node > /evidence/node-shared-libraries.txt
                node --version > /evidence/node-version.txt
                target=2.17.2
                stage=(--historical-preview)
                if [[ "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.6 || "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.10 ]]; then
                  target=$(node /workspace/scripts/e2e/release-updater/inputs.mts --plan-target-version "$inputs/stage" "$TEST_PLAN_SHA")
                  test "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" = "staged-$target"
                  stage=(--stage "$inputs/stage" --plan-sha256 "$TEST_PLAN_SHA")
                else test "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" = historical-2.17.2; fi
                node /workspace/scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.mts --verify-inputs "$inputs" "${stage[@]}" --readonly
                mkdir -p /reference/2.17.1 "/reference/$target"
                for version in 2.17.1 "$target"; do
                  name=$(node /workspace/scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.mts --name "$TEST_KIND" "$version")
                  case "$TEST_KIND" in
                    deb) dpkg-deb -x "$inputs/$name" "/reference/$version" ;;
                    rpm) (cd "/reference/$version"; rpm2cpio "$inputs/$name" | cpio -idm --quiet) ;;
                    pacman) bsdtar -xf "$inputs/$name" -C "/reference/$version"; cp "/reference/$version/.PKGINFO" "/evidence/pacman-$version.PKGINFO"; sha256sum "/evidence/pacman-$version.PKGINFO" ;;
                  esac
                done
                version=2.17.1; if test "$TEST_MODE" = fresh; then version=$target; fi
                if test "$TEST_KIND" = pacman; then
                  # The clean prepared current Arch image contains no legacy
                  # package. New target metadata cannot declare the removed dep.
                  if pacman -Q http-parser > /evidence/legacy-before.txt 2>&1; then exit 1; fi
                  if test "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" != historical-2.17.2; then
                    if grep -Eq "^depend = http-parser([<>=].*)?$" "/reference/$target/.PKGINFO"; then exit 1; fi
                  fi
                  if test "$TEST_MODE" != fresh; then
                    legacy="$inputs/http-parser-2.9.4-2-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst"
                    printf "5b88adb54cfedef794fd16105c3799aafc2b95bb6273ff1ddf96c6f195b1b676  %s\n3a0e243348d01c96967fe1543e360a2a8c5e6f794b754f4b89f84099a9501072  %s\n" "$legacy" "$legacy.sig" | sha256sum --check > /evidence/legacy-digests.txt
                    pacman-key --verify "$legacy.sig" "$legacy" 2>&1 | tee /evidence/legacy-signature.txt
                    pacman -U --noconfirm "$legacy" 2>&1 | tee /evidence/legacy-install.txt
                    pacman -Q http-parser > /evidence/legacy-installed.txt
                    pacman -Q archlinux-keyring > /evidence/legacy-keyring-version.txt
                    sha256sum /usr/share/pacman/keyrings/archlinux.gpg > /evidence/legacy-keyring-sha256.txt
                  fi
                fi
                name=$(node /workspace/scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages-inputs.mts --name "$TEST_KIND" "$version")
                case "$TEST_KIND" in
                  deb) dpkg -i "$inputs/$name"; dpkg-query -W > /evidence/os-packages.txt ;;
                  rpm) dnf --disablerepo="*" install --nogpgcheck -y "$inputs/$name"; rpm -qa > /evidence/os-packages.txt; cat /etc/yum.repos.d/*.repo > /evidence/dnf-offline-repos.txt ;;
                  pacman) pacman -U --noconfirm "$inputs/$name"; pacman -Q > /evidence/os-packages.txt
                    if test "$TEST_MODE" = fresh && pacman -Q http-parser > /evidence/legacy-after-fresh.txt 2>&1; then exit 1; fi ;;
                esac
                # Only distro package installation runs as container root. The
                # harness, mirror, Xvfb and all app/successor processes use TEST uid.
                runuser -u TEST-updater -- env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=/home/TEST-updater LC_ALL=C.UTF-8 \
                  xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args="-screen 0 1280x900x24 -nolisten tcp" --error-file=/evidence/native/xvfb.log \
                  node /workspace/scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-packages.mts --kind "$TEST_KIND" --mode "$TEST_MODE" \
                  --inputs "$inputs" --references /reference --evidence /evidence/native "${stage[@]}"
              ')
            printf '%s\n' "$cid" > "$evidence/container.id"
            docker inspect "$cid" > "$evidence/container-before.json"
            docker start --attach "$cid" 2>&1 | tee "$evidence/container.log" || result=1
            docker inspect "$cid" > "$evidence/container-after.json"
            # Remove only this exact owned disposable container after evidence.
            docker rm "$cid"
          done
          exit "$result"
      - name: Preserve real native evidence even on failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-linux-${{ matrix.kind }}-native-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            .artifacts/TEST-linux-package-evidence/
            .artifacts/TEST-linux-package-build/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

        run: |

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:

        run: ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-manual-inputs.mts --operation retrieve --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-manual-inputs"
      - name: Fresh 220 and original 211 manual replacement in owned sandbox profiles

        if: always()

            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-manual-inputs/producer-jobs.json

permissions:

jobs:
  prepare-mac-inputs:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    name: prepare-mac-inputs
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}

    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.bundle.outputs.artifact-id }}

    steps:
      - name: Require reviewed immutable tooling
        env:
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$TOOLING_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$TOOLING_SHA" ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Check authenticated input boundary
        run: |
          node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-inputs.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-transfer.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.test.mts
          ./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-cleanup-diagnostics.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-pf-baseline.test.mts
      - name: Retrieve only the authenticated immutable prepared metadata plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          PREPARED_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_id }}
          PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_attempt }}
          ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_artifact_id }}
          ARTIFACT_SHA256: ${{ inputs.prepared_artifact_sha256 }}
          PLAN_SHA256: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && "$PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && "$ARTIFACT_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
          [[ "$ARTIFACT_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ && "$PLAN_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-old-inputs"
          mkdir "$root"
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$PREPARED_RUN_ID" > "$root/run.json"
          jq -e --arg sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --argjson attempt "$PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT" '.head_sha == $sha and .run_attempt == $attempt and .status == "completed" and .conclusion == "success" and .event == "workflow_dispatch" and (.path | split("@")[0]) == ".github/workflows/stage-existing-partial-draft.yml"' "$root/run.json"
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$ARTIFACT_ID" > "$root/artifact.json"
          jq -e --arg sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --arg digest "sha256:$ARTIFACT_SHA256" --argjson run "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" '.expired == false and .name == "existing-draft-stage-plan" and .digest == $digest and .workflow_run.id == $run and .workflow_run.head_sha == $sha' "$root/artifact.json"
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$ARTIFACT_ID/zip" > "$root/plan.zip"
          [[ "$(shasum -a 256 "$root/plan.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$ARTIFACT_SHA256" ]]
          [[ "$(unzip -Z1 "$root/plan.zip" | awk '$0 == "stage-plan.json" {count++} END {print count+0}')" == 1 ]]
          unzip -p "$root/plan.zip" stage-plan.json > "$root/stage-plan.json"
          [[ "$(shasum -a 256 "$root/stage-plan.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$PLAN_SHA256" ]]
      - name: Authenticate and hash real release inputs without native application execution
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          PLAN_SHA256: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
          INPUT_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.input_digest }}
          FEED_MODE: ${{ inputs.feed_mode }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-transfer.mts \
            --operation prepare --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-old-inputs/stage-plan.json" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" --input-digest "$INPUT_DIGEST" \
            --tooling-sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --feed-mode "$FEED_MODE" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs"

      fail-fast: false
      matrix:

          - { scenario: older, architecture: x64, runner: macos-15-intel }
          - { scenario: fresh, architecture: arm64, runner: macos-15 }
          - { scenario: fresh, architecture: x64, runner: macos-15-intel }
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner == 'macos-15' && (vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15') || matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Require reviewed immutable tooling
        env:
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$TOOLING_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$TOOLING_SHA" ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install pinned harness dependencies without product lifecycle scripts
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Check typed native Mac harness
        run: |
          node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-old-updater.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-old-native.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-mirror.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-inputs.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-old-ui.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-old-observer.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-serialization.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-serialization.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-transfer.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-old-stop-paint.test.mts

          INPUT_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.input_digest }}
          ARCHITECTURE: ${{ matrix.architecture }}
          SCENARIO: ${{ matrix.scenario }}
          FEED_MODE: ${{ inputs.feed_mode }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-old-updater.mts \
            --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/stage-plan.json" \
            --inputs "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs" \
            --input-artifact-id "$INPUT_ARTIFACT_ID" --input-artifact-sha256 "$INPUT_ARTIFACT_SHA256" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" --input-digest "$INPUT_DIGEST" \
            --tooling-sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --architecture "$ARCHITECTURE" \
            --scenario "$SCENARIO" --feed-mode "$FEED_MODE" \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-old-evidence-${{ matrix.scenario }}"
      - name: Prove TEST apps and owned ShipIt launchd job stopped without respawn before PF restore
        id: network-cleanup

              --restore-network --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-old-evidence-${{ matrix.scenario }}"
          fi
          echo "upload_safe=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Capture bounded PF diagnostics after cleanup failure

        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-cleanup-diagnostics.mts TEST-mac-old-evidence-${{ matrix.scenario }}
      - name: Preserve only PF diagnostics when native cleanup is unproven
        if: always() && steps.network-cleanup.outcome == 'failure'

        timeout-minutes: 2
        with:
          name: TEST-mac-cleanup-failure-${{ matrix.architecture }}-${{ matrix.scenario }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-cleanup-diagnostics-TEST-mac-old-evidence-${{ matrix.scenario }}/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Preserve native OTA, automatic Aqua successor, preferences and binding evidence
        if: always() && steps.network-cleanup.outputs.upload_safe == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-mac-${{ matrix.scenario }}-${{ matrix.architecture }}-${{ inputs.feed_mode }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-old-evidence-${{ matrix.scenario }}/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/validated-input-artifact.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/mac-input-bundle.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/prepared-run.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/prepared-artifact.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/stage-plan.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

name: Native Mac source signatures

on:

      - name: Preserve every native command result and log on success or failure

  mac-source-signatures:

    steps:

      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install pinned tooling without product lifecycle scripts
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Aggregate only successful current-attempt native producer artifacts
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          PREPARED_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_id }}
          PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_attempt }}
          PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_artifact_id }}
          PREPARED_ARTIFACT_SHA256: ${{ inputs.prepared_artifact_sha256 }}
          PLAN_SHA256: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
          INPUT_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.input_digest }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-source.mts \

            --prepared-run-id "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" --prepared-run-attempt "$PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
            --prepared-artifact-id "$PREPARED_ARTIFACT_ID" \
            --prepared-artifact-sha256 "$PREPARED_ARTIFACT_SHA256" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" --input-digest "$INPUT_DIGEST"
      - name: Preserve aggregate evidence and diagnostics
        id: evidence
        if: always()

      - name: Record immutable artifact receipt without a self-hash cycle

            echo "Manifest input digest: $INPUT_DIGEST"
