name: Native Mac current updater no-update

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      feed_mode:
        type: choice
        required: true
        default: preview
        options: [preview, staged]
        description: Staged draft binding is required for final acceptance
      tooling_sha: { type: string, required: true, description: Reviewed immutable tooling SHA }
      prepared_run_id: { type: string, required: true }
      prepared_run_attempt: { type: string, required: true }
      prepared_artifact_id: { type: string, required: true }
      prepared_artifact_sha256: { type: string, required: true }
      plan_sha256: { type: string, required: true }
      input_digest: { type: string, required: true }

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

jobs:
  prepare-mac-inputs:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    name: prepare-mac-inputs
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    outputs:
      artifact_id: ${{ steps.bundle.outputs.artifact-id }}
      artifact_sha256: ${{ steps.bundle.outputs.artifact-digest }}
    steps:
      - name: Require reviewed immutable tooling
        env:
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$TOOLING_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$TOOLING_SHA" ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Check authenticated input boundary
        run: |
          node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-inputs.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-transfer.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.test.mts
          ./node_modules/.bin/tsx --test scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-cleanup-diagnostics.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-pf-baseline.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-lifecycle.test.mts
      - name: Retrieve only the authenticated immutable prepared metadata plan
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          PREPARED_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_id }}
          PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.prepared_run_attempt }}
          ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.prepared_artifact_id }}
          ARTIFACT_SHA256: ${{ inputs.prepared_artifact_sha256 }}
          PLAN_SHA256: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && "$PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && "$ARTIFACT_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
          [[ "$ARTIFACT_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ && "$PLAN_SHA256" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
          root="$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-updater-inputs"
          mkdir "$root"
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$PREPARED_RUN_ID" > "$root/run.json"
          jq -e --arg sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --argjson attempt "$PREPARED_RUN_ATTEMPT" '.head_sha == $sha and .run_attempt == $attempt and .status == "completed" and .conclusion == "success" and .event == "workflow_dispatch" and (.path | split("@")[0]) == ".github/workflows/stage-existing-partial-draft.yml"' "$root/run.json"
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$ARTIFACT_ID" > "$root/artifact.json"
          jq -e --arg sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --arg digest "sha256:$ARTIFACT_SHA256" --argjson run "$PREPARED_RUN_ID" '.expired == false and .name == "existing-draft-stage-plan" and .digest == $digest and .workflow_run.id == $run and .workflow_run.head_sha == $sha' "$root/artifact.json"
          gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/artifacts/$ARTIFACT_ID/zip" > "$root/plan.zip"
          [[ "$(shasum -a 256 "$root/plan.zip" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$ARTIFACT_SHA256" ]]
          [[ "$(unzip -Z1 "$root/plan.zip" | awk '$0 == "stage-plan.json" {count++} END {print count+0}')" == 1 ]]
          unzip -p "$root/plan.zip" stage-plan.json > "$root/stage-plan.json"
          [[ "$(shasum -a 256 "$root/stage-plan.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)" == "$PLAN_SHA256" ]]
      - name: Authenticate and hash real release inputs without native application execution
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          PLAN_SHA256: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
          INPUT_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.input_digest }}
          FEED_MODE: ${{ inputs.feed_mode }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-transfer.mts \
            --operation prepare --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-updater-inputs/stage-plan.json" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" --input-digest "$INPUT_DIGEST" \
            --tooling-sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --feed-mode "$FEED_MODE" \
            --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs"
      - name: Upload authenticated immutable Mac inputs
        id: bundle
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/
          compression-level: 0
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  mac-current-no-update:
    needs: prepare-mac-inputs
    permissions:
      contents: read
      actions: read
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai'
    name: mac-current-no-update (${{ matrix.architecture }})
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - architecture: arm64
            runner: macos-15
          - architecture: x64
            runner: macos-15-intel
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner == 'macos-15' && (vars.CI_MACOS_ARM_RUNNER || 'namespace-profile-macos-15') || matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 30
    steps:
      - name: Require reviewed immutable tooling
        env:
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          [[ "$TOOLING_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$TOOLING_SHA" ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Install pinned harness dependencies without product lifecycle scripts
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      # Independent read-only harness checks and immutable input retrieval share a failure barrier.
      - parallel:
          - name: Check typed native Mac harness
            run: |
              node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc --noEmit -p scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json
              pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-updater.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-loopback.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-inputs.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-mirror.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-serialization.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-serialization.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-pf-receipt.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-transfer.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-artifact.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-stop-owned.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-capture-read.test.mts
          - name: Verify compiler-independent observer serialization
            run: pnpm exec tsx --test scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-serialization.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-pf-receipt.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-stop-owned.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-capture-read.test.mts
          - name: Retrieve and verify only this completed authenticated producer job's immutable artifact
            env:
              GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
              TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
              INPUT_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ needs.prepare-mac-inputs.outputs.artifact_id }}
              INPUT_ARTIFACT_SHA256: ${{ needs.prepare-mac-inputs.outputs.artifact_sha256 }}
            run: |
              set -euo pipefail
              ./node_modules/.bin/tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-input-transfer.mts \
                --operation retrieve --tooling-sha "$TOOLING_SHA" \
                --artifact-id "$INPUT_ARTIFACT_ID" --artifact-sha256 "$INPUT_ARTIFACT_SHA256" \
                --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs"
      - name: Native signed current Mac app completes genuine no-update with OS containment
        timeout-minutes: 16
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          INPUT_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ needs.prepare-mac-inputs.outputs.artifact_id }}
          INPUT_ARTIFACT_SHA256: ${{ needs.prepare-mac-inputs.outputs.artifact_sha256 }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          PLAN_SHA256: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
          INPUT_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.input_digest }}
          ARCHITECTURE: ${{ matrix.architecture }}
          FEED_MODE: ${{ inputs.feed_mode }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          pnpm exec tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-updater.mts \
            --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/stage-plan.json" \
            --inputs "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs" \
            --input-artifact-id "$INPUT_ARTIFACT_ID" --input-artifact-sha256 "$INPUT_ARTIFACT_SHA256" \
            --plan-sha256 "$PLAN_SHA256" --input-digest "$INPUT_DIGEST" \
            --tooling-sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --architecture "$ARCHITECTURE" --feed-mode "$FEED_MODE" \
            --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-updater-evidence"
      - name: Prove TEST app stopped before restoring this disposable job's PF
        id: network-cleanup
        if: always()
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          if [[ -f "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-updater-evidence/pf-owned.json" ]]; then
            pnpm exec tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-updater.mts \
              --restore-network --evidence "$RUNNER_TEMP/TEST-mac-updater-evidence"
          fi
          echo "upload_safe=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - name: Capture bounded PF diagnostics after cleanup failure
        if: always() && steps.network-cleanup.outcome == 'failure'
        run: pnpm exec tsx scripts/e2e/release-updater/mac-cleanup-diagnostics.mts TEST-mac-updater-evidence
      - name: Preserve only PF diagnostics when native cleanup is unproven
        if: always() && steps.network-cleanup.outcome == 'failure'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        timeout-minutes: 2
        with:
          name: TEST-mac-cleanup-failure-${{ matrix.architecture }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-cleanup-diagnostics-TEST-mac-updater-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14
      - name: Preserve native UI, Aqua capture, logs, source hashes and failure gates
        if: always() && steps.network-cleanup.outputs.upload_safe == 'true'
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-mac-current-no-update-${{ matrix.architecture }}-${{ inputs.feed_mode }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-updater-evidence/
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/validated-input-artifact.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/mac-input-bundle.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/prepared-run.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/prepared-artifact.json
            ${{ runner.temp }}/TEST-mac-authenticated-inputs/stage-plan.json
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

name: Native updater feasibility (Linux predecessor)

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/**'
      - '.github/workflows/updater-native-feasibility.yml'
      - 'scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'eslint.fast.config.js'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      target_mode:
        description: '2.17.6/2.17.10 require exact prepared stage; 2.17.2 is historical evidence only'
        type: choice
        options: [staged-2.17.10, staged-2.17.6, historical-2.17.2]
        default: staged-2.17.10
      stage_artifact:
        description: 'Prepared stage artifact name'
        type: string
      stage_run_id:
        description: 'Exact producer run ID'
        type: string
      plan_sha256:
        description: 'Expected SHA256 of its exact stage-plan.json'
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  linux-appimage-tooling-quality:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm lint:fast:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/*.mts
      - run: pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/*.mts

  verified-inputs:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    # GitHub requires push-level access to read draft releases. Keep this token
    # in an input-only job; the native application runs in a separate read-only VM.
    permissions:
      contents: write
      actions: read
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - name: Prepare disposable native inputs and evidence
        run: mkdir -p .artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs .artifacts/TEST-updater-evidence
      - name: Install pinned dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Require explicit prepared artifact identity
        if: inputs.target_mode == 'staged-2.17.6' || inputs.target_mode == 'staged-2.17.10'
        env:
          TEST_STAGE_NAME: ${{ inputs.stage_artifact }}
          TEST_STAGE_RUN: ${{ inputs.stage_run_id }}
          TEST_PLAN_SHA: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -n "$TEST_STAGE_NAME"
          [[ "$TEST_STAGE_RUN" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]
          [[ "$TEST_PLAN_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
      - name: Download immutable prepared stage
        if: inputs.target_mode == 'staged-2.17.6' || inputs.target_mode == 'staged-2.17.10'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: ${{ inputs.stage_artifact }}
          run-id: ${{ inputs.stage_run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ github.token }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs/stage/
      - name: Read exact official predecessor and draft bytes
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          TEST_TARGET_MODE: ${{ inputs.target_mode || 'historical-2.17.2' }}
          TEST_PLAN_SHA: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          inputs=.artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs
          gh api repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/398386033 > "$inputs/source-api.json"
          gh release download v2.17.1 --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern Agent.Teams.AI-2.17.1.AppImage --output "$inputs/old.AppImage"
          gh release download v2.17.1 --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern agent-teams-ai_2.17.1_amd64.deb --output "$inputs/old.deb"
          flags=(--historical-preview)
          if [[ "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.6 || "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.10 ]]; then
            node scripts/e2e/release-updater/inputs.mts --plan-downloads "$inputs/stage" "$TEST_PLAN_SHA" > "$inputs/target-download-identities.json"
            release=$(jq -er '.releaseId' "$inputs/target-download-identities.json")
            target=$(jq -er '.targetVersion' "$inputs/target-download-identities.json")
            test "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" = "staged-$target"
            target_asset=$(jq -er '.assets[0].id' "$inputs/target-download-identities.json")
            readonly target_asset
            gh api "repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/$release" > "$inputs/draft-api.json"
            # Consume actual stage-draft upload bytes, rather than rebuilding
            # its generated metadata inside the native harness.
            node scripts/e2e/release-updater/inputs.mts --metadata-downloads "$inputs/stage" "$TEST_PLAN_SHA" "$inputs/draft-api.json" > "$inputs/staged-metadata-downloads.json"
            jq -r '.[] | [.id,.name] | @tsv' "$inputs/staged-metadata-downloads.json" > "$inputs/staged-metadata.tsv"
            while IFS=$'\t' read -r metadata_asset name; do
              gh api "repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/assets/$metadata_asset" -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' > "$inputs/stage/$name"
            done < "$inputs/staged-metadata.tsv"
            gh api "repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/assets/$target_asset" -H 'Accept: application/octet-stream' > "$inputs/target.AppImage"
            flags=(--stage "$inputs/stage" --plan-sha256 "$TEST_PLAN_SHA")
          else
            test "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" = historical-2.17.2
            gh api repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/401358336 > "$inputs/draft-api.json"
            gh release download v2.17.2 --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern Agent.Teams.AI-2.17.2.AppImage --output "$inputs/target.AppImage"
            node scripts/e2e/release-updater/inputs.mts --write-catalog "$inputs"
          fi
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/inputs.mts --verify-appimage "$inputs" "${flags[@]}"
      - name: Hand verified bytes to the native VM
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-native-updater-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs/
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 2

  linux-predecessor-availability:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    needs: verified-inputs
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Check typed harness and changed file lint
        run: |
          pnpm typecheck
          pnpm lint:fast:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/*.mts
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/*.mts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: TEST-native-updater-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs/
      - run: mkdir -p .artifacts/TEST-updater-evidence
      - name: Enable native FUSE and unprivileged Electron sandbox in ephemeral VM
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse2t64 xvfb xauth x11-utils imagemagick
          test -c /dev/fuse
          # Ubuntu 24 AppArmor otherwise blocks Electron's unprivileged userns.
          # This runner is disposable; no root GUI or --no-sandbox is permitted.
          sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
      - name: Probe unmodified official AppImage with private authenticated Xvfb
        env:
          TEST_TARGET_MODE: ${{ inputs.target_mode || 'historical-2.17.2' }}
          TEST_PLAN_SHA: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          flags=(--historical-preview)
          if [[ "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.6 || "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.10 ]]; then flags=(--stage .artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs/stage --plan-sha256 "$TEST_PLAN_SHA"); fi
          xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24 -nolisten tcp' --error-file=.artifacts/TEST-updater-evidence/xvfb.log \
            node scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-feasibility.mts \
              --inputs .artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs \
              --evidence .artifacts/TEST-updater-evidence "${flags[@]}" \
            2>&1 | tee .artifacts/TEST-updater-evidence/probe.log
      - name: Preserve native evidence on success and failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-linux-predecessor-availability-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-updater-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

  linux-native-ota:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    needs: verified-inputs
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Check the native OTA harness
        run: |
          pnpm typecheck
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/*.mts
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: TEST-native-updater-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs/
      - name: Prepare disposable FUSE, GUI and sandbox
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -p .artifacts/TEST-ota-evidence
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y libfuse2t64 xvfb xauth x11-utils imagemagick tesseract-ocr
          test -c /dev/fuse
          sudo sysctl -w kernel.apparmor_restrict_unprivileged_userns=0
          unshare -Ur true
      - name: Exercise real OTA and separate fresh target desktop
        env:
          TEST_TARGET_MODE: ${{ inputs.target_mode || 'historical-2.17.2' }}
          TEST_PLAN_SHA: ${{ inputs.plan_sha256 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          export TEST_NODE_BIN="$(command -v node)"
          export TEST_RUNNER_USER="$(id -un)"
          export TEST_WORKSPACE="$PWD"
          result=0
          for mode in ota fresh; do
            mkdir -p ".artifacts/TEST-ota-evidence/$mode"
            export TEST_CASE_MODE=$mode
            xvfb-run --auto-servernum --server-args='-screen 0 1280x900x24 -nolisten tcp' \
              sudo --preserve-env=DISPLAY,XAUTHORITY,TEST_NODE_BIN,TEST_RUNNER_USER,TEST_WORKSPACE,TEST_TARGET_MODE,TEST_PLAN_SHA,TEST_CASE_MODE \
              unshare --net /bin/bash -c '
                set -euo pipefail
                ip link set lo up
                flags=(--historical-preview)
                if [[ "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.6 || "$TEST_TARGET_MODE" == staged-2.17.10 ]]; then flags=(--stage "$TEST_WORKSPACE/.artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs/stage" --plan-sha256 "$TEST_PLAN_SHA"); fi
                if test "$TEST_CASE_MODE" = fresh; then flags+=(--fresh); fi
                runuser -u "$TEST_RUNNER_USER" -- env DISPLAY="$DISPLAY" XAUTHORITY="$XAUTHORITY" \
                  "$TEST_NODE_BIN" "$TEST_WORKSPACE/scripts/e2e/release-updater/linux-ota.mts" \
                  --inputs "$TEST_WORKSPACE/.artifacts/TEST-updater-inputs" \
                  --evidence "$TEST_WORKSPACE/.artifacts/TEST-ota-evidence/$TEST_CASE_MODE" "${flags[@]}"
              ' 2>&1 | tee ".artifacts/TEST-ota-evidence/$mode/probe.log" || result=1
          done
          exit "$result"
      - name: Preserve native OTA proof on success and failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-linux-native-ota-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-ota-evidence/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 14

name: Windows official installer fresh and native OTA

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-*.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/native-release-scenario.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/prepared-stage-download*.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/execution-provenance*.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/archive.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/cdp.mts'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/transport.mts'
      - '.github/workflows/updater-windows-ota.yml'
      - '.github/workflows/updater-windows.yml'
      - 'scripts/e2e/release-updater/serialized-function*.mts'
      - 'scripts/ci/release/contract.ts'
      - 'scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      input_mode:
        type: choice
        options: [plan, legacy-2172, serializer]
        default: plan
        required: true
      native_run_id: { type: string, required: false }
      native_run_attempt: { type: string, required: false }
      native_artifact_id: { type: string, required: false }
      native_artifact_sha256: { type: string, required: false }
      plan_digest: { type: string, required: false }
      tooling_sha: { type: string, required: false }
      execution_sha:
        {
          type: string,
          required: false,
          description: Actual immutable executor SHA; defaults to tooling SHA,
        }
      cloud_experience_preflight:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: TEST ARM VM fixture; close one exact CloudExperienceHost window or record verified no-action
      owned_uia_diagnostic:
        type: boolean
        default: false
        description: Read-only ARM window diagnostic; never qualifies release readiness

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/') }}

jobs:
  windows-serializer-contract:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.input_mode == 'serializer'
    runs-on: windows-2025
    timeout-minutes: 10
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    steps:
      - name: Require the exact reviewed serializer source
        env:
          EXECUTION_SHA: ${{ inputs.execution_sha }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if ($env:EXECUTION_SHA -notmatch '^[a-f0-9]{40}$' -or $env:GITHUB_SHA -ne $env:EXECUTION_SHA) { throw 'Exact serializer execution SHA required' }
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Pin the already-running installed PowerShell 7 native helper
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $directory = Join-Path $PWD '.artifacts/TEST-windows-serializer'
          [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($directory) | Out-Null
          $executable = [Diagnostics.Process]::GetCurrentProcess().MainModule.FileName
          $programFiles = [Environment]::GetFolderPath([Environment+SpecialFolder]::ProgramFiles)
          $installedRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $programFiles 'PowerShell')) + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
          if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($executable) -or -not $executable.StartsWith($installedRoot, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or [IO.Path]::GetFileName($executable) -ne 'pwsh.exe' -or [IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($executable) -ne $PSHOME) { throw 'Native helper must be the already-running installed ProgramFiles/PowerShell pwsh.exe' }
          if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core' -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) { throw 'PowerShell 7 or newer required' }
          $manifest = Join-Path $directory 'native-shell.json'
          $identity = @{ executable=$executable; psHome=$PSHOME; version=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); edition=$PSVersionTable.PSEdition; sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $executable -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); programFiles=$programFiles; systemRoot=$env:SystemRoot }
          [IO.File]::WriteAllText($manifest, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $identity -Compress))
          "TEST_WINDOWS_NATIVE_SHELL_MANIFEST=$manifest" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Verify the actual producer without UI or installer execution
        run: |
          node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-name-pattern '^selected PS7 observer producer' scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native-owners.test.mts 2>&1 | Tee-Object .artifacts/TEST-windows-serializer/contract.log
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Selected PowerShell serializer contract failed' }
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        if: always()
        with:
          name: TEST-windows-serializer-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-windows-serializer/
          if-no-files-found: error

  tooling-quality:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/native-release-scenario.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/prepared-stage-download*.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/execution-provenance*.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-*.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/serialized-function*.mts
      - run: node --import tsx --test scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-plan-inputs.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-plan-producer.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/prepared-stage-download.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/execution-provenance.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-cloud-preflight.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-ota-mirror.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/serialized-function.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native-entrypoint.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-startup-retry.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native-route.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native-owners.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native-paint-content.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-arm-prior-fixture.test.mts

  verified-windows-inputs:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.input_mode == 'plan'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Require the exact reviewed tooling SHA
        env:
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          EXECUTION_SHA: ${{ inputs.execution_sha || inputs.tooling_sha }}
        run: |
          [[ "$TOOLING_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$EXECUTION_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$EXECUTION_SHA" ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Verify native helper imports do not intercept controller cleanup
        run: node --import tsx --test scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native-entrypoint.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-startup-retry.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native-route.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native-owners.test.mts
      - name: Verify immutable native producer and extract exact plan-bound inputs
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          NATIVE_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.native_run_id }}
          NATIVE_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.native_run_attempt }}
          NATIVE_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.native_artifact_id }}
          NATIVE_ARTIFACT_SHA256: ${{ inputs.native_artifact_sha256 }}
          PLAN_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.plan_digest }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
          EXECUTION_SHA: ${{ inputs.execution_sha || inputs.tooling_sha }}
        run: |
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-plan-download.mts --kind native --output .artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs --run-id "$NATIVE_RUN_ID" --run-attempt "$NATIVE_ATTEMPT" --artifact-id "$NATIVE_ARTIFACT_ID" --artifact-sha256 "$NATIVE_ARTIFACT_SHA256" --plan-digest "$PLAN_DIGEST" --tooling-sha "$TOOLING_SHA" --execution-sha "$EXECUTION_SHA"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-windows-ota-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs/
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 2

  legacy-windows-inputs:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.input_mode == 'legacy-2172'
    # Draft reads need push-level access. The desktop VM never receives this
    # credential and has only contents:read in its independent native job.
    permissions:
      contents: write
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Download immutable official Windows installers and blockmaps
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          inputs=.artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs
          mkdir -p "$inputs"
          gh api repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/398386033 > "$inputs/source-api.json"
          gh api repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/401358336 > "$inputs/draft-api.json"
          for version in 2.17.1 2.17.2; do
            for suffix in '' '-arm64'; do
              asset="Agent.Teams.AI.Setup.$version$suffix.exe"
              gh release download "v$version" --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern "$asset" --dir "$inputs"
              gh release download "v$version" --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern "$asset.blockmap" --dir "$inputs"
            done
          done
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-mirror.mts --verify-inputs "$inputs" --legacy-2172
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-windows-ota-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs/
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 2

  windows-predecessor:
    needs: [verified-windows-inputs, legacy-windows-inputs]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && !inputs.owned_uia_diagnostic && (needs.verified-windows-inputs.result == 'success' || needs.legacy-windows-inputs.result == 'success') }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: windows-2025
            arch: x64
          - os: windows-11-arm
            arch: arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    env:
      TEST_WINDOWS_CLOUD_EXPERIENCE_PREFLIGHT: ${{ inputs.cloud_experience_preflight && matrix.arch == 'arm64' && '1' || '0' }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          architecture: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Check all typed updater tools and full changed file lint
        run: |
          pnpm typecheck
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Canonical typecheck failed' }
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-updater.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-mirror.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-startup-diagnostic.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-powershell.mts
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows harness lint failed' }
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: TEST-windows-ota-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs/
      - name: Pin the already-running installed PowerShell 7 native helper
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $directory = Join-Path $PWD '.artifacts/TEST-windows-evidence'
          [IO.Directory]::CreateDirectory($directory) | Out-Null
          $executable = [Diagnostics.Process]::GetCurrentProcess().MainModule.FileName
          $programFiles = [Environment]::GetFolderPath([Environment+SpecialFolder]::ProgramFiles)
          $installedRoot = [IO.Path]::GetFullPath((Join-Path $programFiles 'PowerShell')) + [IO.Path]::DirectorySeparatorChar
          if (-not [IO.Path]::IsPathFullyQualified($executable) -or -not $executable.StartsWith($installedRoot, [StringComparison]::OrdinalIgnoreCase) -or [IO.Path]::GetFileName($executable) -ne 'pwsh.exe' -or [IO.Path]::GetDirectoryName($executable) -ne $PSHOME) { throw 'Native helper must be the already-running installed ProgramFiles/PowerShell pwsh.exe' }
          if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core' -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) { throw 'PowerShell 7 or newer required' }
          $manifest = Join-Path $directory 'native-shell.json'
          $identity = @{ executable=$executable; psHome=$PSHOME; version=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); edition=$PSVersionTable.PSEdition; sha256=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $executable -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant(); programFiles=$programFiles; systemRoot=$env:SystemRoot }
          [IO.File]::WriteAllText($manifest, (ConvertTo-Json -InputObject $identity -Compress))
          "TEST_WINDOWS_NATIVE_SHELL_MANIFEST=$manifest" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append
      - name: Compare legacy startup and require explicitly selected PowerShell 7
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-startup-diagnostic.mts --evidence .artifacts/TEST-windows-evidence
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Windows startup diagnostic harness failed' }
      - name: Install and inspect official predecessor on its real native desktop
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force .artifacts/TEST-windows-evidence | Out-Null
          if ((node -p process.arch) -ne '${{ matrix.arch }}') { throw 'Runner/Node architecture mismatch' }

on:

      - 'scripts/tsconfig/tsconfig.updater-e2e.json'
      - 'tsconfig.json'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:

        required: true

      native_run_attempt: { type: string, required: false }

permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read

# Canonical run supersession; see docs/ci-qualification.md#run-supersession.
concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number || (github.event_name == 'merge_group' || github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'branch' && github.event.repository.default_branch != '' && github.ref_name != github.event.repository.default_branch && !startsWith(github.ref_name, 'release/')) && github.ref || github.run_id }}

jobs:
  tooling-quality:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: pnpm typecheck
      - run: pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-*.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/serialized-function*.mts
      - run: node --import tsx --test scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-plan-inputs.test.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/serialized-function.test.mts

  verified-windows-inputs:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.input_mode == 'plan'
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - name: Require the exact reviewed tooling SHA
        env:
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}
        run: |
          [[ "$TOOLING_SHA" =~ ^[a-f0-9]{40}$ && "$GITHUB_SHA" == "$TOOLING_SHA" ]]
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

          NATIVE_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.native_run_attempt }}
          NATIVE_ARTIFACT_ID: ${{ inputs.native_artifact_id }}
          NATIVE_ARTIFACT_SHA256: ${{ inputs.native_artifact_sha256 }}
          PLAN_DIGEST: ${{ inputs.plan_digest }}
          TOOLING_SHA: ${{ inputs.tooling_sha }}

          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-plan-download.mts --kind native --output .artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs --run-id "$NATIVE_RUN_ID" --run-attempt "$NATIVE_ATTEMPT" --artifact-id "$NATIVE_ARTIFACT_ID" --artifact-sha256 "$NATIVE_ARTIFACT_SHA256" --plan-digest "$PLAN_DIGEST" --tooling-sha "$TOOLING_SHA"

        with:
          name: TEST-windows-updater-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs/
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 2

  legacy-windows-inputs:
    if: github.repository == '777genius/agent-teams-ai' && github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.input_mode == 'legacy-2172'
    # Draft reads need push-level access. The desktop VM never receives this
    # credential and has only contents:read in its independent native job.
    permissions:
      contents: write
    runs-on: ${{ vars.CI_LINUX_RUNNER || 'ubuntu-latest' }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Download immutable official Windows installers and blockmaps
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          inputs=.artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs
          mkdir -p "$inputs"
          gh api repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/398386033 > "$inputs/source-api.json"
          gh api repos/777genius/agent-teams-ai/releases/401358336 > "$inputs/draft-api.json"
          for version in 2.17.1 2.17.2; do
            for suffix in '' '-arm64'; do
              asset="Agent.Teams.AI.Setup.$version$suffix.exe"
              gh release download "v$version" --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern "$asset" --dir "$inputs"
              gh release download "v$version" --repo 777genius/agent-teams-ai --pattern "$asset.blockmap" --dir "$inputs"
            done
          done
          node scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-mirror.mts --verify-inputs "$inputs" --legacy-2172
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v7
        with:
          name: TEST-windows-updater-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: .artifacts/TEST-windows-inputs/
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
          retention-days: 2

  windows-predecessor:
    needs: [verified-windows-inputs, legacy-windows-inputs]
    if: ${{ !cancelled() && (needs.verified-windows-inputs.result == 'success' || needs.legacy-windows-inputs.result == 'success') }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - os: windows-2025
            arch: x64
          - os: windows-11-arm
            arch: arm64
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 25
    permissions:
      contents: read
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
          architecture: ${{ matrix.arch }}
          package-manager-cache: false
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Check all typed updater tools and full changed file lint
        run: |
          pnpm typecheck
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Canonical typecheck failed' }
          pnpm lint:ci:files -- scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-updater.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-native.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-mirror.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-startup-diagnostic.mts scripts/e2e/release-updater/windows-powershell.mts

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: TEST-windows-updater-inputs-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}

      - name: Pin the already-running installed PowerShell 7 native helper
        run: |

          if ($PSVersionTable.PSEdition -ne 'Core' -or $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major -lt 7) { throw 'PowerShell 7 or newer required' }

  packaged-backfill:
    if: (github.event_name != 'pull_request' || github.event.pull_request.draft != true) && (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository)
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 35
    env:
      WINDOWS_BACKFILL_REQUIRED: '1'
      WINDOWS_BACKFILL_APP_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
      # Reviewed ownership helper; native identity and teardown passed in run 34313093482.
      # This pin does not claim the separate fake-provider MCP smoke passed.
      WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_SHA: 'cb0b0995290218c2caa5f09541cc1d828a0fa832'
      WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/backfill-test-support
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: pwsh
    steps:
      - name: Initialize failure evidence
        run: |
          $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-app-backfill-evidence'
          "WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR=$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR | Out-Null
          @{ status = 'preflight-pending'; platform = $env:RUNNER_OS; runId = '${{ github.run_id }}'; appEventSha = '${{ github.sha }}'; supportSha = $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_SHA } |
            ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/preflight.json" -Encoding utf8
          if (-not $IsWindows) { throw 'Actual Windows is mandatory' }

      - name: Validate runtime qualification tuple before downloads
        id: runtime
        env:
          INPUT_RUNTIME_VERSION: ${{ inputs.runtime_version }}
          INPUT_RUNTIME_ARCHIVE_SHA256: ${{ inputs.runtime_archive_sha256 }}
          INPUT_RUNTIME_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ inputs.runtime_source_sha }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $version = $env:INPUT_RUNTIME_VERSION
          $digest = $env:INPUT_RUNTIME_ARCHIVE_SHA256
          $source = $env:INPUT_RUNTIME_SOURCE_SHA
          $custom = ($version -ne '' -and $null -ne $version) -or ($digest -ne '' -and $null -ne $digest) -or ($source -ne '' -and $null -ne $source)
          if ($custom) {
            if ($env:GITHUB_EVENT_NAME -ne 'workflow_dispatch') { throw 'Custom runtime requires workflow_dispatch' }
            if ($version -cnotmatch '\A(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\z' -or
                $digest -notmatch '\A[a-fA-F0-9]{64}\z' -or $source -notmatch '\A[a-fA-F0-9]{40}\z') {
              throw 'Supply all three: exact X.Y.Z version, 64-hex archive SHA256, and 40-hex source SHA'
            }
            $digest = $digest.ToLowerInvariant()
            $source = $source.ToLowerInvariant()
          } else {
            # Immutable original PR/manual defaults; custom qualification never updates these pins.
            $version = '0.0.87'
            $digest = 'f4f36d3f3697fcb3208e7bfc784829a447d8c7faf65570479fa0b4a92ed1ef5d'
            $source = ''
          }
          "custom=$($custom.ToString().ToLowerInvariant())" >> $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT
          "WINDOWS_BACKFILL_RUNTIME_VERSION=$version" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "WINDOWS_BACKFILL_RUNTIME_ARCHIVE_SHA256=$digest" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "WINDOWS_BACKFILL_RUNTIME_SOURCE_SHA=$source" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV

      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Record and verify exact application checkout
        run: |
          $actual = git rev-parse HEAD
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $actual -ne $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_APP_SHA) { throw 'Application SHA mismatch' }
          @{ appSourceSha = $actual; expectedAppSourceSha = $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_APP_SHA } |
            ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/app-source.json" -Encoding utf8

      - name: Fetch immutable runtime test support only
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          repository: 777genius/agent_teams_orchestrator
          ref: ${{ env.WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_SHA }}
          path: backfill-test-support
          token: ${{ secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: scripts/smoke

      - name: Verify support availability before installing dependencies
        run: |
          $actual = git -C $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_ROOT rev-parse HEAD
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $actual -ne $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_SHA) { throw 'Support SHA mismatch' }
          foreach ($file in @('windows-runtime-opencode-backfill.mjs', 'windows-runtime-opencode-fixture.cjs')) {
            if (-not (Test-Path "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_ROOT/scripts/smoke/$file" -PathType Leaf)) {
              throw "Pinned support lacks $file; coordinator must pin the reviewed helper commit"
            }
          }

      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
        with:
          run_install: false

      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version

      - name: Install locked test dependencies without builds or lifecycle scripts
        timeout-minutes: 6
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts

      - name: Build captured Host and ledger prerequisites
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/legacy-agent-host build

      - name: Download and verify the selected archive before extraction
        timeout-minutes: 4
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # Additional credential only for validated manual qualification; never for PR downloads.
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && steps.runtime.outputs.custom == 'true' && secrets.RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN || '' }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $requestedVersion = $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_RUNTIME_VERSION
          $expectedSource = $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_RUNTIME_SOURCE_SHA
          $custom = -not [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($expectedSource)
          if ($custom -and [string]::IsNullOrEmpty($env:GH_TOKEN)) { throw 'Manual qualification requires RUNTIME_BUILD_DISPATCH_TOKEN' }
          $tag = "runtime-v$requestedVersion"
          $asset = "agent-teams-runtime-win32-x64-v$requestedVersion.zip"
          $archive = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP $asset
          $url = "https://github.com/777genius/agent_teams_orchestrator_binaries/releases/download/$tag/$asset"
          $expected = $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_RUNTIME_ARCHIVE_SHA256
          $mode = if ($custom) { 'manual-qualification' } else { 'shipped-default' }
          $provenance = @{ status = 'downloading'; mode = $mode; runtimeVersion = $requestedVersion; expectedRuntimeSourceSha = $expectedSource; url = $url; expectedArchiveSha256 = $expected; appSourceSha = (git rev-parse HEAD); supportSha = $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_SHA; runtimeBuildSourceSha = $null }
          $provenance | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/release.json" -Encoding utf8
          # gh supports authenticated draft assets; repository, tag prefix and asset shape are fixed.
          gh release download $tag --repo 777genius/agent_teams_orchestrator_binaries --pattern $asset --dir $env:RUNNER_TEMP --clobber
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Runtime release download failed' }
          $actual = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $archive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          $provenance.archiveSha256 = $actual
          $provenance.status = 'archive-downloaded'
          $provenance | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/release.json" -Encoding utf8
          if ($actual -ne $expected) { throw 'Archive SHA256 mismatch; refusing extraction/execution' }
          $extract = Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'windows-backfill-shipped-runtime'
          Expand-Archive -LiteralPath $archive -DestinationPath $extract -Force
          $executables = @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $extract -Recurse -Filter claude-multimodel.exe -File)
          if ($executables.Count -ne 1) { throw 'Expected exactly one shipped claude-multimodel.exe' }
          $binary = $executables[0].FullName
          $exeHash = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $binary -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant()
          $runtimeDir = Split-Path -Parent $binary
          $runtimeSha = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runtimeDir 'COMMIT_SHA')).Trim()
          $version = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath (Join-Path $runtimeDir 'VERSION')).Trim()
          if ($runtimeSha -cnotmatch '\A[a-f0-9]{40}\z' -or $version -cne $requestedVersion) { throw 'Release metadata mismatch' }
          if ($custom -and $runtimeSha -cne $expectedSource) { throw 'Runtime COMMIT_SHA mismatch' }
          $provenance.runtimeBuildSourceSha = $runtimeSha
          $provenance.executableSha256 = $exeHash
          $provenance.executableArchiveMember = [IO.Path]::GetRelativePath($extract, $binary).Replace('\', '/')
          $provenance.status = 'verified-archive-and-executable'
          $provenance | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/release.json" -Encoding utf8
          "WINDOWS_BACKFILL_ARCHIVE=$archive" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EXE=$binary" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
          "WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EXE_SHA256=$exeHash" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Require actual Windows, binary, and trusted PowerShell fixture PATH
        run: |
          if (-not $IsWindows -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EXE -PathType Leaf)) { throw 'Windows packaged test cannot run' }
          @'
          const path = require('node:path');
          const { pathToFileURL } = require('node:url');
          const fs = require('node:fs');
          (async () => {
            const support = await import(pathToFileURL(path.join(process.env.WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_ROOT, 'scripts/smoke/windows-runtime-opencode-backfill.mjs')));
            const root = fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(require('node:os').tmpdir(), 'backfill-preflight-'));
            try {
              const env = support.sandboxEnvironment(root, path.join(root, 'opencode.cmd'));
              const dir = path.join(process.env.SystemRoot, 'System32', 'WindowsPowerShell', 'v1.0');
              if (!env.PATH.toLowerCase().split(';').includes(dir.toLowerCase()) || !fs.existsSync(path.join(dir, 'powershell.exe'))) throw Error('Pinned helper must include trusted WindowsPowerShell/v1.0');
            } finally { fs.rmSync(root, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
          })().catch(error => { console.error(error.message); process.exitCode = 1; });
          '@ | node
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Support sandbox preflight failed' }
          @{ status = 'ready'; platform = 'win32'; appSourceSha = (git rev-parse HEAD); supportSha = $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_SHA } |
            ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/preflight.json" -Encoding utf8

      - name: Run only the actual application packaged backfill integration
        timeout-minutes: 19
        run: pnpm exec vitest run test/main/services/team/OpenCodePackagedBackfill.windows.test.ts --maxWorkers=1 --no-file-parallelism --reporter=verbose --reporter=json --outputFile.json="$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/vitest.json"

      - name: Record job outcome even when preflight fails
        if: always()
        run: |
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR | Out-Null
          @{ jobStatus = '${{ job.status }}'; platform = $env:RUNNER_OS; supportSha = $env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_SUPPORT_SHA; packagedEvidencePresent = (Test-Path "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/ascii.json") } |
            ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content "$env:WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR/job-outcome.json" -Encoding utf8

      - name: Upload diagnostic evidence on success and failure
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: windows-app-backfill-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ env.WINDOWS_BACKFILL_EVIDENCE_DIR }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

qualification: Read-only retained complete current Git workflow/source data for prospective venue review. Exact source bodies are anchored through unchanged actual non-docroot entries and prior full actual source-publication reads; this is not a current local filesystem census, CI execution, or GREEN result. All42 workflow bodies are complete literal strings; no event/action is inferred merely from filenames.
